The uploaded files collectively define the project called SculptureFlow, which is a production-grade business management system tailored for sculpture studios.

Summary of the project:

- Project Type and Goal: SculptureFlow is designed as a comprehensive business management platform specifically for sculpture studios. It covers client relationship management, project tracking, task management, time tracking, materials inventory, invoicing, quotations, and photo documentation of projects.
- Tech Stack: The project uses Next.js 14 with the App Router, TypeScript, TailwindCSS for styling, Supabase (PostgreSQL) for backend database and storage, and integrates several libraries like Lucide React icons, React Hot Toast for notifications, and jsPDF for PDF generation.
- Core Features Implemented:
    - Client Management with CRUD operations,
    - Project Management including status tracking, budget and deadlines,
    - Task Management with prioritization and task assignments,
    - Time Tracking with project- and task-level flexibility,
    - Materials Inventory management,
    - Invoice and quotation generation with status tracking,
    - A UI designed with a glassmorphic custom design system supporting dark mode and responsive layout.
- Current Development Status:
    - Most core features are implemented and functional.
    - Photo management is in progress but currently blocked by Supabase Storage Row Level Security (RLS) configuration issues.
    - Authentication not yet implemented; currently using Supabase anonymous key with permissive policies.
- Project Execution File Details:
    - Database schema for clients, projects, tasks, materials, projectmaterials, timeentries, photos, invoices, and quotations is fully defined.
    - Step-by-step project execution plan for setting up the database, storage buckets, environment variables, and deploying on Vercel.
    - Detailed instructions for development phases including generating UI components, pages, features, utilities, and integration.
    - Recommended workflow for code generation, testing, deployment, and common troubleshooting steps.
    - Future enhancements including multi-user authentication, email notifications, advanced analytics, and mobile app support are envisioned.
- Visual Sitemap: Comprehensive wireframes define the navigation and key screens including Dashboard, Projects, Clients, Invoices, Materials, and Quotations, with detailed component layouts and user flows.
- Code Generation and Completion:
    - Complete prompts and instructions for generating production-ready, fully-tested, and accessible components and pages are provided.
    - Emphasis on mobile-first responsive design, accessibility, error handling, and performance optimizations.

Overall, the project aims to deliver a robust, scalable, and user-friendly sculpture studio management application, with clean UI/UX, thorough functionality spanning all business operations, and readiness for production deployment.

# this is my current time tracker code, there is also a tasks card that tracks tasks for a specific project of the client, now i was wondering how we can both link the timer as a project timer and task timer in case the worker chooses to link to specific tasks, the current code does not provide me what i need of linking the time spent working to specific tasks: "use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Clock, Play, Square, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface TimeTrackerProps {
projectId: string;
projectName?: string;
}

interface Task {
id: string;
title: string;
}

export default function TimeTracker({ projectId, projectName = 'Project' }: TimeTrackerProps) {
const [isTracking, setIsTracking] = useState(false);
const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(0);
const [activeEntryId, setActiveEntryId] = useState<string | null>(null);
const [selectedTaskId, setSelectedTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);
const [totalHours, setTotalHours] = useState(0);
const [todayHours, setTodayHours] = useState(0);
const [recentEntries, setRecentEntries] = useState<any[]>([]);
const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<Task[]>([]);

useEffect(() => {
fetchTasks();
fetchTotalHours();
fetchTodayHours();
fetchRecentEntries();
checkActiveEntry();
}, [projectId]);

useEffect(() => {
let interval: NodeJS.Timeout;
if (isTracking) {
interval = setInterval(() => {
setSeconds((prev) => prev + 1);
}, 1000);
}
return () => clearInterval(interval);
}, [isTracking]);

const fetchTasks = async () => {
try {
const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
.from('tasks')
.select('id, title')
.eq('project_id', projectId)
.order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (error) throw error;
      setTasks(data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
    };

const fetchTotalHours = async () => {
try {
const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
.from('time_entries')
.select('hours')
.eq('project_id', projectId);

      if (error) throw error;
      const total = data?.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.hours || 0), 0) || 0;
      setTotalHours(total);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
    };

const fetchTodayHours = async () => {
try {
const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
.from('time_entries')
.select('hours')
.eq('project_id', projectId)
.gte('start_time', today);

      if (error) throw error;
      const total = data?.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.hours || 0), 0) || 0;
      setTodayHours(total);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
    };

const fetchRecentEntries = async () => {
try {
const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
.from('time_entries')
.select('*, tasks(title)')
.eq('project_id', projectId)
.order('start_time', { ascending: false })
.limit(5);

      if (error) throw error;
      setRecentEntries(data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
    };

const checkActiveEntry = async () => {
try {
const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
.from('time_entries')
.select('*')
.eq('project_id', projectId)
.is('end_time', null)
.single();

      if (data) {
        setActiveEntryId(data.id);
        setSelectedTaskId(data.task_id);
        setIsTracking(true);
        const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(data.start_time).getTime()) / 1000);
        setSeconds(elapsed);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // No active entry
    }
    };

const startTracking = async () => {
try {
const taskName = selectedTaskId
? tasks.find(t => t.id === selectedTaskId)?.title
: projectName;

      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .insert({
          project_id: projectId,
          task_id: selectedTaskId,
          start_time: new Date().toISOString(),
          description: `Working on ${taskName}`,
        })
        .select()
        .single();
    
    
      if (error) throw error;
      
      setActiveEntryId(data.id);
      setIsTracking(true);
      setSeconds(0);
      toast.success('Timer started');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to start timer');
    }
    };

const stopTracking = async () => {
if (!activeEntryId) return;

    try {
      const hours = seconds / 3600;
      
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .update({
          end_time: new Date().toISOString(),
          hours: parseFloat(hours.toFixed(2)),
        })
        .eq('id', activeEntryId);
    
    
      if (error) throw error;
    
    
      setIsTracking(false);
      setActiveEntryId(null);
      setSelectedTaskId(null);
      await fetchTotalHours();
      await fetchTodayHours();
      await fetchRecentEntries();
      toast.success(`Logged ${hours.toFixed(2)}h`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to stop timer');
    }
    };

const deleteEntry = async (entryId: string) => {
if (!confirm('Delete this time entry?')) return;

    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', entryId);
    
    
      if (error) throw error;
    
    
      await fetchTotalHours();
      await fetchTodayHours();
      await fetchRecentEntries();
      toast.success('Entry deleted');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to delete entry');
    }
    };

const formatTime = (totalSeconds: number) => {
const h = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
const m = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
const s = totalSeconds % 60;
return `${h.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
};

return (
<div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-lg p-4 shadow-xl">
{/* Header */}
<div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
<div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500/20 to-purple-500/20 border border-white/10">
<Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
</div>
```        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">Time Tracker</h3>        ```
</div>

      {/* Task Selector */}
      <div className="mb-3">
        ```
        <label className="text-xs text-white/60 mb-1 block">Task (Optional)</label>
        ```
        <select
          value={selectedTaskId || ''}
          onChange={(e) => setSelectedTaskId(e.target.value || null)}
          disabled={isTracking}
          className="w-full rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 focus:border-transparent disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
        >
          ```
          <option value="">Project-level (no specific task)</option>
          ```
          {tasks.map((task) => (
            <option key={task.id} value={task.id}>
              {task.title}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </div>
    
    
      {/* Timer Display */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {isTracking && (
            ```
            <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-red-500 animate-pulse"></div>
            ```
          )}
          <span className="font-mono text-3xl font-bold text-white">
            {formatTime(seconds)}
          </span>
        </div>
        
        <button
          onClick={isTracking ? stopTracking : startTracking}
          className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg transition-all ${
            isTracking
              ? 'bg-red-500/20 hover:bg-red-500/30 border border-red-500/30'
              : 'bg-green-500/20 hover:bg-green-500/30 border border-green-500/30'
          }`}
          title={isTracking ? 'Stop' : 'Start'}
        >
          {isTracking ? (
            <Square className="w-5 h-5 text-red-400 fill-red-400" />
          ) : (
            <Play className="w-5 h-5 text-green-400 fill-green-400" />
          )}
        </button>
      </div>
    
    
      {/* Stats Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-4">
        <div className="rounded-lg bg-white/5 p-3 border border-white/10">
          ```
          <div className="text-xs text-white/60 mb-1">Today</div>
          ```
          ```
          <div className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">{todayHours.toFixed(1)}h</div>
          ```
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-lg bg-white/5 p-3 border border-white/10">
          ```
          <div className="text-xs text-white/60 mb-1">Total</div>
          ```
          ```
          <div className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">{totalHours.toFixed(1)}h</div>
          ```
        </div>
      </div>
    
    
      {/* Recent Entries */}
      <div>
        ```
        <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-white mb-2">Recent Entries</h4>
        ```
        <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[200px] overflow-y-auto">
          {recentEntries.length === 0 ? (
            ```
            <p className="text-xs text-white/40 py-3 text-center">No entries yet</p>
            ```
          ) : (
            recentEntries.map((entry: any) => (
              <div
                key={entry.id}
                className="rounded-lg bg-white/5 p-2.5 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors group"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-white">
                      {entry.hours ? `${entry.hours.toFixed(2)}h` : 'In progress...'}
                    </span>
                    {entry.tasks && (
                      <span className="text-xs text-purple-300 bg-purple-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                        {entry.tasks.title}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-xs text-white/60">
                      {new Date(entry.start_time).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => deleteEntry(entry.id)}
                      className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 p-1 hover:bg-red-500/20 rounded transition-all"
                      title="Delete"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3 text-red-400" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {entry.description && (
                  ```
                  <p className="text-xs text-white/70 truncate">{entry.description}</p>
                  ```
                )}
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    
    
      {/* Animation styles */}
      <style jsx>{`
        @keyframes pulse {
          0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
          50% { opacity: 0.5; }

          animation: pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
    );
}

# the tasksection.tsx is under projects - id - folder structure: "use client";

import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { Task } from '@/types';
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { CheckCircle2, Circle, Trash2, Plus, ChevronDown, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';

export default function TaskSection({ projectId, tasks }: { projectId: string, tasks: Task[] }) {
const [taskList, setTaskList] = useState<Task[]>(tasks);
const [newTaskInput, setNewTaskInput] = useState('');
const [showCompleted, setShowCompleted] = useState(false);
const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);

const pendingTasks = taskList.filter(t => t.status === 'pending');
const completedTasks = taskList.filter(t => t.status === 'completed');
const completionPercentage = taskList.length > 0
? Math.round((completedTasks.length / taskList.length) * 100)
: 0;

const handleAddTask = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
e.preventDefault();
if (!newTaskInput.trim()) return;

    setAdding(true);
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('tasks')
        .insert({
          project_id: projectId,
          description: newTaskInput.trim(),
          status: 'pending',
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .select()
        .single();
    
    
      if (error) throw error;
      if (data) {
        setTaskList([...taskList, data]);
        setNewTaskInput('');
        toast.success('Task added!');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error adding task:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to add task');
    }
    setAdding(false);
    };

const handleToggleTask = async (task: Task) => {
const newStatus = task.status === 'completed' ? 'pending' : 'completed';

    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('tasks')
        .update({ status: newStatus, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
        .eq('id', task.id)
        .select()
        .single();
    
    
      if (error) throw error;
      if (data) {
        setTaskList(taskList.map(t => t.id === task.id ? data : t));
        toast.success(newStatus === 'completed' ? 'Task completed! 🎉' : 'Task reopened');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating task:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to update task');
    }
    };

const handleDeleteTask = async (taskId: string) => {
if (!confirm('Delete this task?')) return;

    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('tasks')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', taskId);
    
    
      if (error) throw error;
      setTaskList(taskList.filter(t => t.id !== taskId));
      toast.success('Task deleted');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error deleting task:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to delete task');
    }
    };

return (
<div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-lg p-6 shadow-xl">
{/* Header */}
<div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
<div className="flex items-center gap-3">
<div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500/20 to-emerald-500/20 border border-white/10">
<CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
</div>
<div>
```            <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white">Tasks</h3>            ```
<p className="text-sm text-white/60">
{completedTasks.length} of {taskList.length} completed
</p>
</div>
</div>
{/* Progress Circle */}
<div className="relative w-16 h-16">
<svg className="w-16 h-16 transform -rotate-90">
            <circle
              cx="32"
              cy="32"
              r="28"
              stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"
              strokeWidth="4"
              fill="none"
            />
            <circle
              cx="32"
              cy="32"
              r="28"
              stroke="url(#gradient)"
              strokeWidth="4"
              fill="none"
              strokeDasharray={`${2 * Math.PI * 28}`}
              strokeDashoffset={`${2 * Math.PI * 28 * (1 - completionPercentage / 100)}`}
              strokeLinecap="round"
              className="transition-all duration-500"
            />
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id="gradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
                <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#10b981" />
                <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#059669" />
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>
          </svg>
<div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
```            <span className="text-white font-bold text-sm">{completionPercentage}%</span>            ```
</div>
</div>

      {/* Add Task Form */}

### **1. Enhanced TimeTracker.tsx**

```typescript
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Clock, Play, Square, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface TimeTrackerProps {
  projectId: string;
  projectName?: string;
}

interface Task {
  id: string;
  title: string;
}

export default function TimeTracker({ projectId, projectName = 'Project' }: TimeTrackerProps) {
  const [isTracking, setIsTracking] = useState(false);
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [activeEntryId, setActiveEntryId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedTaskId, setSelectedTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [totalHours, setTotalHours] = useState(0);
  const [todayHours, setTodayHours] = useState(0);
  const [recentEntries, setRecentEntries] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<Task[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTasks();
    fetchTotalHours();
    fetchTodayHours();
    fetchRecentEntries();
    checkActiveEntry();
  }, [projectId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let interval: NodeJS.Timeout;
    if (isTracking) {
      interval = setInterval(() => {
        setSeconds((prev) => prev + 1);
      }, 1000);
    }
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isTracking]);

  const fetchTasks = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('tasks')
        .select('id, title')
        .eq('project_id', projectId)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
      
      if (error) throw error;
      setTasks(data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const fetchTotalHours = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .select('hours')
        .eq('project_id', projectId);
      
      if (error) throw error;
      const total = data?.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.hours || 0), 0) || 0;
      setTotalHours(total);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const fetchTodayHours = async () => {
    try {
      const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .select('hours')
        .eq('project_id', projectId)
        .gte('start_time', today);
      
      if (error) throw error;
      const total = data?.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.hours || 0), 0) || 0;
      setTodayHours(total);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const fetchRecentEntries = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .select('*, tasks(title)')
        .eq('project_id', projectId)
        .order('start_time', { ascending: false })
        .limit(5);
      
      if (error) throw error;
      setRecentEntries(data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const checkActiveEntry = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .select('*')
        .eq('project_id', projectId)
        .is('end_time', null)
        .single();
      
      if (data) {
        setActiveEntryId(data.id);
        setSelectedTaskId(data.task_id);
        setIsTracking(true);
        const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(data.start_time).getTime()) / 1000);
        setSeconds(elapsed);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // No active entry
    }
  };

  const startTracking = async () => {
    try {
      const taskName = selectedTaskId 
        ? tasks.find(t => t.id === selectedTaskId)?.title 
        : projectName;
      
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .insert({
          project_id: projectId,
          task_id: selectedTaskId,
          start_time: new Date().toISOString(),
          description: `Working on ${taskName}`,
        })
        .select()
        .single();

      if (error) throw error;
      
      setActiveEntryId(data.id);
      setIsTracking(true);
      setSeconds(0);
      toast.success('Timer started');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to start timer');
    }
  };

  const stopTracking = async () => {
    if (!activeEntryId) return;
    
    try {
      const hours = seconds / 3600;
      
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .update({
          end_time: new Date().toISOString(),
          hours: parseFloat(hours.toFixed(2)),
        })
        .eq('id', activeEntryId);

      if (error) throw error;

      setIsTracking(false);
      setActiveEntryId(null);
      setSelectedTaskId(null);
      await fetchTotalHours();
      await fetchTodayHours();
      await fetchRecentEntries();
      toast.success(`Logged ${hours.toFixed(2)}h`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to stop timer');
    }
  };

  const deleteEntry = async (entryId: string) => {
    if (!confirm('Delete this time entry?')) return;
    
    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', entryId);

      if (error) throw error;

      await fetchTotalHours();
      await fetchTodayHours();
      await fetchRecentEntries();
      toast.success('Entry deleted');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to delete entry');
    }
  };

  const formatTime = (totalSeconds: number) => {
    const h = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
    const m = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
    const s = totalSeconds % 60;
    return `${h.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  return (
    <div className="card">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
        <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500/30 to-purple-600/30 border border-white/20">
          <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
        </div>
        <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Time Tracker</h3>
      </div>

      {/* Task Selector */}
      <div className="mb-4">
        <label className="form-label text-sm text-white/80 mb-2">Link to Task (Optional)</label>
        <select
          value={selectedTaskId || ''}
          onChange={(e) => setSelectedTaskId(e.target.value || null)}
          disabled={isTracking}
          className="form-control disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-base font-medium"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
            borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)',
            color: 'white',
          }}
        >
          <option value="" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1a202c', color: 'white' }}>
            Project-level tracking (no specific task)
          </option>
          {tasks.map((task) => (
            <option 
              key={task.id} 
              value={task.id}
              style={{ backgroundColor: '#1a202c', color: 'white' }}
            >
              {task.title}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </div>

      {/* Timer Display */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5 p-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-white/10 to-white/5 border border-white/20">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {isTracking && (
            <div className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-red-500 animate-pulse shadow-lg shadow-red-500/50"></div>
          )}
          <span className="font-mono text-4xl font-bold text-white tracking-wider">
            {formatTime(seconds)}
          </span>
        </div>
        
        <button
          onClick={isTracking ? stopTracking : startTracking}
          className={`p-3 rounded-xl transition-all transform hover:scale-105 ${
            isTracking
              ? 'bg-gradient-to-br from-red-500/30 to-red-600/30 hover:from-red-500/40 hover:to-red-600/40 border-2 border-red-500/50 shadow-lg shadow-red-500/30'
              : 'bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500/30 to-emerald-600/30 hover:from-green-500/40 hover:to-emerald-600/40 border-2 border-green-500/50 shadow-lg shadow-green-500/30'
          }`}
          title={isTracking ? 'Stop Timer' : 'Start Timer'}
        >
          {isTracking ? (
            <Square className="w-6 h-6 text-red-300 fill-red-300" />
          ) : (
            <Play className="w-6 h-6 text-green-300 fill-green-300" />
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-5">
        <div className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500/20 to-cyan-500/20 p-4 border border-white/20">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-white/70 mb-1 uppercase tracking-wide">Today</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{todayHours.toFixed(1)}h</div>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-500/20 to-pink-500/20 p-4 border border-white/20">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-white/70 mb-1 uppercase tracking-wide">Total</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{totalHours.toFixed(1)}h</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Recent Entries */}
      <div>
        <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white mb-3 uppercase tracking-wide">Recent Entries</h4>
        <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[220px] overflow-y-auto pr-1 custom-scrollbar">
          {recentEntries.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-white/50 py-4 text-center">No entries yet</p>
          ) : (
            recentEntries.map((entry: any) => (
              <div
                key={entry.id}
                className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-white/10 to-white/5 p-3 border border-white/20 hover:from-white/15 hover:to-white/10 transition-all group"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white">
                      {entry.hours ? `${entry.hours.toFixed(2)}h` : 'In progress...'}
                    </span>
                    {entry.tasks && (
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-purple-200 bg-purple-500/30 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-purple-400/30">
                        {entry.tasks.title}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-white/60">
                      {new Date(entry.start_time).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => deleteEntry(entry.id)}
                      className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 p-1.5 hover:bg-red-500/30 rounded-lg transition-all border border-transparent hover:border-red-400/30"
                      title="Delete"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-300" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {entry.description && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-white/70 truncate font-medium">{entry.description}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Custom Scrollbar Styles */}
      <style jsx>{`
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
          width: 6px;
        }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
          background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
          border-radius: 10px;
        }

          border-radius: 10px;
```

### **2. Enhanced TaskSection.tsx**

```typescript
"use client";

import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { Task } from '@/types';
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { CheckCircle2, Circle, Trash2, Plus, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Clock } from 'lucide-react';

export default function TaskSection({ projectId, tasks }: { projectId: string, tasks: Task[] }) {
  const [taskList, setTaskList] = useState<Task[]>(tasks);
  const [newTaskInput, setNewTaskInput] = useState('');
  const [showCompleted, setShowCompleted] = useState(false);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  const [taskHours, setTaskHours] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTaskHours();
  }, [projectId, taskList]);

  const fetchTaskHours = async () => {
    try {
      const taskIds = taskList.map(t => t.id);
      if (taskIds.length === 0) return;

      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .select('task_id, hours')
        .in('task_id', taskIds)
        .not('task_id', 'is', null);
      
      if (error) throw error;

      // Aggregate hours by task_id
      const hoursMap: Record<string, number> = {};
      data?.forEach((entry) => {
        if (entry.task_id) {
          hoursMap[entry.task_id] = (hoursMap[entry.task_id] || 0) + (entry.hours || 0);
        }
      });

      setTaskHours(hoursMap);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error fetching task hours:', err);
    }
  };

  const pendingTasks = taskList.filter(t => t.status === 'pending');
  const completedTasks = taskList.filter(t => t.status === 'completed');
  const completionPercentage = taskList.length > 0 
    ? Math.round((completedTasks.length / taskList.length) * 100) 
    : 0;

  const handleAddTask = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newTaskInput.trim()) return;

    setAdding(true);
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('tasks')
        .insert({
          project_id: projectId,
          title: newTaskInput.trim(),
          status: 'pending',
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .select()
        .single();

      if (error) throw error;
      if (data) {
        setTaskList([...taskList, data]);
        setNewTaskInput('');
        toast.success('Task added!');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error adding task:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to add task');
    }
    setAdding(false);
  };

  const handleToggleTask = async (task: Task) => {
    const newStatus = task.status === 'completed' ? 'pending' : 'completed';
    
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('tasks')
        .update({ status: newStatus, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
        .eq('id', task.id)
        .select()
        .single();

      if (error) throw error;
      if (data) {
        setTaskList(taskList.map(t => t.id === task.id ? data : t));
        toast.success(newStatus === 'completed' ? 'Task completed! 🎉' : 'Task reopened');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating task:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to update task');
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteTask = async (taskId: string) => {
    if (!confirm('Delete this task? This will also delete all associated time entries.')) return;

    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('tasks')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', taskId);

      if (error) throw error;
      setTaskList(taskList.filter(t => t.id !== taskId));
      toast.success('Task deleted');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error deleting task:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to delete task');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="card">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500/30 to-emerald-600/30 border border-white/20">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Tasks</h3>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white/70">
              {completedTasks.length} of {taskList.length} completed
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {/* Progress Circle */}
        <div className="relative w-16 h-16">
          <svg className="w-16 h-16 transform -rotate-90">
            <circle
              cx="32"
              cy="32"
              r="28"
              stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.15)"
              strokeWidth="5"
              fill="none"
            />
            <circle
              cx="32"
              cy="32"
              r="28"
              stroke="url(#gradient)"
              strokeWidth="5"
              fill="none"
              strokeDasharray={`${2 * Math.PI * 28}`}
              strokeDashoffset={`${2 * Math.PI * 28 * (1 - completionPercentage / 100)}`}
              strokeLinecap="round"
              className="transition-all duration-500"
            />
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id="gradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
                <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#10b981" />
                <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#34d399" />
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>
          </svg>
          <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
            <span className="text-white font-bold text-base">{completionPercentage}%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Add Task Form */}
      <form onSubmit={handleAddTask} className="mb-6">
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={newTaskInput}
              onChange={(e) => setNewTaskInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Add new task..."
              className="form-control pl-11 text-base font-medium"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)',
                color: 'white',
              }}
            />
            <Plus className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-5 h-5 text-white/60" />
          </div>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={!newTaskInput.trim() || adding}
            className="btn btn--success px-6 py-3 text-base font-semibold disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transform hover:scale-105 transition-transform"
          >
            {adding ? 'Adding...' : 'Add'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      {/* Pending Tasks */}
      {pendingTasks.length > 0 ? (
        <ul className="space-y-2.5 mb-5">
          {pendingTasks.map((task) => (
            <li
              key={task.id}
              className="group flex items-center gap-3 p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-white/10 to-white/5 border border-white/20 hover:from-white/15 hover:to-white/10 transition-all"
            >
              <button
                onClick={() => handleToggleTask(task)}
                className="flex-shrink-0 p-1 hover:bg-white/15 rounded-lg transition-colors"
              >
                <Circle className="w-6 h-6 text-white/70 hover:text-green-400 transition-colors" />
              </button>
              
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <span className="text-base font-semibold text-white block">{task.title}</span>
                {taskHours[task.id] && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-300" />
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-blue-200">
                      {taskHours[task.id].toFixed(1)}h logged
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              
              <button
                onClick={() => handleDeleteTask(task.id)}
                className="flex-shrink-0 p-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 hover:bg-red-500/30 rounded-lg transition-all border border-transparent hover:border-red-400/30"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4 text-red-300" />
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : (
        <div className="text-center py-8 mb-5">
          <Circle className="w-12 h-12 text-white/30 mx-auto mb-3" />
          <p className="text-white/50 text-sm font-medium">No pending tasks</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Completed Tasks Toggle */}
      {completedTasks.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowCompleted(!showCompleted)}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-white/70 hover:text-white text-sm font-bold mb-3 transition-colors uppercase tracking-wide"
          >
            {showCompleted ? (
              <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />
            ) : (
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            )}
            Completed Tasks ({completedTasks.length})
          </button>

          {showCompleted && (
            <ul className="space-y-2.5">
              {completedTasks.map((task) => (
                <li
                  key={task.id}
                  className="group flex items-center gap-3 p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500/15 to-emerald-500/15 border border-green-500/30 opacity-80 hover:opacity-100 transition-all"
                >
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleToggleTask(task)}
                    className="flex-shrink-0 p-1 hover:bg-white/15 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                  >
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-6 h-6 text-green-400" />
                  </button>
                  
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <span className="text-base font-semibold text-white/80 line-through block">{task.title}</span>
                    {taskHours[task.id] && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                        <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-300" />
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-green-200">
                          {taskHours[task.id].toFixed(1)}h logged
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleDeleteTask(task.id)}
                    className="flex-shrink-0 p-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 hover:bg-red-500/30 rounded-lg transition-all border border-transparent hover:border-red-400/30"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4 text-red-300" />
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Empty State */}
      {taskList.length === 0 && (
        <div className="text-center py-12">
          <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500/30 to-emerald-600/30 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4 border border-white/20">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-10 h-10 text-white/70" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-white/80 text-base mb-2 font-bold">No tasks yet</p>
          <p className="text-white/50 text-sm font-medium">Add your first task to get started</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## **Key Improvements:**

### **1. Time Tracking Integration**

- ✅ TimeTracker properly saves `task_id` when a task is selected
- ✅ Workers can choose to track time at project-level OR task-level
- ✅ Recent entries show which task time was logged against
- ✅ TaskSection fetches and displays hours logged per task


### **2. Fixed Database Field Issue**

- ✅ Changed from `description` to `title` (matches your Supabase schema)
- ✅ All queries now use the correct field name


### **3. Improved Visibility \& Contrast**

- ✅ Stronger colors with better contrast ratios
- ✅ Bolder fonts (font-bold, font-semibold)
- ✅ Better glassmorphic effects with enhanced borders
- ✅ Time badges with clear icons and backgrounds
- ✅ Improved hover states with scale transforms
- ✅ Custom scrollbar styling for Recent Entries


### **4. Visual Enhancements**

- ✅ Task time display with Clock icon
- ✅ Gradient backgrounds for better visual hierarchy
- ✅ Enhanced button states (Start/Stop timer)
- ✅ Animated pulse for active tracking
- ✅ Better spacing and typography
- ✅ Maintains your existing glassmorphic aesthetic

***

## **How It Works:**

1. **Starting Timer:**
    - Worker selects a task (optional) from dropdown
    - Clicks Play button
    - `time_entries` record created with `task_id` (if selected)
2. **Stopping Timer:**
    - Calculates hours worked
    - Updates `time_entries` with `end_time` and `hours`
    - Refreshes all stats and task hours
3. **Task Display:**
    - Each task shows total hours logged against it
    - Fetched by summing all `time_entries` where `task_id` matches
    - Updates in real-time when timer stops

## **Complete TimeTracker.tsx**

**File location:** `src/components/TimeTracker.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Clock, Play, Square, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface TimeTrackerProps {
  projectId: string;
  projectName?: string;
}

interface Task {
  id: string;
  description: string;
}

export default function TimeTracker({ projectId, projectName = 'Project' }: TimeTrackerProps) {
  const [isTracking, setIsTracking] = useState(false);
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [activeEntryId, setActiveEntryId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedTaskId, setSelectedTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [totalHours, setTotalHours] = useState(0);
  const [todayHours, setTodayHours] = useState(0);
  const [recentEntries, setRecentEntries] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<Task[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTasks();
    fetchTotalHours();
    fetchTodayHours();
    fetchRecentEntries();
    checkActiveEntry();
  }, [projectId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let interval: NodeJS.Timeout;
    if (isTracking) {
      interval = setInterval(() => {
        setSeconds((prev) => prev + 1);
      }, 1000);
    }
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isTracking]);

  const fetchTasks = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('tasks')
        .select('id, description')
        .eq('project_id', projectId)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
      
      if (error) throw error;
      setTasks(data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const fetchTotalHours = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .select('hours')
        .eq('project_id', projectId);
      
      if (error) throw error;
      const total = data?.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.hours || 0), 0) || 0;
      setTotalHours(total);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const fetchTodayHours = async () => {
    try {
      const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[^8_0];
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .select('hours')
        .eq('project_id', projectId)
        .gte('start_time', today);
      
      if (error) throw error;
      const total = data?.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.hours || 0), 0) || 0;
      setTodayHours(total);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const fetchRecentEntries = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .select('*, tasks(description)')
        .eq('project_id', projectId)
        .order('start_time', { ascending: false })
        .limit(5);
      
      if (error) throw error;
      setRecentEntries(data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const checkActiveEntry = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .select('*')
        .eq('project_id', projectId)
        .is('end_time', null)
        .single();
      
      if (data) {
        setActiveEntryId(data.id);
        setSelectedTaskId(data.task_id);
        setIsTracking(true);
        const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(data.start_time).getTime()) / 1000);
        setSeconds(elapsed);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // No active entry
    }
  };

  const startTracking = async () => {
    try {
      const taskName = selectedTaskId 
        ? tasks.find(t => t.id === selectedTaskId)?.description 
        : projectName;
      
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .insert({
          project_id: projectId,
          task_id: selectedTaskId,
          start_time: new Date().toISOString(),
          description: `Working on ${taskName}`,
        })
        .select()
        .single();

      if (error) throw error;
      
      setActiveEntryId(data.id);
      setIsTracking(true);
      setSeconds(0);
      toast.success('Timer started');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to start timer');
    }
  };

  const stopTracking = async () => {
    if (!activeEntryId) return;
    
    try {
      const hours = seconds / 3600;
      
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .update({
          end_time: new Date().toISOString(),
          hours: parseFloat(hours.toFixed(2)),
        })
        .eq('id', activeEntryId);

      if (error) throw error;

      setIsTracking(false);
      setActiveEntryId(null);
      setSelectedTaskId(null);
      await fetchTotalHours();
      await fetchTodayHours();
      await fetchRecentEntries();
      toast.success(`Logged ${hours.toFixed(2)}h`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to stop timer');
    }
  };

  const deleteEntry = async (entryId: string) => {
    if (!confirm('Delete this time entry?')) return;
    
    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', entryId);

      if (error) throw error;

      await fetchTotalHours();
      await fetchTodayHours();
      await fetchRecentEntries();
      toast.success('Entry deleted');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to delete entry');
    }
  };

  const formatTime = (totalSeconds: number) => {
    const h = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
    const m = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
    const s = totalSeconds % 60;
    return `${h.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  return (
    <div className="card">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
        <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500/30 to-purple-600/30 border border-white/20">
          <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
        </div>
        <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Time Tracker</h3>
      </div>

      {/* Task Selector */}
      <div className="mb-4">
        <label className="form-label text-sm text-white/80 mb-2">Link to Task (Optional)</label>
        <select
          value={selectedTaskId || ''}
          onChange={(e) => setSelectedTaskId(e.target.value || null)}
          disabled={isTracking}
          className="form-control disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-base font-medium"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
            borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)',
            color: 'white',
          }}
        >
          <option value="" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1a202c', color: 'white' }}>
            Project-level tracking (no specific task)
          </option>
          {tasks.map((task) => (
            <option 
              key={task.id} 
              value={task.id}
              style={{ backgroundColor: '#1a202c', color: 'white' }}
            >
              {task.description}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </div>

      {/* Timer Display */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5 p-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-white/10 to-white/5 border border-white/20">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {isTracking && (
            <div className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-red-500 animate-pulse shadow-lg shadow-red-500/50"></div>
          )}
          <span className="font-mono text-4xl font-bold text-white tracking-wider">
            {formatTime(seconds)}
          </span>
        </div>
        
        <button
          onClick={isTracking ? stopTracking : startTracking}
          className={`p-3 rounded-xl transition-all transform hover:scale-105 ${
            isTracking
              ? 'bg-gradient-to-br from-red-500/30 to-red-600/30 hover:from-red-500/40 hover:to-red-600/40 border-2 border-red-500/50 shadow-lg shadow-red-500/30'
              : 'bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500/30 to-emerald-600/30 hover:from-green-500/40 hover:to-emerald-600/40 border-2 border-green-500/50 shadow-lg shadow-green-500/30'
          }`}
          title={isTracking ? 'Stop Timer' : 'Start Timer'}
        >
          {isTracking ? (
            <Square className="w-6 h-6 text-red-300 fill-red-300" />
          ) : (
            <Play className="w-6 h-6 text-green-300 fill-green-300" />
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-5">
        <div className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500/20 to-cyan-500/20 p-4 border border-white/20">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-white/70 mb-1 uppercase tracking-wide">Today</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{todayHours.toFixed(1)}h</div>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-500/20 to-pink-500/20 p-4 border border-white/20">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-white/70 mb-1 uppercase tracking-wide">Total</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{totalHours.toFixed(1)}h</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Recent Entries */}
      <div>
        <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white mb-3 uppercase tracking-wide">Recent Entries</h4>
        <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[220px] overflow-y-auto pr-1 custom-scrollbar">
          {recentEntries.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-white/50 py-4 text-center">No entries yet</p>
          ) : (
            recentEntries.map((entry: any) => (
              <div
                key={entry.id}
                className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-white/10 to-white/5 p-3 border border-white/20 hover:from-white/15 hover:to-white/10 transition-all group"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white">
                      {entry.hours ? `${entry.hours.toFixed(2)}h` : 'In progress...'}
                    </span>
                    {entry.tasks && (
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-purple-200 bg-purple-500/30 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-purple-400/30">
                        {entry.tasks.description}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-white/60">
                      {new Date(entry.start_time).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => deleteEntry(entry.id)}
                      className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 p-1.5 hover:bg-red-500/30 rounded-lg transition-all border border-transparent hover:border-red-400/30"
                      title="Delete"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-300" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {entry.description && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-white/70 truncate font-medium">{entry.description}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Custom Scrollbar Styles */}
      <style jsx>{`
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
          width: 6px;
        }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
          background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
          border-radius: 10px;
        }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {

          border-radius: 10px;
        }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
          background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}
```

**File location:** `src/app/projects/[id]/TaskSection.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { Task } from '@/types';
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { CheckCircle2, Circle, Trash2, Plus, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Clock } from 'lucide-react';

export default function TaskSection({ projectId, tasks }: { projectId: string, tasks: Task[] }) {
  const [taskList, setTaskList] = useState<Task[]>(tasks);
  const [newTaskInput, setNewTaskInput] = useState('');
  const [showCompleted, setShowCompleted] = useState(false);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  const [taskHours, setTaskHours] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTaskHours();
  }, [projectId, taskList]);

  const fetchTaskHours = async () => {
    try {
      const taskIds = taskList.map(t => t.id);
      if (taskIds.length === 0) return;

      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .select('task_id, hours')
        .in('task_id', taskIds)
        .not('task_id', 'is', null);
      
      if (error) throw error;

      // Aggregate hours by task_id
      const hoursMap: Record<string, number> = {};
      data?.forEach((entry) => {
        if (entry.task_id) {
          hoursMap[entry.task_id] = (hoursMap[entry.task_id] || 0) + (entry.hours || 0);
        }
      });

      setTaskHours(hoursMap);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error fetching task hours:', err);
    }
  };

  const pendingTasks = taskList.filter(t => t.status === 'pending');
  const completedTasks = taskList.filter(t => t.status === 'completed');
  const completionPercentage = taskList.length > 0 
    ? Math.round((completedTasks.length / taskList.length) * 100) 
    : 0;

  const handleAddTask = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newTaskInput.trim()) return;

    setAdding(true);
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('tasks')
        .insert({
          project_id: projectId,
          description: newTaskInput.trim(),
          status: 'pending',
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .select()
        .single();

      if (error) throw error;
      if (data) {
        setTaskList([...taskList, data]);
        setNewTaskInput('');
        toast.success('Task added!');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error adding task:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to add task');
    }
    setAdding(false);
  };

  const handleToggleTask = async (task: Task) => {
    const newStatus = task.status === 'completed' ? 'pending' : 'completed';
    
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('tasks')
        .update({ status: newStatus, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
        .eq('id', task.id)
        .select()
        .single();

      if (error) throw error;
      if (data) {
        setTaskList(taskList.map(t => t.id === task.id ? data : t));
        toast.success(newStatus === 'completed' ? 'Task completed! 🎉' : 'Task reopened');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating task:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to update task');
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteTask = async (taskId: string) => {
    if (!confirm('Delete this task? This will also delete all associated time entries.')) return;

    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('tasks')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', taskId);

      if (error) throw error;
      setTaskList(taskList.filter(t => t.id !== taskId));
      toast.success('Task deleted');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error deleting task:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to delete task');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="card">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500/30 to-emerald-600/30 border border-white/20">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Tasks</h3>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white/70">
              {completedTasks.length} of {taskList.length} completed
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {/* Progress Circle */}
        <div className="relative w-16 h-16">
          <svg className="w-16 h-16 transform -rotate-90">
            <circle
              cx="32"
              cy="32"
              r="28"
              stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.15)"
              strokeWidth="5"
              fill="none"
            />
            <circle
              cx="32"
              cy="32"
              r="28"
              stroke="url(#gradient)"
              strokeWidth="5"
              fill="none"
              strokeDasharray={`${2 * Math.PI * 28}`}
              strokeDashoffset={`${2 * Math.PI * 28 * (1 - completionPercentage / 100)}`}
              strokeLinecap="round"
              className="transition-all duration-500"
            />
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id="gradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
                <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#10b981" />
                <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#34d399" />
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>
          </svg>
          <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
            <span className="text-white font-bold text-base">{completionPercentage}%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Add Task Form */}
      <form onSubmit={handleAddTask} className="mb-6">
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={newTaskInput}
              onChange={(e) => setNewTaskInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Add new task..."
              className="form-control pl-11 text-base font-medium"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)',
                color: 'white',
              }}
            />
            <Plus className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-5 h-5 text-white/60" />
          </div>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={!newTaskInput.trim() || adding}
            className="btn btn--success px-6 py-3 text-base font-semibold disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transform hover:scale-105 transition-transform"
          >
            {adding ? 'Adding...' : 'Add'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      {/* Pending Tasks */}
      {pendingTasks.length > 0 ? (
        <ul className="space-y-2.5 mb-5">
          {pendingTasks.map((task) => (
            <li
              key={task.id}
              className="group flex items-center gap-3 p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-white/10 to-white/5 border border-white/20 hover:from-white/15 hover:to-white/10 transition-all"
            >
              <button
                onClick={() => handleToggleTask(task)}
                className="flex-shrink-0 p-1 hover:bg-white/15 rounded-lg transition-colors"
              >
                <Circle className="w-6 h-6 text-white/70 hover:text-green-400 transition-colors" />
              </button>
              
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <span className="text-base font-semibold text-white block">{task.description}</span>
                {taskHours[task.id] && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-300" />
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-blue-200">
                      {taskHours[task.id].toFixed(1)}h logged
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              
              <button
                onClick={() => handleDeleteTask(task.id)}
                className="flex-shrink-0 p-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 hover:bg-red-500/30 rounded-lg transition-all border border-transparent hover:border-red-400/30"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4 text-red-300" />
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : (
        <div className="text-center py-8 mb-5">
          <Circle className="w-12 h-12 text-white/30 mx-auto mb-3" />
          <p className="text-white/50 text-sm font-medium">No pending tasks</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Completed Tasks Toggle */}
      {completedTasks.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowCompleted(!showCompleted)}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-white/70 hover:text-white text-sm font-bold mb-3 transition-colors uppercase tracking-wide"
          >
            {showCompleted ? (
              <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />
            ) : (
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            )}
            Completed Tasks ({completedTasks.length})
          </button>

          {showCompleted && (
            <ul className="space-y-2.5">
              {completedTasks.map((task) => (
                <li
                  key={task.id}
                  className="group flex items-center gap-3 p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500/15 to-emerald-500/15 border border-green-500/30 opacity-80 hover:opacity-100 transition-all"
                >
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleToggleTask(task)}
                    className="flex-shrink-0 p-1 hover:bg-white/15 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                  >
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-6 h-6 text-green-400" />
                  </button>
                  
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <span className="text-base font-semibold text-white/80 line-through block">{task.description}</span>
                    {taskHours[task.id] && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                        <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-300" />
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-green-200">
                          {taskHours[task.id].toFixed(1)}h logged
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleDeleteTask(task.id)}
                    className="flex-shrink-0 p-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 hover:bg-red-500/30 rounded-lg transition-all border border-transparent hover:border-red-400/30"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4 text-red-300" />
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Empty State */}
      {taskList.length === 0 && (
        <div className="text-center py-12">
          <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500/30 to-emerald-600/30 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4 border border-white/20">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-10 h-10 text-white/70" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-white/80 text-base mb-2 font-bold">No tasks yet</p>
          <p className="text-white/50 text-sm font-medium">Add your first task to get started</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
