```typescript
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Clock, Play, Square, Trash2, Plus, Edit2, X } from 'lucide-react';

interface TimeTrackerProps {
  projectId: string;
  projectName?: string;
}

interface Task {
  id: string;
  description: string;
}

interface TimeEntry {
  id: string;
  start_time: string;
  end_time: string | null;
  hours: number | null;
  description: string | null;
  task_id: string | null;
  tasks?: { description: string } | null;
}

export default function TimeTracker({ projectId, projectName = 'Project' }: TimeTrackerProps) {
  const [isTracking, setIsTracking] = useState(false);
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [activeEntryId, setActiveEntryId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedTaskId, setSelectedTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [totalHours, setTotalHours] = useState(0);
  const [todayHours, setTodayHours] = useState(0);
  const [recentEntries, setRecentEntries] = useState<TimeEntry[]>([]);
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<Task[]>([]);
  
  // Manual entry & edit states
  const [showManualEntry, setShowManualEntry] = useState(false);
  const [manualHours, setManualHours] = useState('');
  const [manualTaskId, setManualTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [manualDescription, setManualDescription] = useState('');
  
  // Edit entry states
  const [editingEntryId, setEditingEntryId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editHours, setEditHours] = useState('');
  const [editTaskId, setEditTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editDescription, setEditDescription] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTasks();
    fetchTotalHours();
    fetchTodayHours();
    fetchRecentEntries();
    checkActiveEntry();
  }, [projectId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let interval: NodeJS.Timeout;
    if (isTracking) {
      interval = setInterval(() => {
        setSeconds((prev) => prev + 1);
      }, 1000);
    }
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isTracking]);

  const fetchTasks = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('tasks')
        .select('id, description')
        .eq('project_id', projectId)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
      
      if (error) throw error;
      setTasks(data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const fetchTotalHours = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .select('hours')
        .eq('project_id', projectId)
        .not('hours', 'is', null);
      
      if (error) throw error;
      const total = data?.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.hours || 0), 0) || 0;
      setTotalHours(total);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const fetchTodayHours = async () => {
    try {
      const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .select('hours')
        .eq('project_id', projectId)
        .gte('start_time', today)
        .not('hours', 'is', null);
      
      if (error) throw error;
      const total = data?.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.hours || 0), 0) || 0;
      setTodayHours(total);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const fetchRecentEntries = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .select('*, tasks(description)')
        .eq('project_id', projectId)
        .order('start_time', { ascending: false })
        .limit(5);
      
      if (error) throw error;
      setRecentEntries(data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const checkActiveEntry = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .select('*')
        .eq('project_id', projectId)
        .is('end_time', null)
        .single();
      
      if (data) {
        setActiveEntryId(data.id);
        setSelectedTaskId(data.task_id);
        setIsTracking(true);
        const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(data.start_time).getTime()) / 1000);
        setSeconds(elapsed);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // No active entry
    }
  };

  const startTracking = async () => {
    try {
      const taskName = selectedTaskId 
        ? tasks.find(t => t.id === selectedTaskId)?.description 
        : projectName;
      
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .insert({
          project_id: projectId,
          task_id: selectedTaskId,
          start_time: new Date().toISOString(),
          description: `Working on ${taskName}`,
        })
        .select()
        .single();

      if (error) throw error;
      
      setActiveEntryId(data.id);
      setIsTracking(true);
      setSeconds(0);
      toast.success('Timer started');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to start timer');
    }
  };

  const stopTracking = async () => {
    if (!activeEntryId) return;
    
    try {
      const hours = seconds / 3600;
      
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .update({
          end_time: new Date().toISOString(),
          hours: parseFloat(hours.toFixed(2)),
        })
        .eq('id', activeEntryId);

      if (error) throw error;

      setIsTracking(false);
      setActiveEntryId(null);
      setSelectedTaskId(null);
      await fetchTotalHours();
      await fetchTodayHours();
      await fetchRecentEntries();
      
      // Trigger custom event for TaskSection to refresh
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('timeEntryUpdated'));
      
      toast.success(`Logged ${hours.toFixed(2)}h`);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to stop timer');
    }
  };

  const handleManualEntry = async () => {
    const hours = parseFloat(manualHours);
    if (isNaN(hours) || hours <= 0) {
      toast.error('Please enter valid hours');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const now = new Date();
      const startTime = new Date(now.getTime() - hours * 3600000);

      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .insert({
          project_id: projectId,
          task_id: manualTaskId,
          start_time: startTime.toISOString(),
          end_time: now.toISOString(),
          hours: hours,
          description: manualDescription || 'Manual entry',
        });

      if (error) throw error;

      await fetchTotalHours();
      await fetchTodayHours();
      await fetchRecentEntries();
      
      // Trigger refresh
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('timeEntryUpdated'));

      setShowManualEntry(false);
      setManualHours('');
      setManualTaskId(null);
      setManualDescription('');
      toast.success('Time entry added');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to add entry');
    }
  };

  const startEditEntry = (entry: TimeEntry) => {
    setEditingEntryId(entry.id);
    setEditHours(entry.hours?.toString() || '');
    setEditTaskId(entry.task_id);
    setEditDescription(entry.description || '');
  };

  const saveEditEntry = async (entryId: string) => {
    const hours = parseFloat(editHours);
    if (isNaN(hours) || hours <= 0) {
      toast.error('Please enter valid hours');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .update({
          hours: hours,
          task_id: editTaskId,
          description: editDescription || null,
        })
        .eq('id', entryId);

      if (error) throw error;

      await fetchTotalHours();
      await fetchTodayHours();
      await fetchRecentEntries();
      
      // Trigger refresh
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('timeEntryUpdated'));

      setEditingEntryId(null);
      toast.success('Entry updated');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to update entry');
    }
  };

  const cancelEdit = () => {
    setEditingEntryId(null);
    setEditHours('');
    setEditTaskId(null);
    setEditDescription('');
  };

  const deleteEntry = async (entryId: string) => {
    if (!confirm('Delete this time entry?')) return;
    
    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('time_entries')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', entryId);

      if (error) throw error;

      await fetchTotalHours();
      await fetchTodayHours();
      await fetchRecentEntries();
      
      // Trigger refresh
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('timeEntryUpdated'));
      
      toast.success('Entry deleted');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error('Failed to delete entry');
    }
  };

  const formatTime = (totalSeconds: number) => {
    const h = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
    const m = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
    const s = totalSeconds % 60;
    return `${h.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  return (
    <div className="card">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500/30 to-purple-600/30 border border-white/20">
            <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Time Tracker</h3>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowManualEntry(!showManualEntry)}
          className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-green-500/20 hover:bg-green-500/30 border border-green-500/30 transition-all"
          title="Add Manual Entry"
        >
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-green-300" />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Manual Entry Form */}
      {showManualEntry && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-white/10 to-white/5 border border-white/20">
          <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white mb-3">Add Manual Time Entry</h4>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div>
              <label className="text-xs text-white/70 mb-1 block">Hours</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                step="0.1"
                value={manualHours}
                onChange={(e) => setManualHours(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g., 2.5"
                className="form-control text-sm"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                  borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  color: 'white',
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="text-xs text-white/70 mb-1 block">Task (Optional)</label>
              <select
                value={manualTaskId || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setManualTaskId(e.target.value || null)}
                className="form-control text-sm"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                  borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  color: 'white',
                }}
              >
                <option value="">No specific task</option>
                {tasks.map((task) => (
                  <option key={task.id} value={task.id} style={{ backgroundColor: '#1a202c' }}>
                    {task.description}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="text-xs text-white/70 mb-1 block">Description (Optional)</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={manualDescription}
                onChange={(e) => setManualDescription(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="What did you work on?"
                className="form-control text-sm"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                  borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  color: 'white',
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={handleManualEntry}
                className="flex-1 py-2 px-4 rounded-lg bg-green-500/30 hover:bg-green-500/40 border border-green-500/50 text-white font-medium text-sm transition-all"
              >
                Add Entry
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowManualEntry(false)}
                className="py-2 px-4 rounded-lg bg-red-500/30 hover:bg-red-500/40 border border-red-500/50 text-white font-medium text-sm transition-all"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Task Selector */}
      <div className="mb-4">
        <label className="form-label text-sm text-white/80 mb-2">Link to Task (Optional)</label>
        <select
          value={selectedTaskId || ''}
          onChange={(e) => setSelectedTaskId(e.target.value || null)}
          disabled={isTracking}
          className="form-control disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-base font-medium"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
            borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)',
            color: 'white',
          }}
        >
          <option value="" style={{ backgroundColor: '#1a202c', color: 'white' }}>
            Project-level tracking (no specific task)
          </option>
          {tasks.map((task) => (
            <option 
              key={task.id} 
              value={task.id}
              style={{ backgroundColor: '#1a202c', color: 'white' }}
            >
              {task.description}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </div>

      {/* Timer Display */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5 p-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-white/10 to-white/5 border border-white/20">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {isTracking && (
            <div className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-red-500 animate-pulse shadow-lg shadow-red-500/50"></div>
          )}
          <span className="font-mono text-4xl font-bold text-white tracking-wider">
            {formatTime(seconds)}
          </span>
        </div>
        
        <button
          onClick={isTracking ? stopTracking : startTracking}
          className={`p-3 rounded-xl transition-all transform hover:scale-105 ${
            isTracking
              ? 'bg-gradient-to-br from-red-500/30 to-red-600/30 hover:from-red-500/40 hover:to-red-600/40 border-2 border-red-500/50 shadow-lg shadow-red-500/30'
              : 'bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500/30 to-emerald-600/30 hover:from-green-500/40 hover:to-emerald-600/40 border-2 border-green-500/50 shadow-lg shadow-green-500/30'
          }`}
          title={isTracking ? 'Stop Timer' : 'Start Timer'}
        >
          {isTracking ? (
            <Square className="w-6 h-6 text-red-300 fill-red-300" />
          ) : (
            <Play className="w-6 h-6 text-green-300 fill-green-300" />
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-5">
        <div className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500/20 to-cyan-500/20 p-4 border border-white/20">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-white/70 mb-1 uppercase tracking-wide">Today</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{todayHours.toFixed(1)}h</div>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-500/20 to-pink-500/20 p-4 border border-white/20">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-white/70 mb-1 uppercase tracking-wide">Total</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{totalHours.toFixed(1)}h</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Recent Entries */}
      <div>
        <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white mb-3 uppercase tracking-wide">Recent Entries</h4>
        <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[300px] overflow-y-auto pr-1 custom-scrollbar">
          {recentEntries.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-white/50 py-4 text-center">No entries yet</p>
          ) : (
            recentEntries.map((entry: TimeEntry) => (
              <div
                key={entry.id}
                className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-white/10 to-white/5 p-3 border border-white/20 hover:from-white/15 hover:to-white/10 transition-all group"
              >
                {editingEntryId === entry.id ? (
                  // Edit Mode
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-xs text-white/70 block mb-1">Hours</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        step="0.1"
                        value={editHours}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditHours(e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full p-2 rounded-lg text-sm"
                        style={{
                          backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                          borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                          color: 'white',
                          border: '1px solid',
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-xs text-white/70 block mb-1">Task</label>
                      <select
                        value={editTaskId || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditTaskId(e.target.value || null)}
                        className="w-full p-2 rounded-lg text-sm"
                        style={{
                          backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                          borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                          color: 'white',
                          border: '1px solid',
                        }}
                      >
                        <option value="">No task</option>
                        {tasks.map((task) => (
                          <option key={task.id} value={task.id} style={{ backgroundColor: '#1a202c' }}>
                            {task.description}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex gap-2 mt-2">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => saveEditEntry(entry.id)}
                        className="flex-1 py-1.5 px-3 rounded-lg bg-green-500/30 hover:bg-green-500/40 border border-green-500/50 text-white text-xs font-medium"
                      >
                        Save
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={cancelEdit}
                        className="py-1.5 px-3 rounded-lg bg-red-500/30 hover:bg-red-500/40 border border-red-500/50 text-white text-xs font-medium"
                      >
                        <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  // View Mode
                  <>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white">
                          {entry.hours ? `${entry.hours.toFixed(2)}h` : 'In progress...'}
                        </span>
                        {entry.tasks && (
                          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-purple-200 bg-purple-500/30 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-purple-400/30">
                            {entry.tasks.description}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-white/60">
                          {new Date(entry.start_time).toLocaleDateString()}
                        </span>
                        {entry.hours && (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => startEditEntry(entry)}
                            className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 p-1.5 hover:bg-blue-500/30 rounded-lg transition-all border border-transparent hover:border-blue-400/30"
                            title="Edit"
                          >
                            <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-300" />
                          </button>
                        )}
                        <button
                          onClick={() => deleteEntry(entry.id)}
                          className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 p-1.5 hover:bg-red-500/30 rounded-lg transition-all border border-transparent hover:border-red-400/30"
                          title="Delete"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-300" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {entry.description && (
                      <p className="text-xs text-white/70 truncate font-medium">{entry.description}</p>
                    )}
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Custom Scrollbar Styles */}
      <style jsx>{`
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
          width: 6px;
        }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
          background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
          border-radius: 10px;
        }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
          background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
          border-radius: 10px;
        }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
          background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## **Change 3: Replace the `handleManualEntry` Function**

Find the `handleManualEntry` function and replace it with:

```typescript
const handleManualEntry = async () => {
  const hours = parseInt(manualHours || '0');
  const minutes = parseInt(manualMinutes || '0');
  
  if (hours === 0 && minutes === 0) {
    toast.error('Please enter at least some time');
    return;
  }

  const totalHours = hours + (minutes / 60);

  try {
    const now = new Date();
    const startTime = new Date(now.getTime() - totalHours * 3600000);

    const { error } = await supabaseClient
      .from('time_entries')
      .insert({
        project_id: projectId,
        task_id: manualTaskId,
        start_time: startTime.toISOString(),
        end_time: now.toISOString(),
        hours: parseFloat(totalHours.toFixed(2)),
        description: manualDescription || 'Manual entry',
      });

    if (error) throw error;

    await fetchTotalHours();
    await fetchTodayHours();
    await fetchRecentEntries();
    
    // Trigger refresh
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('timeEntryUpdated'));

    setShowManualEntry(false);
    setManualHours('');
    setManualMinutes('');
    setManualTaskId(null);
    setManualDescription('');
    toast.success('Time entry added');
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error(err);
    toast.error('Failed to add entry');
  }
};
```

## **Change 4: Add Helper Function for Time Formatting (add this near other helper functions)**

Add this function right after the `formatTime` function:

```typescript
const formatHoursToTime = (hours: number): string => {
  const h = Math.floor(hours);
  const m = Math.floor((hours - h) * 60);
  const s = Math.floor(((hours - h) * 60 - m) * 60);
  return `${h.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
};
```

```typescript
const formatHoursToTime = (hours: number): string => {
  const totalSeconds = Math.round(hours * 3600); // Round to avoid floating point errors
  const h = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
  const s = totalSeconds % 60;
```

### **🔄 WORKFLOW LOGIC**

#### **1. Project Creation Flow:**

```
User creates project:
├─ Fills basic info (name, client, deadline, budget)
├─ Selects Workflow Type (3D / 2D / Others)
├─ System fetches template tasks for that workflow
├─ User reviews tasks, adjusts estimated_hours if needed
└─ System auto-generates:
    ├─ All tasks with order_index
    ├─ Calculates priority_score = (budget / days_to_deadline)
    └─ Auto-schedules tasks based on:
        - Project deadline (work backwards)
        - Task dependencies (task 2 after task 1)
        - Estimated hours per task
        - Available working hours per day (8 hours default)
```


#### **2. Priority Score Calculation:**

```javascript
priority_score = (project.budget / days_remaining) * urgency_multiplier

Where:
- days_remaining = deadline - today
- urgency_multiplier:
  - < 7 days: 3x
  - 7-14 days: 2x
  - 14-30 days: 1.5x
  - > 30 days: 1x

Higher score = Higher priority
```


#### **3. Daily Task Scheduling Algorithm:**

```
For each active project:
├─ Get next incomplete task (by order_index)
├─ Check dependencies (previous task completed?)
├─ Calculate priority score
└─ Assign to daily plan based on:
    - Priority score (high to low)
    - Task estimated hours
    - Available capacity for the day
    - Material availability (if materials needed)
```

## **🤔 MY RECOMMENDATIONS \& CONCERNS**

### **✅ What Will Work Well:**

1. **Priority-based scheduling** - Simple formula, easy to understand
2. **Workflow templates** - Saves time, ensures consistency
3. **Material alerts** - Proactive, prevents delays
4. **Dependency tracking** - Ensures correct task sequence

### **⚠️ Potential Challenges:**

1. **Parallel tasks** - What if multiple tasks can be done simultaneously?
    - **Solution:** Add `can_parallel` boolean to tasks, schedule multiple per day
2. **Multiple workers** - What if you have 3 workers working on different projects?
    - **Solution:** Add `assigned_to` field (worker name/id), capacity per worker
3. **Client delays** - What if waiting for "client approval" blocks everything?
    - **Solution:** Mark tasks as `blocking` vs `non-blocking`, show blocked status
4. **Partial completion** - What if task is 50% done?
    - **Solution:** Add `progress_percentage` field, allow partial completion
5. **Urgent interruptions** - What if client calls with emergency?
    - **Solution:** Add "Insert Priority Task" button, bumps other tasks

# **🎨 SCULPTUREFLOW: THE COMPLETE VISION**

## **THE PROBLEM THEY FACE TODAY**

Imagine you're the sculptor. Every morning you wake up and think:

- "Which project should I work on today?"
- "Do I have enough bronze for the Temple Lion?"
- "Did I call that supplier about the clay?"
- "When is the client meeting for the Garden Relief?"
- "If I don't finish the brass work today, will I miss the deadline?"
- "I have 3 workers - who does what?"

**It's chaos. There's no system. It's all in your head or on paper.**

***

## **THE VISION: YOUR INTELLIGENT STUDIO ASSISTANT**

Think of this app as hiring a **smart project manager** who:

1. Knows every project, every deadline, every material
2. Plans your day intelligently
3. Warns you before problems happen
4. Adapts when things change
5. Keeps everyone on the same page

***

# **📱 HOW THE APP WORKS (SIMPLE WALKTHROUGH)**

## **SCENARIO 1: STARTING A NEW PROJECT**

### **What Happens:**

**Old Way (Chaos):**

```
Client calls → You write down details on paper → 
You mentally think "okay this needs moulding, casting, finishing..." → 
You forget some steps → Project gets messy
```

**New Way (SculptureFlow):**

**Step 1: Create Project**

- You open the app
- Click "New Project"
- Fill in simple details:
    - Client: "Rajesh Kumar"
    - Project: "Temple Lion Sculpture"
    - Type: Select "3D Work" (app knows this is a full sculpture)
    - Deadline: "Dec 15, 2025"
    - Budget: "₹2,00,000"

**Step 2: App Magic Happens**

- App says: "For 3D Work, here are the 22 standard steps"
- Shows list:

```
1. Scale up and take printout (4 hours)
2. Armature work (8 hours)
3. Jute layer (3 hours)
... and so on
```

- You review, adjust hours if needed
- Click "Create Project"

**Step 3: Auto-Scheduling**

- App calculates: "45 days till deadline"
- App knows: "Total work = 150 hours"
- App figures out: "Need to work ~3-4 hours per day on this"
- App creates a timeline automatically
- Shows you: "Start armature work on Nov 5"

**You're done. Project is planned. No thinking needed.**

### **Problem: You Couldn't Finish Today's Brass Wielding**

Maybe:

- Material didn't arrive
- Worker was sick
- Client changed their mind
- Took longer than expected

**What You Do:**

1. Tap the task
2. Click "Didn't Finish"
3. App asks: "When can you do this?"

4. App automatically:
    - Moves that task to new date
    - Pushes all dependent tasks forward
    - Recalculates priority
    - Shows updated tomorrow's plan

**You're still in control. App adapts to reality.**

### **2. 🔔 PROACTIVE ALERTS (Before Problems)**

```
🔍 Reason: Waiting client approval for 3 days
💡 Action: Send reminder to Rajesh Kumar
```


***

### **3. 📊 INTELLIGENT PRIORITIZATION**

**How App Decides Priority:**

**Formula (Simple):**

```
Priority Score = (Money You'll Earn Per Day) × (Urgency Factor)

Where:
- Money Per Day = Project Budget ÷ Days Left
- Urgency Factor = 
  - Less than 7 days: 3x multiplier
  - 7-14 days: 2x multiplier
  - More than 14 days: 1x multiplier
```

**Example:**

```
Temple Lion:
- Budget: ₹2,00,000
- Days Left: 5
- Per Day Value: ₹40,000
- Urgency: 3x (less than 7 days)
- PRIORITY SCORE: 120,000 🔥

Garden Relief:
- Budget: ₹1,50,000
- Days Left: 12
- Per Day Value: ₹12,500
- Urgency: 2x (7-14 days)
- PRIORITY SCORE: 25,000 📊

You work on Temple Lion first. Obvious.
```


***

**C. Bulk Reschedule (Emergency)**

- You click "Delay All Tasks"
- Entire project shifts forward
- All dates updated automatically

## **HOW THE SMART SCHEDULING WORKS**

### **The AI Scheduling Algorithm (Behind the Scenes):**

**Step 1: Gather All Available Tasks**

```
From ALL active projects, get:
- Tasks that are "next in sequence" (dependencies met)
- Tasks with available materials
- Tasks not waiting on client approval
```

**Step 2: Score Each Task**

```
For each task, calculate:
Score = (Project Priority × Task Urgency × Worker Availability)

Where:
- Project Priority = deadline proximity + budget value
- Task Urgency = is it blocking other tasks?
- Worker Availability = who can do this task?
```

**Step 3: Optimize Task Sequencing**

```
Consider:
✅ Can tasks run in parallel? (2 workers, 2 different projects)
✅ Are there waiting times? (glue drying, clay setting)
✅ Task dependencies within same day (do A before B)
✅ Worker skill match (complex vs simple tasks)
✅ Mental variety (alternate heavy/light tasks)
```

**Step 4: Create Time Blocks**

```
Morning: High-focus tasks (detailed work)
Afternoon: Medium-focus tasks
Late day: Prep/simple tasks for next day
```

***

## **WHY THIS MULTI-PROJECT APPROACH WORKS**

### **Benefits:**

1. **Efficient Use of Wait Times**
    - Glue drying? Work on another project
    - Material delay? Switch projects
    - No dead time
2. **Worker Coordination**
    - Everyone busy on different projects
    - No stepping on each other's toes
    - Clear who does what
3. **Mental Variety**
    - Alternate heavy/light work
    - Switch between creative/mechanical
    - Less burnout
4. **Risk Distribution**
    - One project blocked? Others continue
    - Balanced progress across all projects
    - No single point of failure
5. **Deadline Insurance**
    - Multiple projects move forward daily
    - Buffer time on each
    - If one slips, others cushion

# **📋 TASK TEMPLATE ESTIMATES - SCULPTURE WORKFLOWS**

## **🎨 3D WORK (Full Sculpture) - 22 Tasks**

| \# | Task Name | Work Time | Waiting/Drying Time | Can Delegate? | Skill Level | Notes |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **1** | Scale up and take printout | 2h | - | ✅ Yes | Basic | Quick task, can be done between others |
| **2** | Armature work | 8h | 2h (welding cool-down) | ⚠️ Semi-skilled | Medium | Metal framework, needs welding skills |
| **3** | Jute layer | 4h | **24h** (jute setting) | ✅ Yes | Basic | Apply jute + glue, must dry overnight |
| **4** | Prepare clay | 3h | - | ✅ Yes | Basic | Mixing, kneading clay to right consistency |
| **5** | Basic layer of clay | 6h | **12h** (initial setting) | ⚠️ Semi-skilled | Medium | First clay coating, needs to firm up |
| **6** | Detailing | 12h | - | ❌ Expert only | High | Artistic work, requires master sculptor |
| **7** | Client approval | - | **2-5 days** (wait) | N/A | N/A | Not a work task, blocked until client responds |
| **8** | Mould ready clay work | 4h | **24h** (full drying) | ⚠️ Semi-skilled | Medium | Final prep before moulding, must be bone dry |
| **9** | Moulding | 10h | **48h** (mould curing) | ❌ Skilled only | High | Creating plaster/silicone mould, technical |
| **10** | Casting in FRP | 8h | **24h** (FRP curing) | ⚠️ Semi-skilled | Medium | Fiberglass resin layering, chemical process |
| **11** | Finishing FRP | 6h | - | ⚠️ Semi-skilled | Medium | Sanding, smoothing FRP surface |
| **12** | Painting and lacquering | 4h | **6h** (drying between coats) | ✅ Yes | Basic | Base coat + lacquer, needs ventilation |
| **13** | Cutting FRP model | 5h | - | ⚠️ Semi-skilled | Medium | Precision cutting for brass sections |
| **14** | Brass casting | 10h | **12h** (cooling) | ❌ Skilled only | High | Hot metal work, dangerous, needs expertise |
| **15** | First level finishing | 6h | - | ⚠️ Semi-skilled | Medium | Initial brass smoothing and cleaning |
| **16** | Attaching brass pieces | 4h | - | ⚠️ Semi-skilled | Medium | Positioning brass on FRP body |
| **17** | Brass wielding | 6h | **2h** (cooling) | ❌ Skilled only | High | Welding brass pieces together |
| **18** | Grinding wielded portion | 4h | - | ⚠️ Semi-skilled | Medium | Smooth out weld seams |
| **19** | Sandblasting | 3h | - | ✅ Yes | Basic | Texture finish, messy but simple |
| **20** | Finishing touches/rewielding | 5h | **1h** (cool-down) | ❌ Expert only | High | Final perfection, touch-ups |
| **21** | Patina work | 3h | **12h** (chemical reaction) | ❌ Skilled only | High | Chemical treatment for color, timing critical |
| **22** | Sealing patina | 2h | **24h** (final cure) | ✅ Yes | Basic | Protective coating, final step |
|  | **TOTAL** | **115h work** | **~10-15 days waiting** |  |  | **Typical project: 20-30 calendar days** |


***

## **📊 KEY INSIGHTS \& PATTERNS**

### **🕐 Waiting Time Categories:**

**SHORT WAITS (Can work on other tasks same day):**

- Welding cool-down: 1-2h → Switch to clay work on another project
- Paint drying: 6h → Do prep work for tomorrow
- Brass cooling: 2h → Admin work or quick tasks

**OVERNIGHT WAITS (Next day continuation):**

- Jute setting: 12-24h → Work on different project today, return tomorrow
- Clay setting: 12-24h → Same project continues next day
- FRP curing: 24h → Schedule other projects for next day

**MULTI-DAY WAITS (Must schedule other work):**

- Mould curing: 48h → 2 days to work on other projects
- Client approval: 2-5 days → Plan accordingly, can't control timing

***

### **👥 Worker Skill Matrix:**

**✅ ANYONE CAN DO (Delegatable):**

- Printouts
- Clay preparation
- Jute layer application
- Sandblasting
- Painting base coats
- Sealing patina

**⚠️ SEMI-SKILLED (Need training):**

- Armature work (welding basics)
- Basic clay layering
- FRP casting
- FRP finishing
- Grinding

**❌ EXPERT ONLY (Master sculptor/specialist):**

- Artistic detailing
- Brass casting (dangerous)
- Brass welding
- Patina work (chemistry)
- Fine finishing touches

***

### **🎯 Scheduling Implications:**

**Tasks That Can Run Parallel:**

```
Project A: Jute drying (24h wait)
  → Work on Project B: Clay detailing
  → Work on Project C: Printouts

Project A: FRP curing (24h wait)  
  → Work on Project B: Armature work
  → Work on Project C: Brass grinding
```

**Tasks That Block Everything:**

```
❌ Client approval (2-5 days)
   → Cannot continue this project
   → MUST work on other projects
   → Flag this project as "BLOCKED"
```

**Tasks Best Done in Sequence (Same Day):**

```
Morning: Brass welding (6h)
  ↓ [2h cooling wait - do admin/breaks]
Afternoon: Grinding wielded portion (4h)
  ✅ Efficient use of day
```


***

### **💡 Smart Scheduling Suggestions:**

**MORNING TASKS (High Focus Needed):**

- Artistic detailing (requires concentration)
- Brass casting (dangerous, need alertness)
- Client meetings (fresh mind)

**AFTERNOON TASKS (Medium Focus):**

- FRP finishing (repetitive, lower risk)
- Clay preparation (physical work)
- Grinding/sanding (mechanical work)

**END OF DAY TASKS (Prep for Tomorrow):**

- Apply jute (let it dry overnight)
- Start FRP curing (cures overnight)
- Mix clay (ready for tomorrow)
- Painting (dries overnight)

**FILLER TASKS (15-30 min gaps):**

- Printouts
- Material inventory check
- Photo documentation
- Client follow-up calls

***

## **FIX 2: Create Projects/New Page**

Check if this file exists: `src/app/projects/new/page.tsx`

If it doesn't exist, create it:

**File:** `src/app/projects/new/page.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function NewProjectPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [clients, setClients] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    client_id: '',
    description: '',
    status: 'pending',
    deadline: '',
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchClients();
  }, []);

  const fetchClients = async () => {
    const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
      .from('clients')
      .select('id, name')
      .order('name');
    
    if (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to load clients');
    } else {
      setClients(data || []);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!formData.name || !formData.client_id) {
      toast.error('Please fill in required fields');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('projects')
        .insert([formData]);

      if (error) throw error;

      toast.success('Project created successfully!');
      router.push('/projects');
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to create project');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <div className="card">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6">Create New Project</h1>
          
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
            {/* Project Name */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label">Project Name *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.name}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
                placeholder="e.g., Temple Lion Sculpture"
                required
              />
            </div>

            {/* Client */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label">Client *</label>
              <select
                value={formData.client_id}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, client_id: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
                required
              >
                <option value="">Select a client</option>
                {clients.map((client) => (
                  <option key={client.id} value={client.id}>
                    {client.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Description */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label">Description</label>
              <textarea
                value={formData.description}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
                rows={4}
                placeholder="Project details..."
              />
            </div>

            {/* Status */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label">Status</label>
              <select
                value={formData.status}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, status: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
              >
                <option value="pending">Pending</option>
                <option value="in_progress">In Progress</option>
                <option value="completed">Completed</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Deadline */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label">Deadline</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={formData.deadline}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, deadline: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Buttons */}
            <div className="flex gap-4">
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="btn btn--primary flex-1"
              >
                Create Project
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => router.back()}
                className="btn btn--secondary"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function NewInvoicePage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    project_id: '',
    amount: '',
    payment_status: 'pending',
    issue_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    due_date: '',
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchProjects();
  }, []);

  const fetchProjects = async () => {
    const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
      .from('projects')
      .select('id, name')
      .order('name');
    
    if (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to load projects');
    } else {
      setProjects(data || []);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!formData.project_id || !formData.amount) {
      toast.error('Please fill in required fields');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('invoices')
        .insert([{
          ...formData,
          amount: parseFloat(formData.amount),
        }]);

      if (error) throw error;

      toast.success('Invoice created successfully!');
      router.push('/invoices');
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to create invoice');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <div className="card">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6">Create New Invoice</h1>
          
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
            {/* Project */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label">Project *</label>
              <select
                value={formData.project_id}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, project_id: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
                required
              >
                <option value="">Select a project</option>
                {projects.map((project) => (
                  <option key={project.id} value={project.id}>
                    {project.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Amount */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label">Amount *</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                step="0.01"
                value={formData.amount}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, amount: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
                placeholder="0.00"
                required
              />
            </div>

            {/* Payment Status */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label">Payment Status</label>
              <select
                value={formData.payment_status}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, payment_status: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
              >
                <option value="pending">Pending</option>
                <option value="paid">Paid</option>
                <option value="overdue">Overdue</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Issue Date */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label">Issue Date</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={formData.issue_date}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, issue_date: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Due Date */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label">Due Date</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={formData.due_date}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, due_date: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Buttons */}
            <div className="flex gap-4">
              <button type="submit" className="btn btn--primary flex-1">
                Create Invoice
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => router.back()}
                className="btn btn--secondary"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Perfect! I can see the issue now. **The invoices page has a fundamental problem** - it's marked as `"use client"` but it's using `async` function which is **server-side only**. You can't mix them in Next.js 13+.

Here are the corrected files:

***

## **FIX 1: Invoices Page (Complete Rewrite)**

**File:** `src/app/invoices/page.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import Link from 'next/link';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { formatCurrency, formatDate } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/Card';
import { Invoice, Project } from '@/types';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function InvoicesPage() {
    const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState<(Invoice & { project: Project })[]>([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

    useEffect(() => {
        fetchInvoices();
    }, []);

    const fetchInvoices = async () => {
        try {
            const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
                .from('invoices')
                .select('*, project:projects(name)')
                .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
            
            if (error) throw error;
            setInvoices(data as (Invoice & { project: Project })[]);
        } catch (error: any) {
            console.error(error);
            toast.error('Failed to fetch invoices');
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    };

    if (loading) {
        return (
            <div className="container py-6">
                <p>Loading invoices...</p>
            </div>
        );
    }

    return (
        <div className="container py-6">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
                <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">Invoices</h1>
                <Link href="/invoices/new" className="btn btn--primary">
                    New Invoice
                </Link>
            </div>
            {invoices.length === 0 ? (
                <Card className="mb-4">
                    <p className="text-text-secondary">No invoices found.</p>
                </Card>
            ) : (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                    <table className="min-w-full table-auto border rounded-lg">
                        <thead>
                            <tr className="bg-surface text-left">
                                <th className="px-4 py-2">Invoice #</th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-2">Project</th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-2">Amount</th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-2">Status</th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-2">Due Date</th>
                                <th className="px-4 py-2">Actions</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                            {invoices.map(inv => (
                                <tr key={inv.id} className="border-b">
                                    <td className="px-4 py-2 font-mono">{inv.invoice_number}</td>
                                    <td className="px-4 py-2">{inv.project?.name ?? '-'}</td>
                                    <td className="px-4 py-2">{formatCurrency(inv.amount)}</td>
                                    <td className="px-4 py-2">
                                        <span className={`badge badge--${inv.status}`}>{inv.status.replace('_', ' ')}</span>
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="px-4 py-2">{inv.due_date ? formatDate(inv.due_date) : '-'}</td>
                                    <td className="px-4 py-2">
                                        <Link href={`/invoices/${inv.id}`} className="btn btn--outline btn--sm mr-2">View</Link>
                                        <Link href={`/invoices/${inv.id}/edit`} className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm">Edit</Link>
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            ))}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}
```

## **SUMMARY OF WHAT'S WRONG**

The **root cause** of all errors:

**In Next.js 13+ App Router:**

- ❌ You **CANNOT** use `async function Component()` with `"use client"`
- ✅ Client Components must use `useEffect` + `useState` for data fetching
- ✅ OR remove `"use client"` and keep it as Server Component with `async`

**Your invoice page was trying to do both**, which is impossible.

### **File:** `src/app/page.tsx` (Replace completely)

Here's your new enhanced dashboard:

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { 
  Clock, 
  TrendingUp, 
  AlertCircle, 
  Calendar,
  Plus,
  ArrowRight,
  CheckCircle2,
  DollarSign
} from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface DashboardStats {
  activeProjects: number;
  totalProjects: number;
  hoursThisWeek: number;
  totalHours: number;
  pendingInvoices: number;
  upcomingDeadlines: number;
}

interface ProjectWithDetails {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  status: string;
  deadline: string | null;
  description: string | null;
  client: { name: string } | null;
  tasks: any[];
  time_entries: any[];
}

interface RecentActivity {
  id: string;
  type: 'task_completed' | 'time_logged' | 'project_created';
  description: string;
  timestamp: string;
  project_name?: string;
}

export default function DashboardPage() {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<DashboardStats>({
    activeProjects: 0,
    totalProjects: 0,
    hoursThisWeek: 0,
    totalHours: 0,
    pendingInvoices: 0,
    upcomingDeadlines: 0,
  });
  
  const [activeProjects, setActiveProjects] = useState<ProjectWithDetails[]>([]);
  const [recentActivity, setRecentActivity] = useState<RecentActivity[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchDashboardData();
  }, []);

  const fetchDashboardData = async () => {
    try {
      await Promise.all([
        fetchStats(),
        fetchActiveProjects(),
        fetchRecentActivity(),
      ]);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch dashboard data:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load dashboard');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchStats = async () => {
    // Get projects count
    const { data: projects } = await supabaseClient
      .from('projects')
      .select('id, status');
    
    const activeCount = projects?.filter(p => p.status === 'in_progress').length || 0;
    
    // Get hours this week
    const weekAgo = new Date();
    weekAgo.setDate(weekAgo.getDate() - 7);
    
    const { data: timeEntries } = await supabaseClient
      .from('time_entries')
      .select('hours')
      .gte('start_time', weekAgo.toISOString())
      .not('hours', 'is', null);
    
    const hoursThisWeek = timeEntries?.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.hours || 0), 0) || 0;
    
    // Get total hours
    const { data: allTimeEntries } = await supabaseClient
      .from('time_entries')
      .select('hours')
      .not('hours', 'is', null);
    
    const totalHours = allTimeEntries?.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.hours || 0), 0) || 0;
    
    // Get pending invoices
    const { data: invoices } = await supabaseClient
      .from('invoices')
      .select('id')
      .eq('payment_status', 'pending');
    
    // Get upcoming deadlines (next 7 days)
    const nextWeek = new Date();
    nextWeek.setDate(nextWeek.getDate() + 7);
    
    const { data: upcomingProjects } = await supabaseClient
      .from('projects')
      .select('id')
      .gte('deadline', new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0])
      .lte('deadline', nextWeek.toISOString().split('T')[0]);
    
    setStats({
      activeProjects: activeCount,
      totalProjects: projects?.length || 0,
      hoursThisWeek: hoursThisWeek,
      totalHours: totalHours,
      pendingInvoices: invoices?.length || 0,
      upcomingDeadlines: upcomingProjects?.length || 0,
    });
  };

  const fetchActiveProjects = async () => {
    const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
      .from('projects')
      .select(`
        id,
        name,
        status,
        deadline,
        description,
        client:clients(name),
        tasks(id, status),
        time_entries(hours)
      `)
      .eq('status', 'in_progress')
      .order('deadline', { ascending: true })
      .limit(4);
    
    if (error) {
      console.error(error);
      return;
    }
    
    setActiveProjects(data as ProjectWithDetails[] || []);
  };

  const fetchRecentActivity = async () => {
    // Get recent completed tasks
    const { data: recentTasks } = await supabaseClient
      .from('tasks')
      .select('id, description, updated_at, project:projects(name)')
      .eq('status', 'completed')
      .order('updated_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(5);
    
    // Get recent time entries
    const { data: recentTime } = await supabaseClient
      .from('time_entries')
      .select('id, hours, start_time, project:projects(name)')
      .not('hours', 'is', null)
      .order('start_time', { ascending: false })
      .limit(5);
    
    // Combine and format
    const activities: RecentActivity[] = [];
    
    recentTasks?.forEach(task => {
      activities.push({
        id: task.id,
        type: 'task_completed',
        description: task.description,
        timestamp: task.updated_at,
        project_name: task.project?.name,
      });
    });
    
    recentTime?.forEach(entry => {
      activities.push({
        id: entry.id,
        type: 'time_logged',
        description: `Logged ${entry.hours}h`,
        timestamp: entry.start_time,
        project_name: entry.project?.name,
      });
    });
    
    // Sort by timestamp and take top 8
    activities.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime());
    setRecentActivity(activities.slice(0, 8));
  };

  const calculateProgress = (project: ProjectWithDetails) => {
    const totalTasks = project.tasks?.length || 0;
    const completedTasks = project.tasks?.filter(t => t.status === 'completed').length || 0;
    return totalTasks > 0 ? Math.round((completedTasks / totalTasks) * 100) : 0;
  };

  const getDaysUntilDeadline = (deadline: string | null) => {
    if (!deadline) return null;
    const days = Math.ceil((new Date(deadline).getTime() - new Date().getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    return days;
  };

  const formatTimeAgo = (timestamp: string) => {
    const seconds = Math.floor((new Date().getTime() - new Date(timestamp).getTime()) / 1000);
    
    if (seconds < 60) return 'just now';
    if (seconds < 3600) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}m ago`;
    if (seconds < 86400) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 3600)}h ago`;
    return `${Math.floor(seconds / 86400)}d ago`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
          <div className="text-xl">Loading dashboard...</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="mb-8">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2">Welcome to SculptureFlow</h1>
        <p className="text-lg opacity-80">Here's what's happening in your studio today</p>
      </div>

      {/* Stats Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 mb-8">
        {/* Active Projects */}
        <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500/20 to-blue-600/20 border-blue-500/30">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/30">
              <TrendingUp className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-300" />
            </div>
            <span className="text-sm opacity-70">Active</span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-1">{stats.activeProjects}</div>
          <div className="text-sm opacity-80">of {stats.totalProjects} total projects</div>
        </div>

        {/* Hours This Week */}
        <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500/20 to-emerald-600/20 border-green-500/30">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-green-500/30">
              <Clock className="w-6 h-6 text-green-300" />
            </div>
            <span className="text-sm opacity-70">This Week</span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-1">{stats.hoursThisWeek.toFixed(1)}h</div>
          <div className="text-sm opacity-80">{stats.totalHours.toFixed(1)}h total logged</div>
        </div>

        {/* Pending Invoices */}
        <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-500/20 to-purple-600/20 border-purple-500/30">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/30">
              <DollarSign className="w-6 h-6 text-purple-300" />
            </div>
            <span className="text-sm opacity-70">Pending</span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-1">{stats.pendingInvoices}</div>
          <div className="text-sm opacity-80">invoices awaiting payment</div>
        </div>

        {/* Upcoming Deadlines */}
        <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-orange-500/20 to-red-600/20 border-orange-500/30">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-orange-500/30">
              <AlertCircle className="w-6 h-6 text-orange-300" />
            </div>
            <span className="text-sm opacity-70">Next 7 Days</span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-1">{stats.upcomingDeadlines}</div>
          <div className="text-sm opacity-80">deadlines approaching</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Content Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
        {/* Active Projects - Takes 2 columns */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Active Projects</h2>
            <Link href="/projects" className="btn btn--outline btn--sm">
              View All <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
            </Link>
          </div>

          {activeProjects.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="card text-center py-12">
              <p className="text-lg opacity-70 mb-4">No active projects yet</p>
              <Link href="/projects/new" className="btn btn--primary">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                Create Your First Project
              </Link>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {activeProjects.map((project) => {
                const progress = calculateProgress(project);
                const daysLeft = getDaysUntilDeadline(project.deadline);
                const totalHours = project.time_entries?.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.hours || 0), 0) || 0;
                
                return (
                  <Link href={`/projects/${project.id}`} key={project.id}>
                    <div className="card hover:shadow-lg transition-all cursor-pointer">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-4">
                        <div className="flex-1">
                          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-1">{project.name}</h3>
                          <p className="text-sm opacity-70">
                            {project.client?.name || 'No client assigned'}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        {daysLeft !== null && (
                          <div className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-medium ${
                            daysLeft <= 3 ? 'bg-red-500/30 text-red-300 border border-red-500/50' :
                            daysLeft <= 7 ? 'bg-orange-500/30 text-orange-300 border border-orange-500/50' :
                            'bg-blue-500/30 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/50'
                          }`}>
                            {daysLeft === 0 ? 'Due Today' : 
                             daysLeft === 1 ? 'Due Tomorrow' :
                             `${daysLeft} days left`}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Progress Bar */}
                      <div className="mb-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm mb-2">
                          <span className="opacity-80">Progress</span>
                          <span className="font-medium">{progress}%</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="w-full h-2 bg-white/10 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                          <div 
                            className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500 to-emerald-500 transition-all duration-300"
                            style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Stats */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-6 text-sm">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 opacity-70" />
                          <span>{project.tasks?.filter(t => t.status === 'completed').length || 0} / {project.tasks?.length || 0} tasks</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Clock className="w-4 h-4 opacity-70" />
                          <span>{totalHours.toFixed(1)}h logged</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Link>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Recent Activity - Takes 1 column */}
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Recent Activity</h2>
          
          {recentActivity.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="card text-center py-8">
              <p className="opacity-70">No recent activity</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="card">
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {recentActivity.map((activity) => (
                  <div key={activity.id} className="flex items-start gap-3 pb-4 border-b border-white/10 last:border-0 last:pb-0">
                    <div className={`p-2 rounded-lg ${
                      activity.type === 'task_completed' ? 'bg-green-500/30' :
                      activity.type === 'time_logged' ? 'bg-blue-500/30' :
                      'bg-purple-500/30'
                    }`}>
                      {activity.type === 'task_completed' ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      ) : activity.type === 'time_logged' ? (
                        <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
                      ) : (
                        <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="font-medium text-sm truncate">{activity.description}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs opacity-70 mt-1">
                        {activity.project_name && `${activity.project_name} · `}
                        {formatTimeAgo(activity.timestamp)}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Quick Actions */}
          <div className="mt-8">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Quick Actions</h3>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3">
              <Link href="/projects/new" className="btn btn--primary flex items-center justify-center">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                New Project
              </Link>
              <Link href="/clients/new" className="btn btn--secondary flex items-center justify-center">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                New Client
              </Link>
              <Link href="/invoices/new" className="btn btn--outline flex items-center justify-center">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                Create Invoice
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## **FIX: Update fetchRecentActivity function**

Find the `fetchRecentActivity` function and replace it with this:

```typescript
const fetchRecentActivity = async () => {
  // Get recent completed tasks
  const { data: recentTasks } = await supabaseClient
    .from('tasks')
    .select('id, description, updated_at, project:projects(name)')
    .eq('status', 'completed')
    .order('updated_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(5);
  
  // Get recent time entries
  const { data: recentTime } = await supabaseClient
    .from('time_entries')
    .select('id, hours, start_time, project:projects(name)')
    .not('hours', 'is', null)
    .order('start_time', { ascending: false })
    .limit(5);
  
  // Combine and format
  const activities: RecentActivity[] = [];
  
  recentTasks?.forEach((task: any) => {
    activities.push({
      id: task.id,
      type: 'task_completed',
      description: task.description,
      timestamp: task.updated_at,
      project_name: Array.isArray(task.project) ? task.project[0]?.name : task.project?.name,
    });
  });
  
  recentTime?.forEach((entry: any) => {
    activities.push({
      id: entry.id,
      type: 'time_logged',
      description: `Logged ${entry.hours}h`,
      timestamp: entry.start_time,
      project_name: Array.isArray(entry.project) ? entry.project[0]?.name : entry.project?.name,
    });
  });
  
  // Sort by timestamp and take top 8
  activities.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime());
  setRecentActivity(activities.slice(0, 8));
};
```

The key changes:

- Changed `task.project?.name` to `Array.isArray(task.project) ? task.project[0]?.name : task.project?.name`
- Changed `entry.project?.name` to `Array.isArray(entry.project) ? entry.project[0]?.name : entry.project?.name`

This handles both cases - whether Supabase returns an array or a single object.

```typescript
"use client";

import { ReactNode } from 'react';

interface Tab {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: ReactNode;
}

interface TabsProps {
  tabs: Tab[];
  activeTab: string;
  onChange: (tabId: string) => void;
}

export function Tabs({ tabs, activeTab, onChange }: TabsProps) {
  return (
    <div className="border-b border-white/20 mb-6">
      <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto">
        {tabs.map((tab) => (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            onClick={() => onChange(tab.id)}
            className={`
              px-6 py-3 font-medium text-sm transition-all relative
              ${activeTab === tab.id 
                ? 'text-white' 
                : 'text-white/60 hover:text-white/80'
              }
            `}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {tab.icon}
              <span>{tab.label}</span>
            </div>
            {activeTab === tab.id && (
              <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-0.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-purple-500" />
            )}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
export default async function ProjectDetailsPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('projects')
        .select(`
            *,
            client:clients(*),
            tasks(*),
            project_materials(*, material:materials(*)),
            time_entries(*),
            photos(*)
        `)
        .eq('id', params.id)
        .single();

    if (error || !data) {
        console.error(error);
        notFound();
    }
    
    const project = data as ProjectWithDetails;

    return <ProjectDetailsClient project={project} />;
}
```
