```typescript
"use client";

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Tabs } from '@/components/Tabs';
import TaskSection from './TaskSection';
import MaterialsSection from './MaterialsSection';
import TimeTracker from '@/components/TimeTracker';
import PhotoUpload from '@/components/PhotoUpload';
import { 
  LayoutDashboard, 
  CheckSquare, 
  Clock, 
  Package, 
  Image,
  Calendar,
  DollarSign,
  User,
  AlertCircle
} from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import StatusBadge from '@/components/StatusBadge';
import { formatDate } from '@/lib/utils';

interface ProjectDetailsClientProps {
  project: any;
}

export default function ProjectDetailsClient({ project }: ProjectDetailsClientProps) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('overview');

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: <LayoutDashboard className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'tasks', label: 'Tasks', icon: <CheckSquare className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'time', label: 'Time Tracking', icon: <Clock className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'materials', label: 'Materials', icon: <Package className="w-4 h-4" /> },
    { id: 'photos', label: 'Photos', icon: <Image className="w-4 h-4" /> },
  ];

  // Calculate stats
  const totalTasks = project.tasks?.length || 0;
  const completedTasks = project.tasks?.filter((t: any) => t.status === 'completed').length || 0;
  const progress = totalTasks > 0 ? Math.round((completedTasks / totalTasks) * 100) : 0;
  const totalHours = project.time_entries?.reduce((sum: number, entry: any) => sum + (entry.hours || 0), 0) || 0;

  const getDaysUntilDeadline = () => {
    if (!project.deadline) return null;
    const days = Math.ceil((new Date(project.deadline).getTime() - new Date().getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    return days;
  };

  const daysLeft = getDaysUntilDeadline();

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Project Header */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-500/20 to-blue-600/20 border-b border-white/10">
        <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-6">
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2">{project.name}</h1>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm">
                <Link 
                  href={`/clients/${project.client?.id}`}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 hover:text-blue-300 transition-colors"
                >
                  <User className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>{project.client?.name || 'No client'}</span>
                </Link>
                <span className="text-white/40">•</span>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Calendar className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>{project.deadline ? formatDate(project.deadline) : 'No deadline'}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <StatusBadge status={project.status} />
              {daysLeft !== null && (
                <div className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-medium ${
                  daysLeft <= 3 ? 'bg-red-500/30 text-red-300 border border-red-500/50' :
                  daysLeft <= 7 ? 'bg-orange-500/30 text-orange-300 border border-orange-500/50' :
                  'bg-blue-500/30 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/50'
                }`}>
                  {daysLeft === 0 ? 'Due Today' : 
                   daysLeft === 1 ? 'Due Tomorrow' :
                   daysLeft < 0 ? `${Math.abs(daysLeft)} days overdue` :
                   `${daysLeft} days left`}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Stats */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur rounded-lg p-4 border border-white/20">
              <div className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-1">Progress</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{progress}%</div>
              <div className="text-xs opacity-60 mt-1">{completedTasks} / {totalTasks} tasks</div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur rounded-lg p-4 border border-white/20">
              <div className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-1">Time Logged</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{totalHours.toFixed(1)}h</div>
              <div className="text-xs opacity-60 mt-1">Total hours</div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur rounded-lg p-4 border border-white/20">
              <div className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-1">Materials</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{project.project_materials?.length || 0}</div>
              <div className="text-xs opacity-60 mt-1">Items used</div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur rounded-lg p-4 border border-white/20">
              <div className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-1">Photos</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{project.photos?.length || 0}</div>
              <div className="text-xs opacity-60 mt-1">Uploaded</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-6">
        <Tabs tabs={tabs} activeTab={activeTab} onChange={setActiveTab} />

        {/* Tab Content */}
        <div className="mt-6">
          {activeTab === 'overview' && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
                {/* Description */}
                <div className="card">
                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">Project Description</h2>
                  <p className="text-white/80 leading-relaxed">
                    {project.description || 'No description provided.'}
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* Recent Activity Preview */}
                <div className="card">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                    <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Recent Tasks</h2>
                    <button 
                      onClick={() => setActiveTab('tasks')}
                      className="text-sm text-blue-300 hover:text-blue-200"
                    >
                      View all →
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    {project.tasks?.slice(0, 5).map((task: any) => (
                      <div key={task.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-white/5 rounded-lg">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <input 
                            type="checkbox" 
                            checked={task.status === 'completed'}
                            readOnly
                            className="w-5 h-5"
                          />
                          <span className={task.status === 'completed' ? 'line-through opacity-60' : ''}>
                            {task.description}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <StatusBadge status={task.status} />
                      </div>
                    ))}
                    {totalTasks === 0 && (
                      <p className="text-center py-8 opacity-60">No tasks yet</p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Sidebar */}
              <div className="space-y-6">
                {/* Project Info */}
                <div className="card">
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Project Info</h3>
                  <div className="space-y-3 text-sm">
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                      <span className="opacity-70">Client:</span>
                      <Link 
                        href={`/clients/${project.client?.id}`}
                        className="font-medium text-blue-300 hover:text-blue-200"
                      >
                        {project.client?.name}
                      </Link>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                      <span className="opacity-70">Status:</span>
                      <StatusBadge status={project.status} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                      <span className="opacity-70">Deadline:</span>
                      <span className="font-medium">
                        {project.deadline ? formatDate(project.deadline) : 'N/A'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                      <span className="opacity-70">Created:</span>
                      <span className="font-medium">
                        {formatDate(project.created_at)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Quick Actions */}
                <div className="card">
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Quick Actions</h3>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <button 
                      onClick={() => setActiveTab('tasks')}
                      className="btn btn--outline w-full"
                    >
                      Manage Tasks
                    </button>
                    <button 
                      onClick={() => setActiveTab('time')}
                      className="btn btn--outline w-full"
                    >
                      Log Time
                    </button>
                    <button 
                      onClick={() => setActiveTab('photos')}
                      className="btn btn--outline w-full"
                    >
                      Upload Photos
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'tasks' && (
            <div className="card">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Tasks</h2>
              <TaskSection projectId={project.id} tasks={project.tasks} />
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'time' && (
            <div className="max-w-2xl">
              <div className="card">
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Time Tracking</h2>
                <TimeTracker projectId={project.id} projectName={project.name} />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'materials' && (
            <div className="card">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Materials Used</h2>
              <MaterialsSection projectId={project.id} materials={project.project_materials} />
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'photos' && (
            <div className="max-w-4xl">
              <PhotoUpload projectId={project.id} />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## **Step 2: Create Analytics Page**

**Create file:** `src/app/analytics/page.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { 
  TrendingUp, 
  Clock, 
  Briefcase, 
  Target,
  Calendar,
  DollarSign,
  Users,
  Activity
} from 'lucide-react';
import { 
  BarChart, 
  Bar, 
  XAxis, 
  YAxis, 
  CartesianGrid, 
  Tooltip, 
  ResponsiveContainer,
  PieChart,
  Pie,
  Cell,
  LineChart,
  Line,
  Legend
} from 'recharts';

interface AnalyticsData {
  totalRevenue: number;
  totalHours: number;
  totalProjects: number;
  completionRate: number;
  hoursByProject: { name: string; hours: number }[];
  projectsByStatus: { name: string; value: number }[];
  revenueOverTime: { month: string; revenue: number }[];
  topClients: { name: string; projects: number; revenue: number }[];
}

const COLORS = ['#3b82f6', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#ef4444', '#8b5cf6'];

export default function AnalyticsPage() {
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<'week' | 'month' | 'year'>('month');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [analytics, setAnalytics] = useState<AnalyticsData>({
    totalRevenue: 0,
    totalHours: 0,
    totalProjects: 0,
    completionRate: 0,
    hoursByProject: [],
    projectsByStatus: [],
    revenueOverTime: [],
    topClients: [],
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAnalytics();
  }, [period]);

  const fetchAnalytics = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Calculate date range based on period
      const now = new Date();
      const startDate = new Date();
      
      if (period === 'week') {
        startDate.setDate(now.getDate() - 7);
      } else if (period === 'month') {
        startDate.setMonth(now.getMonth() - 1);
      } else {
        startDate.setFullYear(now.getFullYear() - 1);
      }

      // Fetch all data in parallel
      const [
        projectsData,
        timeEntriesData,
        invoicesData,
        clientsData
      ] = await Promise.all([
        supabaseClient
          .from('projects')
          .select('id, name, status, created_at')
          .gte('created_at', startDate.toISOString()),
        
        supabaseClient
          .from('time_entries')
          .select('hours, project_id, start_time, project:projects(name)')
          .not('hours', 'is', null)
          .gte('start_time', startDate.toISOString()),
        
        supabaseClient
          .from('invoices')
          .select('amount, project_id, issue_date')
          .gte('issue_date', startDate.toISOString()),
        
        supabaseClient
          .from('clients')
          .select('id, name, projects(id, invoices(amount))')
      ]);

      // Process projects data
      const projects = projectsData.data || [];
      const totalProjects = projects.length;
      const completedProjects = projects.filter(p => p.status === 'completed').length;
      const completionRate = totalProjects > 0 ? (completedProjects / totalProjects) * 100 : 0;

      // Process time entries
      const timeEntries = timeEntriesData.data || [];
      const totalHours = timeEntries.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.hours || 0), 0);

      // Hours by project
      const hoursByProject: { [key: string]: number } = {};
      timeEntries.forEach((entry: any) => {
        const projectName = Array.isArray(entry.project) 
          ? entry.project[0]?.name || 'Unknown'
          : entry.project?.name || 'Unknown';
        
        if (!hoursByProject[projectName]) {
          hoursByProject[projectName] = 0;
        }
        hoursByProject[projectName] += entry.hours || 0;
      });

      const hoursByProjectChart = Object.entries(hoursByProject)
        .map(([name, hours]) => ({ name, hours: Number(hours.toFixed(1)) }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.hours - a.hours)
        .slice(0, 10);

      // Projects by status
      const statusCounts: { [key: string]: number } = {};
      projects.forEach(p => {
        statusCounts[p.status] = (statusCounts[p.status] || 0) + 1;
      });

      const projectsByStatus = Object.entries(statusCounts).map(([name, value]) => ({
        name: name.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase(),
        value
      }));

      // Revenue calculation
      const invoices = invoicesData.data || [];
      const totalRevenue = invoices.reduce((sum, inv) => sum + (inv.amount || 0), 0);

      // Revenue over time (monthly)
      const revenueByMonth: { [key: string]: number } = {};
      invoices.forEach(inv => {
        const month = new Date(inv.issue_date).toLocaleString('default', { month: 'short' });
        revenueByMonth[month] = (revenueByMonth[month] || 0) + (inv.amount || 0);
      });

      const revenueOverTime = Object.entries(revenueByMonth).map(([month, revenue]) => ({
        month,
        revenue: Number(revenue.toFixed(0))
      }));

      // Top clients
      const clients = clientsData.data || [];
      const topClients = clients
        .map((client: any) => ({
          name: client.name,
          projects: client.projects?.length || 0,
          revenue: client.projects?.reduce((sum: number, p: any) => 
            sum + (p.invoices?.reduce((s: number, i: any) => s + (i.amount || 0), 0) || 0), 0) || 0
        }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.revenue - a.revenue)
        .slice(0, 5);

      setAnalytics({
        totalRevenue,
        totalHours,
        totalProjects,
        completionRate,
        hoursByProject: hoursByProjectChart,
        projectsByStatus,
        revenueOverTime,
        topClients,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch analytics:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
          <div className="text-xl">Loading analytics...</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2">Business Analytics</h1>
          <p className="text-lg opacity-80">Insights into your studio performance</p>
        </div>

        {/* Period Selector */}
        <div className="flex gap-2 bg-white/10 p-1 rounded-lg">
          {(['week', 'month', 'year'] as const).map((p) => (
            <button
              key={p}
              onClick={() => setPeriod(p)}
              className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-all ${
                period === p
                  ? 'bg-white/20 text-white font-medium'
                  : 'text-white/60 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              {p === 'week' ? 'This Week' : p === 'month' ? 'This Month' : 'This Year'}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 mb-8">
        <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500/20 to-emerald-600/20 border-green-500/30">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-green-500/30">
              <DollarSign className="w-6 h-6 text-green-300" />
            </div>
            <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-green-300" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-1">₹{analytics.totalRevenue.toLocaleString()}</div>
          <div className="text-sm opacity-80">Total Revenue</div>
        </div>

        <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500/20 to-blue-600/20 border-blue-500/30">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/30">
              <Clock className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-300" />
            </div>
            <Activity className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-300" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-1">{analytics.totalHours.toFixed(1)}h</div>
          <div className="text-sm opacity-80">Hours Logged</div>
        </div>

        <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-500/20 to-purple-600/20 border-purple-500/30">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/30">
              <Briefcase className="w-6 h-6 text-purple-300" />
            </div>
            <Calendar className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-300" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-1">{analytics.totalProjects}</div>
          <div className="text-sm opacity-80">Total Projects</div>
        </div>

        <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-orange-500/20 to-red-600/20 border-orange-500/30">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-orange-500/30">
              <Target className="w-6 h-6 text-orange-300" />
            </div>
            <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-300" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-1">{analytics.completionRate.toFixed(0)}%</div>
          <div className="text-sm opacity-80">Completion Rate</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Charts Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8 mb-8">
        {/* Hours by Project */}
        <div className="card">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Hours by Project</h2>
          {analytics.hoursByProject.length > 0 ? (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>
              <BarChart data={analytics.hoursByProject}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)" />
                <XAxis 
                  dataKey="name" 
                  stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)"
                  angle={-45}
                  textAnchor="end"
                  height={80}
                />
                <YAxis stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)" />
                <Tooltip 
                  contentStyle={{ 
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)', 
                    border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
                    borderRadius: '8px'
                  }}
                />
                <Bar dataKey="hours" fill="#3b82f6" radius={[8, 8, 0, 0]} />
              </BarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-12 opacity-60">No data available</div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Project Status Distribution */}
        <div className="card">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Project Status</h2>
          {analytics.projectsByStatus.length > 0 ? (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>
              <PieChart>
                <Pie
                  data={analytics.projectsByStatus}
                  cx="50%"
                  cy="50%"
                  labelLine={false}
                  label={({ name, percent }) => `${name} ${(percent * 100).toFixed(0)}%`}
                  outerRadius={100}
                  fill="#8884d8"
                  dataKey="value"
                >
                  {analytics.projectsByStatus.map((entry, index) => (
                    <Cell key={`cell-${index}`} fill={COLORS[index % COLORS.length]} />
                  ))}
                </Pie>
                <Tooltip 
                  contentStyle={{ 
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)', 
                    border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
                    borderRadius: '8px'
                  }}
                />
              </PieChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-12 opacity-60">No data available</div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Revenue Over Time */}
      {analytics.revenueOverTime.length > 0 && (
        <div className="card mb-8">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Revenue Trend</h2>
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>
            <LineChart data={analytics.revenueOverTime}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)" />
              <XAxis dataKey="month" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)" />
              <YAxis stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)" />
              <Tooltip 
                contentStyle={{ 
                  backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.8)', 
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)',
                  borderRadius: '8px'
                }}
              />
              <Legend />
              <Line 
                type="monotone" 
                dataKey="revenue" 
                stroke="#10b981" 
                strokeWidth={2}
                dot={{ fill: '#10b981', r: 4 }}
              />
            </LineChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Top Clients */}
      <div className="card">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Top Clients</h2>
        {analytics.topClients.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {analytics.topClients.map((client, index) => (
              <div key={index} className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold ${
                    index === 0 ? 'bg-yellow-500/30 text-yellow-300' :
                    index === 1 ? 'bg-gray-400/30 text-gray-300' :
                    index === 2 ? 'bg-orange-500/30 text-orange-300' :
                    'bg-blue-500/30 text-blue-300'
                  }`}>
                    #{index + 1}
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-bold">{client.name}</div>
                    <div className="text-sm opacity-70">{client.projects} projects</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-xl font-bold text-green-300">
                  ₹{client.revenue.toLocaleString()}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-center py-12 opacity-60">No client data available</div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

{ href: '/', label: 'Dashboard', icon: Home },
{ href: '/projects', label: 'Projects', icon: Briefcase },
{ href: '/clients', label: 'Clients', icon: Users },
{ href: '/invoices', label: 'Money', icon: DollarSign },
{ href: '/materials', label: 'Materials', icon: Package },
];

export default function Navigation() {
const pathname = usePathname();

return (
<nav className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-surface border-t border-border z-50">
<div className="flex justify-around">
{navItems.map((item) => {
const isActive = pathname === item.href || (item.href !== '/' \&\& pathname.startsWith(item.href));
return (
<Link
key={item.href}
href={item.href}
className={cn(
'flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full pt-2 pb-1 text-xs',
isActive ? 'text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary'
)}
aria-current={isActive ? 'page' : undefined}
>
<item.icon className="w-6 h-6 mb-1" />
<span className="block md:hidden">{item.label}</span>
</Link>
);
})}
</div>
</nav>
);
}

```typescript
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { Home, Briefcase, Users, DollarSign, BarChart3 } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const navItems = [
  { href: '/', label: 'Dashboard', icon: Home },
  { href: '/projects', label: 'Projects', icon: Briefcase },
  { href: '/clients', label: 'Clients', icon: Users },
  { href: '/analytics', label: 'Analytics', icon: BarChart3 }, // <-- ADDED THIS
  { href: '/invoices', label: 'Money', icon: DollarSign },
];

export default function Navigation() {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  return (
    <nav className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-surface border-t border-border z-50">
      <div className="flex justify-around">
        {navItems.map((item) => {
          const isActive = pathname === item.href || (item.href !== '/' && pathname.startsWith(item.href));
          return (
            <Link
              key={item.href}
              href={item.href}
              className={cn(
                'flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full pt-2 pb-1 text-xs',
                isActive ? 'text-primary' : 'text-text-secondary'
              )}
              aria-current={isActive ? 'page' : undefined}
            >
              <item.icon className="w-6 h-6 mb-1" />
              <span className="block md:hidden">{item.label}</span>
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

## **🎨 MODERN NAVIGATION BAR**

```typescript
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { Home, Briefcase, Users, BarChart3, DollarSign } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const navItems = [
  { href: '/', label: 'Dashboard', icon: Home },
  { href: '/projects', label: 'Projects', icon: Briefcase },
  { href: '/clients', label: 'Clients', icon: Users },
  { href: '/analytics', label: 'Analytics', icon: BarChart3 },
  { href: '/invoices', label: 'Money', icon: DollarSign },
];

export default function Navigation() {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  return (
    <nav className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-surface/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/10 z-50 shadow-lg">
      <div className="max-w-screen-xl mx-auto px-4">
        <div className="flex justify-around items-center h-20">
          {navItems.map((item) => {
            const isActive = pathname === item.href || (item.href !== '/' && pathname.startsWith(item.href));
            
            return (
              <Link
                key={item.href}
                href={item.href}
                className={cn(
                  'group relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center',
                  'min-w-[80px] py-2 px-4 rounded-2xl',
                  'transition-all duration-300 ease-out',
                  'hover:scale-110',
                  isActive 
                    ? 'text-primary' 
                    : 'text-text-secondary hover:text-white'
                )}
                aria-current={isActive ? 'page' : undefined}
              >
                {/* Background glow on active */}
                {isActive && (
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500/20 to-purple-500/20 rounded-2xl blur-sm -z-10" />
                )}
                
                {/* Hover background */}
                <div className={cn(
                  'absolute inset-0 rounded-2xl transition-all duration-300',
                  'group-hover:bg-white/5',
                  isActive && 'bg-white/10'
                )} />
                
                {/* Icon with animation */}
                <div className={cn(
                  'relative mb-1 transition-all duration-300',
                  'group-hover:-translate-y-0.5',
                  isActive && 'scale-110'
                )}>
                  <item.icon className={cn(
                    'w-6 h-6 transition-all duration-300',
                    isActive && 'drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)]'
                  )} />
                  
                  {/* Active indicator dot */}
                  {isActive && (
                    <div className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-2 h-2 bg-primary rounded-full animate-pulse" />
                  )}
                </div>
                
                {/* Label */}
                <span className={cn(
                  'relative text-xs font-medium transition-all duration-300',
                  'group-hover:font-semibold',
                  isActive && 'font-semibold'
                )}>
                  {item.label}
                </span>
                
                {/* Active bottom indicator */}
                {isActive && (
                  <div className="absolute -bottom-[1px] left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-12 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-purple-500 rounded-t-full" />
                )}
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

## **STEP 1: Update Database Schema**

```sql
-- Enhanced Quotations Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quotations (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  quotation_number TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  client_id UUID REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  subject TEXT,
  date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  valid_until DATE,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'draft', -- draft, sent, accepted, rejected, converted
  subtotal DECIMAL(12,2),
  gst_percentage DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 12,
  gst_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
  total_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
  notes TEXT,
  terms_and_conditions TEXT,
  converted_to_invoice_id UUID REFERENCES invoices(id),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Quotation Line Items
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quotation_items (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  quotation_id UUID REFERENCES quotations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  item_number INTEGER,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  specifications JSONB, -- {height, weight, material, finish, etc}
  quantity DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 1,
  unit TEXT DEFAULT 'unit', -- unit, kg, sqft, etc
  rate DECIMAL(12,2),
  amount DECIMAL(12,2),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Enhanced Invoices Table (similar structure)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoices_enhanced (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  invoice_number TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  client_id UUID REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  quotation_id UUID REFERENCES quotations(id), -- Link to original quotation
  subject TEXT,
  issue_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  due_date DATE,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'unpaid', -- unpaid, partially_paid, paid, overdue
  subtotal DECIMAL(12,2),
  gst_percentage DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 12,
  gst_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
  total_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
  paid_amount DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
  balance_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
  payment_terms TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Invoice Line Items
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoice_items (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  invoice_id UUID REFERENCES invoices_enhanced(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  item_number INTEGER,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  specifications JSONB,
  quantity DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 1,
  unit TEXT DEFAULT 'unit',
  rate DECIMAL(12,2),
  amount DECIMAL(12,2),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Payment Milestones/Schedule
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payment_milestones (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  invoice_id UUID REFERENCES invoices_enhanced(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  quotation_id UUID REFERENCES quotations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  milestone_name TEXT, -- "Advance", "After clay approval", "Final delivery"
  due_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
  due_date DATE,
  paid_amount DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending', -- pending, paid, overdue
  paid_date DATE,
  payment_method TEXT,
  transaction_reference TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Bill Book / Ledger
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transactions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  transaction_number TEXT UNIQUE,
  transaction_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'income', 'expense'
  category TEXT, -- 'quotation_payment', 'material_purchase', 'salary', etc
  client_id UUID REFERENCES clients(id),
  invoice_id UUID REFERENCES invoices_enhanced(id),
  quotation_id UUID REFERENCES quotations(id),
  amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  payment_method TEXT, -- cash, bank_transfer, cheque, upi
  reference_number TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  created_by UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);
```

## **STEP 3: Create PDF Generation Utility**

**Create file:** `src/lib/pdf-generator.ts`

```typescript
import jsPDF from 'jspdf';
import autoTable from 'jspdf-autotable';

interface QuotationData {
  quotation_number: string;
  date: string;
  client_name: string;
  client_address?: string;
  subject: string;
  items: Array<{
    description: string;
    specifications?: any;
    quantity: number;
    unit: string;
    rate: number;
    amount: number;
  }>;
  subtotal: number;
  gst_percentage: number;
  gst_amount: number;
  total_amount: number;
  payment_milestones?: Array<{
    milestone_name: string;
    due_amount: number;
  }>;
  notes?: string;
  terms?: string;
  bank_details?: {
    account_name: string;
    account_number: string;
    ifsc_code: string;
    branch: string;
  };
}

export function generateQuotationPDF(data: QuotationData) {
  const doc = new jsPDF();
  
  // Company Header
  doc.setFontSize(20);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.text('Sculpture Studio, Bangalore', 105, 20, { align: 'center' });
  
  doc.setFontSize(10);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  doc.text('Contact: [Your Phone] | Email: [Your Email]', 105, 27, { align: 'center' });
  
  // Line separator
  doc.setDrawColor(100, 100, 100);
  doc.line(15, 32, 195, 32);
  
  // Quotation Details
  doc.setFontSize(12);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.text(`Quotation #${data.quotation_number}`, 15, 40);
  
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  doc.setFontSize(10);
  doc.text(`Date: ${new Date(data.date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}`, 15, 47);
  
  // Client Details
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.text('To:', 15, 55);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  doc.text(data.client_name, 15, 61);
  if (data.client_address) {
    doc.text(data.client_address, 15, 67);
  }
  
  // Subject
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.text('Subject:', 15, 80);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  const splitSubject = doc.splitTextToSize(data.subject, 170);
  doc.text(splitSubject, 15, 86);
  
  // Items Table
  const tableStartY = 100;
  const tableData = data.items.map((item, index) => {
    let description = `${index + 1}. ${item.description}`;
    
    // Add specifications if present
    if (item.specifications) {
      const specs = Object.entries(item.specifications)
        .map(([key, value]) => `${key}: ${value}`)
        .join(', ');
      description += `\n${specs}`;
    }
    
    return [
      description,
      `${item.quantity} ${item.unit}`,
      `₹${item.rate.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`,
      `₹${item.amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`
    ];
  });
  
  autoTable(doc, {
    startY: tableStartY,
    head: [['Description', 'Quantity', 'Rate', 'Amount']],
    body: tableData,
    theme: 'grid',
    headStyles: { fillColor: [100, 100, 100], textColor: 255 },
    styles: { fontSize: 9, cellPadding: 3 },
    columnStyles: {
      0: { cellWidth: 100 },
      1: { cellWidth: 30 },
      2: { cellWidth: 30 },
      3: { cellWidth: 30, halign: 'right' }
    }
  });
  
  // Totals
  const finalY = (doc as any).lastAutoTable.finalY + 10;
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  
  doc.text('Subtotal:', 130, finalY);
  doc.text(`₹${data.subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`, 195, finalY, { align: 'right' });
  
  doc.text(`GST (${data.gst_percentage}%):`, 130, finalY + 7);
  doc.text(`₹${data.gst_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`, 195, finalY + 7, { align: 'right' });
  
  doc.setFontSize(12);
  doc.text('Total Amount:', 130, finalY + 14);
  doc.text(`₹${data.total_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`, 195, finalY + 14, { align: 'right' });
  
  // Payment Milestones
  if (data.payment_milestones && data.payment_milestones.length > 0) {
    doc.setFontSize(11);
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
    doc.text('Payment Terms:', 15, finalY + 25);
    
    doc.setFontSize(9);
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
    data.payment_milestones.forEach((milestone, index) => {
      doc.text(
        `• ${milestone.milestone_name}: ₹${milestone.due_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`,
        20,
        finalY + 32 + (index * 5)
      );
    });
  }
  
  // Bank Details
  if (data.bank_details) {
    const bankY = finalY + 50;
    doc.setFontSize(10);
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
    doc.text('Bank Account Details:', 15, bankY);
    
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
    doc.setFontSize(9);
    doc.text(`Account Name: ${data.bank_details.account_name}`, 15, bankY + 6);
    doc.text(`Account Number: ${data.bank_details.account_number}`, 15, bankY + 11);
    doc.text(`IFSC Code: ${data.bank_details.ifsc_code}`, 15, bankY + 16);
    doc.text(`Branch: ${data.bank_details.branch}`, 15, bankY + 21);
  }
  
  // Footer
  doc.setFontSize(8);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'italic');
  doc.text('Thank you for your business!', 105, 280, { align: 'center' });
  
  return doc;
}

// Similar function for invoices
export function generateInvoicePDF(data: any) {
  // Similar structure, but with "INVOICE" header and payment status
  // ... (can be implemented similarly)
}
```

## **PART 1: Enhanced Quotation Creation Page**

**File:** `src/app/quotations/new/page.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Plus, Trash2, Save, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { generateQuotationPDF } from '@/lib/pdf-generator';

interface LineItem {
  id: string;
  description: string;
  specifications: string;
  quantity: number;
  unit: string;
  rate: number;
  amount: number;
}

interface PaymentMilestone {
  id: string;
  milestone_name: string;
  percentage: number;
  amount: number;
}

export default function NewQuotationPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [clients, setClients] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    client_id: '',
    project_id: '',
    subject: '',
    date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    valid_until: '',
    gst_percentage: 12,
    notes: '',
    terms_and_conditions: `• The final cost will be adjusted proportionally if the actual weight is less than estimated.
• The above prices exclude GST (${12}%), which will be added to the final bill.
• Timeline: Estimated completion in 6-8 months from date of advance payment.
• Installation charges (if required) will be quoted separately.`,
  });

  const [items, setItems] = useState<LineItem[]>([
    {
      id: '1',
      description: 'Sculpture',
      specifications: 'Height: \nMaterial: Brass\nFinish: Antique patina',
      quantity: 1,
      unit: 'unit',
      rate: 0,
      amount: 0,
    },
  ]);

  const [milestones, setMilestones] = useState<PaymentMilestone[]>([
    { id: '1', milestone_name: 'Advance Payment', percentage: 40, amount: 0 },
    { id: '2', milestone_name: 'After Clay Model Approval', percentage: 30, amount: 0 },
    { id: '3', milestone_name: 'Final Delivery', percentage: 30, amount: 0 },
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchClients();
    fetchProjects();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    calculateTotals();
  }, [items, formData.gst_percentage]);

  const fetchClients = async () => {
    const { data } = await supabaseClient
      .from('clients')
      .select('id, name')
      .order('name');
    setClients(data || []);
  };

  const fetchProjects = async () => {
    const { data } = await supabaseClient
      .from('projects')
      .select('id, name, client_id')
      .order('name');
    setProjects(data || []);
  };

  const addItem = () => {
    setItems([
      ...items,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        description: '',
        specifications: '',
        quantity: 1,
        unit: 'unit',
        rate: 0,
        amount: 0,
      },
    ]);
  };

  const removeItem = (id: string) => {
    if (items.length > 1) {
      setItems(items.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
    }
  };

  const updateItem = (id: string, field: string, value: any) => {
    setItems(
      items.map((item) => {
        if (item.id === id) {
          const updated = { ...item, [field]: value };
          // Auto-calculate amount
          if (field === 'quantity' || field === 'rate') {
            updated.amount = updated.quantity * updated.rate;
          }
          return updated;
        }
        return item;
      })
    );
  };

  const calculateTotals = () => {
    const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.amount, 0);
    const gstAmount = (subtotal * formData.gst_percentage) / 100;
    const total = subtotal + gstAmount;

    // Update milestone amounts based on total
    setMilestones(
      milestones.map((m) => ({
        ...m,
        amount: (total * m.percentage) / 100,
      }))
    );

    return { subtotal, gstAmount, total };
  };

  const updateMilestone = (id: string, field: string, value: any) => {
    setMilestones(
      milestones.map((m) => {
        if (m.id === id) {
          return { ...m, [field]: value };
        }
        return m;
      })
    );
  };

  const addMilestone = () => {
    setMilestones([
      ...milestones,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        milestone_name: '',
        percentage: 0,
        amount: 0,
      },
    ]);
  };

  const removeMilestone = (id: string) => {
    if (milestones.length > 1) {
      setMilestones(milestones.filter((m) => m.id !== id));
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (action: 'draft' | 'finalize') => {
    if (!formData.client_id || !formData.subject) {
      toast.error('Please fill in required fields');
      return;
    }

    if (items.some((item) => !item.description || item.rate === 0)) {
      toast.error('Please complete all line items');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const { subtotal, gstAmount, total } = calculateTotals();

      // Generate quotation number
      const quotationNumber = `QT-${Date.now()}`;

      // Insert quotation
      const { data: quotation, error: quotationError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotations')
        .insert([
          {
            quotation_number: quotationNumber,
            client_id: formData.client_id,
            project_id: formData.project_id || null,
            subject: formData.subject,
            date: formData.date,
            valid_until: formData.valid_until || null,
            status: action === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'sent',
            subtotal,
            gst_percentage: formData.gst_percentage,
            gst_amount: gstAmount,
            total_amount: total,
            notes: formData.notes,
            terms_and_conditions: formData.terms_and_conditions,
          },
        ])
        .select()
        .single();

      if (quotationError) throw quotationError;

      // Insert line items
      const { error: itemsError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotation_items')
        .insert(
          items.map((item, index) => ({
            quotation_id: quotation.id,
            item_number: index + 1,
            description: item.description,
            specifications: { notes: item.specifications },
            quantity: item.quantity,
            unit: item.unit,
            rate: item.rate,
            amount: item.amount,
          }))
        );

      if (itemsError) throw itemsError;

      // Insert payment milestones
      const { error: milestonesError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('payment_milestones')
        .insert(
          milestones.map((m) => ({
            quotation_id: quotation.id,
            milestone_name: m.milestone_name,
            due_amount: m.amount,
            status: 'pending',
          }))
        );

      if (milestonesError) throw milestonesError;

      toast.success('Quotation created successfully!');
      router.push(`/quotations/${quotation.id}`);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to create quotation');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const { subtotal, gstAmount, total } = calculateTotals();

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 max-w-6xl">
      <div className="mb-8">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2">Create Quotation</h1>
        <p className="text-lg opacity-80">Generate professional quotations with line items and payment terms</p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
        {/* Main Form - Left Side */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {/* Basic Details */}
          <div className="card">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Basic Information</h2>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-4">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Client *</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.client_id}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, client_id: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  required
                >
                  <option value="">Select client</option>
                  {clients.map((client) => (
                    <option key={client.id} value={client.id}>
                      {client.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Project (Optional)</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.project_id}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, project_id: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                >
                  <option value="">Select project</option>
                  {projects
                    .filter((p) => p.client_id === formData.client_id)
                    .map((project) => (
                      <option key={project.id} value={project.id}>
                        {project.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="form-group mb-4">
              <label className="form-label">Subject *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.subject}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, subject: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
                placeholder="e.g., Quotation for Brass Sculptures of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar and Mahatma Gandhi"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Date</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={formData.date}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, date: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Valid Until</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={formData.valid_until}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, valid_until: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">GST %</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={formData.gst_percentage}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, gst_percentage: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
                  className="form-control"
                  step="0.01"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Line Items */}
          <div className="card">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Line Items</h2>
              <button onClick={addItem} className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm flex items-center gap-2">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                Add Item
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              {items.map((item, index) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-lg border border-white/10">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
                    <h3 className="font-bold">Item {index + 1}</h3>
                    {items.length > 1 && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => removeItem(item.id)}
                        className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid gap-3">
                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="form-label text-sm">Description *</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={item.description}
                        onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'description', e.target.value)}
                        className="form-control"
                        placeholder="e.g., Sculpture of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar (Walking Figure)"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="form-label text-sm">Specifications</label>
                      <textarea
                        value={item.specifications}
                        onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'specifications', e.target.value)}
                        className="form-control"
                        rows={3}
                        placeholder="Height: 10 feet&#10;Material: Brass&#10;Finish: Antique patina"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Quantity</label>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={item.quantity}
                          onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'quantity', parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                          className="form-control"
                          step="0.01"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Unit</label>
                        <select
                          value={item.unit}
                          onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'unit', e.target.value)}
                          className="form-control"
                        >
                          <option value="unit">Unit</option>
                          <option value="kg">Kg</option>
                          <option value="sqft">Sq.Ft</option>
                          <option value="feet">Feet</option>
                        </select>
                      </div>

                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Rate (₹)</label>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={item.rate}
                          onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'rate', parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                          className="form-control"
                          step="0.01"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Amount (₹)</label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={item.amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                          className="form-control bg-white/5"
                          readOnly
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Payment Milestones */}
          <div className="card">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Payment Milestones</h2>
              <button onClick={addMilestone} className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm flex items-center gap-2">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                Add Milestone
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              {milestones.map((milestone, index) => (
                <div key={milestone.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold w-8">{index + 1}.</span>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={milestone.milestone_name}
                    onChange={(e) => updateMilestone(milestone.id, 'milestone_name', e.target.value)}
                    className="form-control flex-1"
                    placeholder="Milestone name"
                  />
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    value={milestone.percentage}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      updateMilestone(milestone.id, 'percentage', parseFloat(e.target.value))
                    }
                    className="form-control w-24"
                    placeholder="%"
                  />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={`₹${milestone.amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`}
                    className="form-control w-32 bg-white/5"
                    readOnly
                  />
                  {milestones.length > 1 && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => removeMilestone(milestone.id)}
                      className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Terms & Conditions */}
          <div className="card">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">Terms & Conditions</h2>
            <textarea
              value={formData.terms_and_conditions}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, terms_and_conditions: e.target.value })}
              className="form-control"
              rows={6}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Summary Sidebar - Right Side */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Totals Card */}
          <div className="card sticky top-4">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Summary</h3>
            
            <div className="space-y-3 mb-6">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="opacity-70">Subtotal:</span>
                <span className="font-medium">₹{subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="opacity-70">GST ({formData.gst_percentage}%):</span>
                <span className="font-medium">₹{gstAmount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="border-t border-white/10 pt-3">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="font-bold text-lg">Total:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-2xl text-primary">
                    ₹{total.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              <button
                onClick={() => handleSubmit('draft')}
                disabled={loading}
                className="btn btn--secondary w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
              >
                <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                Save as Draft
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleSubmit('finalize')}
                disabled={loading}
                className="btn btn--primary w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
              >
                <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
                Finalize & Create
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Tips */}
          <div className="card bg-blue-500/10 border-blue-500/30">
            <h4 className="font-bold mb-2">💡 Tips</h4>
            <ul className="text-sm space-y-2 opacity-80">
              <li>• Add detailed specifications for clarity</li>
              <li>• Use milestones for large projects</li>
              <li>• Valid until date creates urgency</li>
              <li>• You can download PDF after creation</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## **PART 2: View/Edit Quotation with PDF Download**

**Create folder \& file:** `src/app/quotations/[id]/page.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Download, Edit, Send, FileText, ArrowRight, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { generateQuotationPDF } from '@/lib/pdf-generator';
import StatusBadge from '@/components/StatusBadge';

export default function QuotationDetailsPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [quotation, setQuotation] = useState<any>(null);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [milestones, setMilestones] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [client, setClient] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [converting, setConverting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchQuotation();
  }, [params.id]);

  const fetchQuotation = async () => {
    try {
      // Fetch quotation with client details
      const { data: quotationData, error: quotationError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotations')
        .select(`
          *,
          client:clients(id, name, email, phone, address)
        `)
        .eq('id', params.id)
        .single();

      if (quotationError) throw quotationError;
      setQuotation(quotationData);
      setClient(Array.isArray(quotationData.client) ? quotationData.client[0] : quotationData.client);

      // Fetch line items
      const { data: itemsData, error: itemsError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotation_items')
        .select('*')
        .eq('quotation_id', params.id)
        .order('item_number');

      if (itemsError) throw itemsError;
      setItems(itemsData || []);

      // Fetch payment milestones
      const { data: milestonesData, error: milestonesError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('payment_milestones')
        .select('*')
        .eq('quotation_id', params.id);

      if (milestonesError) throw milestonesError;
      setMilestones(milestonesData || []);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to load quotation');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const downloadPDF = () => {
    if (!quotation || !client) return;

    try {
      const pdfData = {
        quotation_number: quotation.quotation_number,
        date: quotation.date,
        client_name: client.name,
        client_address: client.address,
        subject: quotation.subject,
        items: items.map((item) => ({
          description: item.description,
          specifications: item.specifications,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unit: item.unit,
          rate: item.rate,
          amount: item.amount,
        })),
        subtotal: quotation.subtotal,
        gst_percentage: quotation.gst_percentage,
        gst_amount: quotation.gst_amount,
        total_amount: quotation.total_amount,
        payment_milestones: milestones.map((m) => ({
          milestone_name: m.milestone_name,
          due_amount: m.due_amount,
        })),
        notes: quotation.notes,
        terms: quotation.terms_and_conditions,
      };

      const pdf = generateQuotationPDF(pdfData);
      pdf.save(`Quotation-${quotation.quotation_number}.pdf`);
      toast.success('PDF downloaded successfully!');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to generate PDF');
    }
  };

  const convertToInvoice = async () => {
    if (!quotation) return;

    setConverting(true);
    try {
      // Generate invoice number
      const invoiceNumber = `INV-${Date.now()}`;

      // Create invoice from quotation
      const { data: invoice, error: invoiceError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('invoices_enhanced')
        .insert([
          {
            invoice_number: invoiceNumber,
            client_id: quotation.client_id,
            project_id: quotation.project_id,
            quotation_id: quotation.id,
            subject: quotation.subject,
            issue_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
            due_date: null,
            status: 'unpaid',
            subtotal: quotation.subtotal,
            gst_percentage: quotation.gst_percentage,
            gst_amount: quotation.gst_amount,
            total_amount: quotation.total_amount,
            paid_amount: 0,
            balance_amount: quotation.total_amount,
            payment_terms: quotation.terms_and_conditions,
          },
        ])
        .select()
        .single();

      if (invoiceError) throw invoiceError;

      // Copy line items to invoice
      const { error: itemsError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('invoice_items')
        .insert(
          items.map((item) => ({
            invoice_id: invoice.id,
            item_number: item.item_number,
            description: item.description,
            specifications: item.specifications,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            unit: item.unit,
            rate: item.rate,
            amount: item.amount,
          }))
        );

      if (itemsError) throw itemsError;

      // Copy payment milestones
      const { error: milestonesError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('payment_milestones')
        .insert(
          milestones.map((m) => ({
            invoice_id: invoice.id,
            milestone_name: m.milestone_name,
            due_amount: m.due_amount,
            status: 'pending',
          }))
        );

      if (milestonesError) throw milestonesError;

      // Update quotation status
      await supabaseClient
        .from('quotations')
        .update({
          status: 'converted',
          converted_to_invoice_id: invoice.id,
        })
        .eq('id', quotation.id);

      toast.success('Converted to invoice successfully!');
      router.push(`/invoices/${invoice.id}`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to convert to invoice');
    } finally {
      setConverting(false);
    }
  };

  const deleteQuotation = async () => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this quotation?')) return;

    try {
      await supabaseClient.from('quotations').delete().eq('id', params.id);
      toast.success('Quotation deleted');
      router.push('/quotations');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to delete quotation');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
          <div className="text-xl">Loading quotation...</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!quotation) {
    return (
      <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
        <div className="text-center py-12">
          <p className="text-xl mb-4">Quotation not found</p>
          <button onClick={() => router.back()} className="btn btn--primary">
            Go Back
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 max-w-6xl">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-8">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-2">
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold">{quotation.quotation_number}</h1>
            <StatusBadge status={quotation.status} />
          </div>
          <p className="text-lg opacity-80">{quotation.subject}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <button onClick={downloadPDF} className="btn btn--secondary flex items-center gap-2">
            <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
            Download PDF
          </button>
          
          {quotation.status !== 'converted' && (
            <button
              onClick={convertToInvoice}
              disabled={converting}
              className="btn btn--primary flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
              Convert to Invoice
            </button>
          )}

          <button onClick={() => router.push(`/quotations/${params.id}/edit`)} className="btn btn--outline">
            <Edit className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>

          <button onClick={deleteQuotation} className="btn btn--outline text-red-400 hover:text-red-300">
            <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Quotation Content */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
        {/* Main Content */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {/* Client & Details */}
          <div className="card">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold mb-2">Client</h3>
                <p className="text-lg">{client?.name}</p>
                {client?.address && <p className="text-sm opacity-70 mt-1">{client.address}</p>}
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold mb-2">Date</h3>
                <p>{new Date(quotation.date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}</p>
                {quotation.valid_until && (
                  <>
                    <h3 className="font-bold mb-2 mt-4">Valid Until</h3>
                    <p>{new Date(quotation.valid_until).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}</p>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Line Items */}
          <div className="card">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Items</h2>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {items.map((item, index) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-lg">
                  <div className="flex justify-between mb-2">
                    <h3 className="font-bold">
                      {index + 1}. {item.description}
                    </h3>
                    <span className="font-bold">₹{item.amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                  </div>
                  {item.specifications && (
                    <p className="text-sm opacity-70 whitespace-pre-line">
                      {typeof item.specifications === 'object'
                        ? item.specifications.notes
                        : item.specifications}
                    </p>
                  )}
                  <div className="flex gap-6 mt-3 text-sm">
                    <span>
                      Qty: {item.quantity} {item.unit}
                    </span>
                    <span>Rate: ₹{item.rate.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Totals */}
            <div className="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-white/10">
              <div className="space-y-2 max-w-sm ml-auto">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Subtotal:</span>
                  <span>₹{quotation.subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>GST ({quotation.gst_percentage}%):</span>
                  <span>₹{quotation.gst_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between text-xl font-bold pt-2 border-t border-white/10">
                  <span>Total:</span>
                  <span className="text-primary">₹{quotation.total_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Payment Milestones */}
          {milestones.length > 0 && (
            <div className="card">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Payment Terms</h2>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {milestones.map((milestone, index) => (
                  <div key={milestone.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-white/5 rounded-lg">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <span className="font-bold">{index + 1}.</span>
                      <span>{milestone.milestone_name}</span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="font-bold">₹{milestone.due_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Terms & Conditions */}
          {quotation.terms_and_conditions && (
            <div className="card">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">Terms & Conditions</h2>
              <p className="text-sm opacity-80 whitespace-pre-line">{quotation.terms_and_conditions}</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Sidebar */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Quick Actions */}
          <div className="card">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Quick Actions</h3>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <button onClick={downloadPDF} className="btn btn--secondary w-full flex items-center gap-2">
                <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                Download PDF
              </button>
              
              {quotation.status !== 'converted' && (
                <button
                  onClick={convertToInvoice}
                  disabled={converting}
                  className="btn btn--primary w-full flex items-center gap-2"
                >
                  <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                  {converting ? 'Converting...' : 'Convert to Invoice'}
                </button>
              )}

              <button className="btn btn--outline w-full flex items-center gap-2">
                <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
                Email to Client
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quotation Info */}
          <div className="card">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Information</h3>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-sm">
              <div>
                <span className="opacity-70">Status:</span>
                <div className="mt-1">
                  <StatusBadge status={quotation.status} />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="opacity-70">Created:</span>
                <p className="mt-1">{new Date(quotation.created_at).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</p>
              </div>
              {quotation.converted_to_invoice_id && (
                <div>
                  <span className="opacity-70">Converted to Invoice:</span>
                  <p className="mt-1">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => router.push(`/invoices/${quotation.converted_to_invoice_id}`)}
                      className="text-primary hover:underline"
                    >
                      View Invoice →
                    </button>
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
