## **PART 3: Enhanced Invoice View with Payment Tracking**

**Create file:** `src/app/invoices/[id]/page.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Download, DollarSign, Check, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import StatusBadge from '@/components/StatusBadge';

export default function InvoiceDetailsPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [invoice, setInvoice] = useState<any>(null);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [milestones, setMilestones] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [client, setClient] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showPaymentModal, setShowPaymentModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedMilestone, setSelectedMilestone] = useState<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchInvoice();
  }, [params.id]);

  const fetchInvoice = async () => {
    try {
      const { data: invoiceData, error: invoiceError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('invoices_enhanced')
        .select(`
          *,
          client:clients(id, name, email, phone, address),
          quotation:quotations(quotation_number)
        `)
        .eq('id', params.id)
        .single();

      if (invoiceError) throw invoiceError;
      setInvoice(invoiceData);
      setClient(Array.isArray(invoiceData.client) ? invoiceData.client[0] : invoiceData.client);

      const { data: itemsData } = await supabaseClient
        .from('invoice_items')
        .select('*')
        .eq('invoice_id', params.id)
        .order('item_number');
      setItems(itemsData || []);

      const { data: milestonesData } = await supabaseClient
        .from('payment_milestones')
        .select('*')
        .eq('invoice_id', params.id);
      setMilestones(milestonesData || []);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to load invoice');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const recordPayment = async (milestoneId: string, amount: number, paymentMethod: string, reference: string) => {
    try {
      // Update milestone
      await supabaseClient
        .from('payment_milestones')
        .update({
          paid_amount: amount,
          paid_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
          status: 'paid',
          payment_method: paymentMethod,
          transaction_reference: reference,
        })
        .eq('id', milestoneId);

      // Calculate total paid
      const totalPaid = milestones.reduce((sum, m) => {
        if (m.id === milestoneId) return sum + amount;
        return sum + (m.paid_amount || 0);
      }, 0);

      const balance = invoice.total_amount - totalPaid;

      // Update invoice
      await supabaseClient
        .from('invoices_enhanced')
        .update({
          paid_amount: totalPaid,
          balance_amount: balance,
          status: balance === 0 ? 'paid' : totalPaid > 0 ? 'partially_paid' : 'unpaid',
        })
        .eq('id', invoice.id);

      // Record transaction
      await supabaseClient.from('transactions').insert([
        {
          transaction_number: `TXN-${Date.now()}`,
          transaction_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
          type: 'income',
          category: 'invoice_payment',
          client_id: invoice.client_id,
          invoice_id: invoice.id,
          amount: amount,
          payment_method: paymentMethod,
          reference_number: reference,
          description: `Payment for ${invoice.invoice_number} - ${selectedMilestone?.milestone_name}`,
        },
      ]);

      toast.success('Payment recorded successfully!');
      setShowPaymentModal(false);
      fetchInvoice();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to record payment');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">Loading invoice...</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!invoice) return null;

  const paidPercentage = (invoice.paid_amount / invoice.total_amount) * 100;

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 max-w-6xl">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-8">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-2">
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold">{invoice.invoice_number}</h1>
            <StatusBadge status={invoice.status} />
          </div>
          <p className="text-lg opacity-80">{invoice.subject}</p>
          {invoice.quotation && (
            <p className="text-sm opacity-60 mt-2">
              From Quotation: {Array.isArray(invoice.quotation) ? invoice.quotation[0]?.quotation_number : invoice.quotation?.quotation_number}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <button className="btn btn--secondary flex items-center gap-2">
            <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
            Download PDF
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
        {/* Main Content */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {/* Payment Status Card */}
          <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500/20 to-emerald-600/20 border-green-500/30">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <h3 className="text-xl font-bold">Payment Status</h3>
              <span className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-300">
                {paidPercentage.toFixed(0)}%
              </span>
            </div>
            
            {/* Progress Bar */}
            <div className="w-full h-4 bg-white/10 rounded-full overflow-hidden mb-4">
              <div
                className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500 to-emerald-500 transition-all duration-500"
                style={{ width: `${paidPercentage}%` }}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-center">
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm opacity-70">Total Amount</div>
                <div className="text-xl font-bold">₹{invoice.total_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm opacity-70">Paid</div>
                <div className="text-xl font-bold text-green-300">₹{invoice.paid_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-sm opacity-70">Balance</div>
                <div className="text-xl font-bold text-orange-300">₹{invoice.balance_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Payment Milestones */}
          {milestones.length > 0 && (
            <div className="card">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Payment Milestones</h2>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {milestones.map((milestone, index) => (
                  <div
                    key={milestone.id}
                    className={`p-4 rounded-lg border ${
                      milestone.status === 'paid'
                        ? 'bg-green-500/10 border-green-500/30'
                        : 'bg-white/5 border-white/10'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        {milestone.status === 'paid' ? (
                          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-green-500/30 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <Check className="w-5 h-5 text-green-300" />
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-orange-500/30 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-300" />
                          </div>
                        )}
                        <div>
                          <h3 className="font-bold">{milestone.milestone_name}</h3>
                          {milestone.status === 'paid' && milestone.paid_date && (
                            <p className="text-xs opacity-70">
                              Paid on {new Date(milestone.paid_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}
                            </p>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <div className="font-bold text-lg">₹{milestone.due_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
                        {milestone.status === 'paid' ? (
                          <span className="text-sm text-green-300">Paid</span>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => {
                              setSelectedMilestone(milestone);
                              setShowPaymentModal(true);
                            }}
                            className="btn btn--sm btn--primary mt-2"
                          >
                            Record Payment
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {milestone.payment_method && (
                      <div className="text-sm opacity-70 mt-2">
                        Method: {milestone.payment_method} | Ref: {milestone.transaction_reference}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Line Items */}
          <div className="card">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Items</h2>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {items.map((item, index) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-lg">
                  <div className="flex justify-between mb-2">
                    <h3 className="font-bold">
                      {index + 1}. {item.description}
                    </h3>
                    <span className="font-bold">₹{item.amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                  </div>
                  {item.specifications && (
                    <p className="text-sm opacity-70 whitespace-pre-line">
                      {typeof item.specifications === 'object' ? item.specifications.notes : item.specifications}
                    </p>
                  )}
                  <div className="flex gap-6 mt-3 text-sm">
                    <span>
                      Qty: {item.quantity} {item.unit}
                    </span>
                    <span>Rate: ₹{item.rate.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Totals */}
            <div className="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-white/10">
              <div className="space-y-2 max-w-sm ml-auto">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>Subtotal:</span>
                  <span>₹{invoice.subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span>GST ({invoice.gst_percentage}%):</span>
                  <span>₹{invoice.gst_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between text-xl font-bold pt-2 border-t border-white/10">
                  <span>Total:</span>
                  <span className="text-primary">₹{invoice.total_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Sidebar */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="card">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Client</h3>
            <p className="text-lg mb-2">{client?.name}</p>
            {client?.email && <p className="text-sm opacity-70">{client.email}</p>}
            {client?.phone && <p className="text-sm opacity-70">{client.phone}</p>}
          </div>

          <div className="card">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Invoice Details</h3>
            <div className="space-y-3 text-sm">
              <div>
                <span className="opacity-70">Issue Date:</span>
                <p className="mt-1">{new Date(invoice.issue_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}</p>
              </div>
              {invoice.due_date && (
                <div>
                  <span className="opacity-70">Due Date:</span>
                  <p className="mt-1">{new Date(invoice.due_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}</p>
                </div>
              )}
              <div>
                <span className="opacity-70">Status:</span>
                <div className="mt-1">
                  <StatusBadge status={invoice.status} />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Payment Modal */}
      {showPaymentModal && selectedMilestone && (
        <PaymentModal
          milestone={selectedMilestone}
          onClose={() => setShowPaymentModal(false)}
          onSubmit={recordPayment}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// Payment Modal Component
function PaymentModal({ milestone, onClose, onSubmit }: any) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    amount: milestone.due_amount,
    paymentMethod: 'bank_transfer',
    reference: '',
  });

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    onSubmit(milestone.id, formData.amount, formData.paymentMethod, formData.reference);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50">
      <div className="card max-w-md w-full mx-4">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Record Payment</h2>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="form-group">
            <label className="form-label">Milestone</label>
            <input type="text" value={milestone.milestone_name} className="form-control bg-white/5" readOnly />
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label className="form-label">Amount (₹)</label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={formData.amount}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, amount: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
              className="form-control"
              step="0.01"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label className="form-label">Payment Method</label>
            <select
              value={formData.paymentMethod}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, paymentMethod: e.target.value })}
              className="form-control"
            >
              <option value="cash">Cash</option>
              <option value="bank_transfer">Bank Transfer</option>
              <option value="cheque">Cheque</option>
              <option value="upi">UPI</option>
              <option value="card">Card</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label className="form-label">Reference Number</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={formData.reference}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, reference: e.target.value })}
              className="form-control"
              placeholder="Transaction ID / Cheque No."
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-3">
            <button type="submit" className="btn btn--primary flex-1">
              <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              Record Payment
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="btn btn--secondary">
              Cancel
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## **PART 4: Bill Book / Ledger Dashboard**

**Create file:** `src/app/billbook/page.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { 
  TrendingUp, 
  TrendingDown, 
  DollarSign, 
  Download,
  Filter,
  Plus,
  Calendar
} from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface Transaction {
  id: string;
  transaction_number: string;
  transaction_date: string;
  type: 'income' | 'expense';
  category: string;
  amount: number;
  payment_method: string;
  description: string;
  client?: { name: string };
  invoice?: { invoice_number: string };
}

export default function BillBookPage() {
  const [transactions, setTransactions] = useState<Transaction[]>([]);
  const [filteredTransactions, setFilteredTransactions] = useState<Transaction[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [dateRange, setDateRange] = useState({
    from: new Date(new Date().getFullYear(), new Date().getMonth(), 1).toISOString().split('T')[0],
    to: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
  });
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState<'all' | 'income' | 'expense'>('all');
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({
    totalIncome: 0,
    totalExpense: 0,
    netBalance: 0,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTransactions();
  }, [dateRange]);

  useEffect(() => {
    applyFilters();
  }, [transactions, filterType]);

  const fetchTransactions = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('transactions')
        .select(`
          *,
          client:clients(name),
          invoice:invoices_enhanced(invoice_number)
        `)
        .gte('transaction_date', dateRange.from)
        .lte('transaction_date', dateRange.to)
        .order('transaction_date', { ascending: false });

      if (error) throw error;
      setTransactions(data || []);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to load transactions');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const applyFilters = () => {
    let filtered = transactions;

    if (filterType !== 'all') {
      filtered = filtered.filter((t) => t.type === filterType);
    }

    setFilteredTransactions(filtered);

    // Calculate stats
    const income = transactions
      .filter((t) => t.type === 'income')
      .reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.amount, 0);
    
    const expense = transactions
      .filter((t) => t.type === 'expense')
      .reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.amount, 0);

    setStats({
      totalIncome: income,
      totalExpense: expense,
      netBalance: income - expense,
    });
  };

  const exportToCSV = () => {
    const headers = ['Date', 'Type', 'Category', 'Description', 'Amount', 'Payment Method', 'Reference'];
    const rows = filteredTransactions.map((t) => [
      t.transaction_date,
      t.type,
      t.category,
      t.description,
      t.amount,
      t.payment_method,
      t.transaction_number,
    ]);

    const csvContent = [headers, ...rows].map((row) => row.join(',')).join('\n');
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv' });
    const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `billbook-${dateRange.from}-to-${dateRange.to}.csv`;
    a.click();
    toast.success('Exported to CSV!');
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2">Bill Book / Ledger</h1>
          <p className="text-lg opacity-80">Track all income and expenses</p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <button onClick={exportToCSV} className="btn btn--secondary flex items-center gap-2">
            <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
            Export CSV
          </button>
          <button className="btn btn--primary flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Add Transaction
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Stats Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mb-8">
        <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500/20 to-emerald-600/20 border-green-500/30">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-green-500/30">
              <TrendingUp className="w-6 h-6 text-green-300" />
            </div>
            <span className="text-sm opacity-70">Income</span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-1">₹{stats.totalIncome.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
          <div className="text-sm opacity-80">Total received</div>
        </div>

        <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-red-500/20 to-pink-600/20 border-red-500/30">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-red-500/30">
              <TrendingDown className="w-6 h-6 text-red-300" />
            </div>
            <span className="text-sm opacity-70">Expense</span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-1">₹{stats.totalExpense.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
          <div className="text-sm opacity-80">Total spent</div>
        </div>

        <div className={`card bg-gradient-to-br ${
          stats.netBalance >= 0 
            ? 'from-blue-500/20 to-purple-600/20 border-blue-500/30' 
            : 'from-orange-500/20 to-red-600/20 border-orange-500/30'
        }`}>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl ${stats.netBalance >= 0 ? 'bg-blue-500/30' : 'bg-orange-500/30'}`}>
              <DollarSign className={`w-6 h-6 ${stats.netBalance >= 0 ? 'text-blue-300' : 'text-orange-300'}`} />
            </div>
            <span className="text-sm opacity-70">Net Balance</span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-1">
            {stats.netBalance >= 0 ? '+' : ''}₹{stats.netBalance.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
          </div>
          <div className="text-sm opacity-80">Profit/Loss</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <div className="card mb-6">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Calendar className="w-5 h-5 opacity-70" />
            <span className="font-medium">Date Range:</span>
          </div>
          
          <input
            type="date"
            value={dateRange.from}
            onChange={(e) => setDateRange({ ...dateRange, from: e.target.value })}
            className="form-control w-40"
          />
          
          <span>to</span>
          
          <input
            type="date"
            value={dateRange.to}
            onChange={(e) => setDateRange({ ...dateRange, to: e.target.value })}
            className="form-control w-40"
          />

          <div className="flex gap-2 ml-auto">
            <button
              onClick={() => setFilterType('all')}
              className={`btn btn--sm ${filterType === 'all' ? 'btn--primary' : 'btn--outline'}`}
            >
              All
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setFilterType('income')}
              className={`btn btn--sm ${filterType === 'income' ? 'btn--primary' : 'btn--outline'}`}
            >
              Income
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setFilterType('expense')}
              className={`btn btn--sm ${filterType === 'expense' ? 'btn--primary' : 'btn--outline'}`}
            >
              Expense
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Transactions Table */}
      <div className="card">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">
          Transactions ({filteredTransactions.length})
        </h2>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="text-center py-12">Loading transactions...</div>
        ) : filteredTransactions.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-12 opacity-60">
            No transactions found for selected filters
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="min-w-full">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-white/10 text-left">
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Date</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Reference</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Type</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Category</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Description</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Payment Method</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4 text-right">Amount</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {filteredTransactions.map((transaction) => (
                  <tr key={transaction.id} className="border-b border-white/5 hover:bg-white/5">
                    <td className="py-4 pr-4">
                      {new Date(transaction.transaction_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-4 pr-4">
                      <span className="font-mono text-sm">{transaction.transaction_number}</span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-4 pr-4">
                      <span
                        className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${
                          transaction.type === 'income'
                            ? 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-300'
                            : 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-300'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {transaction.type === 'income' ? '↑ Income' : '↓ Expense'}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-4 pr-4 capitalize">{transaction.category.replace('_', ' ')}</td>
                    <td className="py-4 pr-4">
                      <div className="max-w-xs">
                        <p className="truncate">{transaction.description}</p>
                        {transaction.client && (
                          <p className="text-xs opacity-70">{Array.isArray(transaction.client) ? transaction.client[0]?.name : transaction.client.name}</p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-4 pr-4 capitalize">{transaction.payment_method.replace('_', ' ')}</td>
                    <td className="py-4 pr-4 text-right">
                      <span
                        className={`font-bold ${
                          transaction.type === 'income' ? 'text-green-300' : 'text-red-300'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {transaction.type === 'income' ? '+' : '-'}₹
                        {transaction.amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Running Balance */}
      <div className="card mt-6 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500/10 to-blue-500/10 border-purple-500/20">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold mb-1">Running Balance (Selected Period)</h3>
            <p className="text-sm opacity-70">Income - Expense = Net</p>
          </div>
          <div className="text-right">
            <div className="text-4xl font-bold text-primary">
              {stats.netBalance >= 0 ? '+' : ''}₹{stats.netBalance.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
export function TransactionModal({ onClose, onSubmit }: { onClose: () => void; onSubmit: (data: any) => void }) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    type: 'expense',
    category: '',
    amount: 0,
    date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    payment_method: 'cash',
    description: '',
  });

  const categories = {
    income: ['invoice_payment', 'advance_payment', 'other_income'],
    expense: ['material_purchase', 'salary', 'rent', 'utilities', 'transport', 'other_expense'],
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    onSubmit(formData);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50">
      <div className="card max-w-md w-full mx-4">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Add Transaction</h2>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="form-group">
            <label className="form-label">Type</label>
            <select
              value={formData.type}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, type: e.target.value as any, category: '' })}
              className="form-control"
            >
              <option value="income">Income</option>
              <option value="expense">Expense</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label className="form-label">Category</label>
            <select
              value={formData.category}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, category: e.target.value })}
              className="form-control"
              required
            >
              <option value="">Select category</option>
              {categories[formData.type as 'income' | 'expense'].map((cat) => (
                <option key={cat} value={cat}>
                  {cat.replace('_', ' ')}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label className="form-label">Amount (₹)</label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={formData.amount}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, amount: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
              className="form-control"
              step="0.01"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label className="form-label">Date</label>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={formData.date}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, date: e.target.value })}
              className="form-control"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label className="form-label">Payment Method</label>
            <select
              value={formData.payment_method}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, payment_method: e.target.value })}
              className="form-control"
            >
              <option value="cash">Cash</option>
              <option value="bank_transfer">Bank Transfer</option>
              <option value="upi">UPI</option>
              <option value="cheque">Cheque</option>
              <option value="card">Card</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label className="form-label">Description</label>
            <textarea
              value={formData.description}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
              className="form-control"
              rows={3}
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-3">
            <button type="submit" className="btn btn--primary flex-1">Add Transaction</button>
            <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="btn btn--secondary">Cancel</button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## **FIXED: src/app/quotations/new/page.tsx**

Replace with this corrected version:

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Plus, Trash2, Save, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface LineItem {
  id: string;
  description: string;
  specifications: string;
  quantity: number;
  unit: string;
  rate: number;
  amount: number;
}

interface PaymentMilestone {
  id: string;
  milestone_name: string;
  percentage: number;
  amount: number;
}

export default function NewQuotationPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [clients, setClients] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    client_id: '',
    project_id: '',
    subject: '',
    date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[^46_0],
    valid_until: '',
    gst_percentage: 12,
    notes: '',
    terms_and_conditions: `• The final cost will be adjusted proportionally if the actual weight is less than estimated.
• The above prices exclude GST (12%), which will be added to the final bill.
• Timeline: Estimated completion in 6-8 months from date of advance payment.
• Installation charges (if required) will be quoted separately.`,
  });

  const [items, setItems] = useState<LineItem[]>([
    {
      id: '1',
      description: 'Sculpture',
      specifications: 'Height: \nMaterial: Brass\nFinish: Antique patina',
      quantity: 1,
      unit: 'unit',
      rate: 0,
      amount: 0,
    },
  ]);

  const [milestones, setMilestones] = useState<PaymentMilestone[]>([
    { id: '1', milestone_name: 'Advance Payment', percentage: 40, amount: 0 },
    { id: '2', milestone_name: 'After Clay Model Approval', percentage: 30, amount: 0 },
    { id: '3', milestone_name: 'Final Delivery', percentage: 30, amount: 0 },
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchClients();
    fetchProjects();
  }, []);

  // ✅ FIXED: Calculate totals using useMemo instead of in render
  const { subtotal, gstAmount, total } = useMemo(() => {
    const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.amount, 0);
    const gstAmount = (subtotal * formData.gst_percentage) / 100;
    const total = subtotal + gstAmount;
    return { subtotal, gstAmount, total };
  }, [items, formData.gst_percentage]);

  // ✅ Update milestones when total changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setMilestones(prev =>
      prev.map((m) => ({
        ...m,
        amount: (total * m.percentage) / 100,
      }))
    );
  }, [total]);

  const fetchClients = async () => {
    const { data } = await supabaseClient
      .from('clients')
      .select('id, name')
      .order('name');
    setClients(data || []);
  };

  const fetchProjects = async () => {
    const { data } = await supabaseClient
      .from('projects')
      .select('id, name, client_id')
      .order('name');
    setProjects(data || []);
  };

  const addItem = () => {
    setItems([
      ...items,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        description: '',
        specifications: '',
        quantity: 1,
        unit: 'unit',
        rate: 0,
        amount: 0,
      },
    ]);
  };

  const removeItem = (id: string) => {
    if (items.length > 1) {
      setItems(items.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
    }
  };

  const updateItem = (id: string, field: string, value: any) => {
    setItems(
      items.map((item) => {
        if (item.id === id) {
          const updated = { ...item, [field]: value };
          // Auto-calculate amount
          if (field === 'quantity' || field === 'rate') {
            updated.amount = updated.quantity * updated.rate;
          }
          return updated;
        }
        return item;
      })
    );
  };

  const updateMilestone = (id: string, field: string, value: any) => {
    setMilestones(
      milestones.map((m) => {
        if (m.id === id) {
          const updated = { ...m, [field]: value };
          // Recalculate amount if percentage changed
          if (field === 'percentage') {
            updated.amount = (total * updated.percentage) / 100;
          }
          return updated;
        }
        return m;
      })
    );
  };

  const addMilestone = () => {
    setMilestones([
      ...milestones,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        milestone_name: '',
        percentage: 0,
        amount: 0,
      },
    ]);
  };

  const removeMilestone = (id: string) => {
    if (milestones.length > 1) {
      setMilestones(milestones.filter((m) => m.id !== id));
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (action: 'draft' | 'finalize') => {
    if (!formData.client_id || !formData.subject) {
      toast.error('Please fill in required fields');
      return;
    }

    if (items.some((item) => !item.description || item.rate === 0)) {
      toast.error('Please complete all line items');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      // Generate quotation number
      const quotationNumber = `QT-${Date.now()}`;

      // Insert quotation
      const { data: quotation, error: quotationError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotations')
        .insert([
          {
            quotation_number: quotationNumber,
            client_id: formData.client_id,
            project_id: formData.project_id || null,
            subject: formData.subject,
            date: formData.date,
            valid_until: formData.valid_until || null,
            status: action === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'sent',
            subtotal,
            gst_percentage: formData.gst_percentage,
            gst_amount: gstAmount,
            total_amount: total,
            notes: formData.notes,
            terms_and_conditions: formData.terms_and_conditions,
          },
        ])
        .select()
        .single();

      if (quotationError) throw quotationError;

      // Insert line items
      const { error: itemsError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotation_items')
        .insert(
          items.map((item, index) => ({
            quotation_id: quotation.id,
            item_number: index + 1,
            description: item.description,
            specifications: { notes: item.specifications },
            quantity: item.quantity,
            unit: item.unit,
            rate: item.rate,
            amount: item.amount,
          }))
        );

      if (itemsError) throw itemsError;

      // Insert payment milestones
      const { error: milestonesError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('payment_milestones')
        .insert(
          milestones.map((m) => ({
            quotation_id: quotation.id,
            milestone_name: m.milestone_name,
            due_amount: m.amount,
            status: 'pending',
          }))
        );

      if (milestonesError) throw milestonesError;

      toast.success('Quotation created successfully!');
      router.push(`/quotations/${quotation.id}`);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to create quotation');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 max-w-6xl">
      <div className="mb-8">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2">Create Quotation</h1>
        <p className="text-lg opacity-80">Generate professional quotations with line items and payment terms</p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
        {/* Main Form - Left Side */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {/* Basic Details */}
          <div className="card">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Basic Information</h2>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-4">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Client *</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.client_id}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, client_id: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  required
                >
                  <option value="">Select client</option>
                  {clients.map((client) => (
                    <option key={client.id} value={client.id}>
                      {client.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Project (Optional)</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.project_id}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, project_id: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                >
                  <option value="">Select project</option>
                  {projects
                    .filter((p) => p.client_id === formData.client_id)
                    .map((project) => (
                      <option key={project.id} value={project.id}>
                        {project.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="form-group mb-4">
              <label className="form-label">Subject *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.subject}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, subject: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
                placeholder="e.g., Quotation for Brass Sculptures"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Date</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={formData.date}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, date: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Valid Until</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={formData.valid_until}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, valid_until: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">GST %</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={formData.gst_percentage}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, gst_percentage: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                  className="form-control"
                  step="0.01"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Line Items */}
          <div className="card">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Line Items</h2>
              <button onClick={addItem} className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm flex items-center gap-2">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                Add Item
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              {items.map((item, index) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-lg border border-white/10">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
                    <h3 className="font-bold">Item {index + 1}</h3>
                    {items.length > 1 && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => removeItem(item.id)}
                        className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid gap-3">
                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="form-label text-sm">Description *</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={item.description}
                        onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'description', e.target.value)}
                        className="form-control"
                        placeholder="e.g., Sculpture of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="form-label text-sm">Specifications</label>
                      <textarea
                        value={item.specifications}
                        onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'specifications', e.target.value)}
                        className="form-control"
                        rows={3}
                        placeholder="Height: 10 feet&#10;Material: Brass&#10;Finish: Antique patina"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Quantity</label>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={item.quantity}
                          onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'quantity', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                          className="form-control"
                          step="0.01"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Unit</label>
                        <select
                          value={item.unit}
                          onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'unit', e.target.value)}
                          className="form-control"
                        >
                          <option value="unit">Unit</option>
                          <option value="kg">Kg</option>
                          <option value="sqft">Sq.Ft</option>
                          <option value="feet">Feet</option>
                        </select>
                      </div>

                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Rate (₹)</label>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={item.rate}
                          onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'rate', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                          className="form-control"
                          step="0.01"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Amount (₹)</label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={item.amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                          className="form-control bg-white/5"
                          readOnly
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Payment Milestones */}
          <div className="card">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Payment Milestones</h2>
              <button onClick={addMilestone} className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm flex items-center gap-2">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                Add Milestone
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              {milestones.map((milestone, index) => (
                <div key={milestone.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold w-8">{index + 1}.</span>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={milestone.milestone_name}
                    onChange={(e) => updateMilestone(milestone.id, 'milestone_name', e.target.value)}
                    className="form-control flex-1"
                    placeholder="Milestone name"
                  />
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    value={milestone.percentage}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      updateMilestone(milestone.id, 'percentage', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)
                    }
                    className="form-control w-24"
                    placeholder="%"
                  />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={`₹${milestone.amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`}
                    className="form-control w-32 bg-white/5"
                    readOnly
                  />
                  {milestones.length > 1 && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => removeMilestone(milestone.id)}
                      className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Terms & Conditions */}
          <div className="card">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">Terms & Conditions</h2>
            <textarea
              value={formData.terms_and_conditions}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, terms_and_conditions: e.target.value })}
              className="form-control"
              rows={6}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Summary Sidebar - Right Side */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Totals Card */}
          <div className="card sticky top-4">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Summary</h3>
            
            <div className="space-y-3 mb-6">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="opacity-70">Subtotal:</span>
                <span className="font-medium">₹{subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="opacity-70">GST ({formData.gst_percentage}%):</span>
                <span className="font-medium">₹{gstAmount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="border-t border-white/10 pt-3">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="font-bold text-lg">Total:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-2xl text-primary">
                    ₹{total.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              <button
                onClick={() => handleSubmit('draft')}
                disabled={loading}
                className="btn btn--secondary w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
              >
                <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                Save as Draft
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleSubmit('finalize')}
                disabled={loading}
                className="btn btn--primary w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
              >
                <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
                {loading ? 'Creating...' : 'Finalize & Create'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Tips */}
          <div className="card bg-blue-500/10 border-blue-500/30">
            <h4 className="font-bold mb-2">💡 Tips</h4>
            <ul className="text-sm space-y-2 opacity-80">
              <li>• Add detailed specifications for clarity</li>
              <li>• Use milestones for large projects</li>
              <li>• Valid until date creates urgency</li>
              <li>• You can download PDF after creation</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## **KEY FIXES:**

1. **✅ Used `useMemo`** - Prevents recalculation on every render
2. **✅ Separate useEffect** - Updates milestones when total changes
3. **✅ Added `|| 0`** - Prevents NaN errors
4. **✅ Better error handling** - Shows actual error message

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Plus, Trash2, Save, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface LineItem {
  id: string;
  description: string;
  specifications: string;
  quantity: number;
  unit: string;
  rate: number;
  amount: number;
}

export default function NewInvoicePage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [clients, setClients] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    client_id: '',
    project_id: '',
    subject: '',
    issue_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    due_date: '',
    gst_percentage: 12,
    payment_terms: '',
  });

  const [items, setItems] = useState<LineItem[]>([
    {
      id: '1',
      description: '',
      specifications: '',
      quantity: 1,
      unit: 'unit',
      rate: 0,
      amount: 0,
    },
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchClients();
    fetchProjects();
  }, []);

  const { subtotal, gstAmount, total } = useMemo(() => {
    const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.amount, 0);
    const gstAmount = (subtotal * formData.gst_percentage) / 100;
    const total = subtotal + gstAmount;
    return { subtotal, gstAmount, total };
  }, [items, formData.gst_percentage]);

  const fetchClients = async () => {
    const { data } = await supabaseClient
      .from('clients')
      .select('id, name')
      .order('name');
    setClients(data || []);
  };

  const fetchProjects = async () => {
    const { data } = await supabaseClient
      .from('projects')
      .select('id, name, client_id')
      .order('name');
    setProjects(data || []);
  };

  const addItem = () => {
    setItems([
      ...items,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        description: '',
        specifications: '',
        quantity: 1,
        unit: 'unit',
        rate: 0,
        amount: 0,
      },
    ]);
  };

  const removeItem = (id: string) => {
    if (items.length > 1) {
      setItems(items.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
    }
  };

  const updateItem = (id: string, field: string, value: any) => {
    setItems(
      items.map((item) => {
        if (item.id === id) {
          const updated = { ...item, [field]: value };
          if (field === 'quantity' || field === 'rate') {
            updated.amount = updated.quantity * updated.rate;
          }
          return updated;
        }
        return item;
      })
    );
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!formData.client_id || !formData.subject) {
      toast.error('Please fill in required fields');
      return;
    }

    if (items.some((item) => !item.description || item.rate === 0)) {
      toast.error('Please complete all line items');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const invoiceNumber = `INV-${Date.now()}`;

      const { data: invoice, error: invoiceError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('invoices_enhanced')
        .insert([
          {
            invoice_number: invoiceNumber,
            client_id: formData.client_id,
            project_id: formData.project_id || null,
            subject: formData.subject,
            issue_date: formData.issue_date,
            due_date: formData.due_date || null,
            status: 'unpaid',
            subtotal,
            gst_percentage: formData.gst_percentage,
            gst_amount: gstAmount,
            total_amount: total,
            paid_amount: 0,
            balance_amount: total,
            payment_terms: formData.payment_terms,
          },
        ])
        .select()
        .single();

      if (invoiceError) throw invoiceError;

      const { error: itemsError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('invoice_items')
        .insert(
          items.map((item, index) => ({
            invoice_id: invoice.id,
            item_number: index + 1,
            description: item.description,
            specifications: { notes: item.specifications },
            quantity: item.quantity,
            unit: item.unit,
            rate: item.rate,
            amount: item.amount,
          }))
        );

      if (itemsError) throw itemsError;

      toast.success('Invoice created successfully!');
      router.push(`/invoices/${invoice.id}`);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to create invoice');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 max-w-6xl">
      <div className="mb-8">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2">Create Invoice</h1>
        <p className="text-lg opacity-80">Generate professional invoices</p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {/* Basic Details */}
          <div className="card">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Basic Information</h2>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-4">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Client *</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.client_id}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, client_id: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  required
                >
                  <option value="">Select client</option>
                  {clients.map((client) => (
                    <option key={client.id} value={client.id}>
                      {client.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Project (Optional)</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.project_id}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, project_id: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                >
                  <option value="">Select project</option>
                  {projects
                    .filter((p) => p.client_id === formData.client_id)
                    .map((project) => (
                      <option key={project.id} value={project.id}>
                        {project.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="form-group mb-4">
              <label className="form-label">Subject *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.subject}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, subject: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
                placeholder="e.g., Invoice for Sculpture Work"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Issue Date</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={formData.issue_date}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, issue_date: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Due Date</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={formData.due_date}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, due_date: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">GST %</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={formData.gst_percentage}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, gst_percentage: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                  className="form-control"
                  step="0.01"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Line Items */}
          <div className="card">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Line Items</h2>
              <button onClick={addItem} className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm flex items-center gap-2">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                Add Item
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              {items.map((item, index) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-lg border border-white/10">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
                    <h3 className="font-bold">Item {index + 1}</h3>
                    {items.length > 1 && (
                      <button onClick={() => removeItem(item.id)} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300">
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid gap-3">
                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="form-label text-sm">Description *</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={item.description}
                        onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'description', e.target.value)}
                        className="form-control"
                        placeholder="Item description"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Quantity</label>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={item.quantity}
                          onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'quantity', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                          className="form-control"
                          step="0.01"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Unit</label>
                        <select
                          value={item.unit}
                          onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'unit', e.target.value)}
                          className="form-control"
                        >
                          <option value="unit">Unit</option>
                          <option value="kg">Kg</option>
                          <option value="sqft">Sq.Ft</option>
                          <option value="feet">Feet</option>
                        </select>
                      </div>

                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Rate (₹)</label>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={item.rate}
                          onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'rate', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                          className="form-control"
                          step="0.01"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Amount (₹)</label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={item.amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                          className="form-control bg-white/5"
                          readOnly
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Summary Sidebar */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="card sticky top-4">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Summary</h3>
            
            <div className="space-y-3 mb-6">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="opacity-70">Subtotal:</span>
                <span className="font-medium">₹{subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="opacity-70">GST ({formData.gst_percentage}%):</span>
                <span className="font-medium">₹{gstAmount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="border-t border-white/10 pt-3">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="font-bold text-lg">Total:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-2xl text-primary">
                    ₹{total.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handleSubmit}
              disabled={loading}
              className="btn btn--primary w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
            >
              <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
              {loading ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Invoice'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// Get recent quotations
const { data: recentQuotations } = await supabaseClient
  .from('quotations')

});
```

```
Hi! To set up the AI task planning system, I need these details:
```

### **STEP 2: Create AI Task Generator**

Once you have answers, I'll build:

**File:** `src/lib/ai-task-generator.ts`

```typescript
import OpenAI from 'openai';

// Use OpenAI or local Gemini API
const openai = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY,
});

export async function generateDailyTasks(projects: Project[]) {
  const prompt = `
    You are an AI assistant for a sculpture studio.
    
    Active Projects:
    ${projects.map(p => `
      - ${p.name}
      - Deadline: ${p.deadline}
      - Budget: ₹${p.budget}
      - Status: ${p.status}
      - Hours spent: ${p.hours_spent}
      - Materials needed: ${p.materials}
    `).join('\n')}
    
    Working hours: 8 hours/day
    Sculpture process: Clay → Mold → Casting → Finishing
    
    Generate a prioritized daily task list with:
    1. Task description
    2. Estimated hours
    3. Priority (high/medium/low)
    4. Reason (why this task today)
    
    Format as JSON array.
  `;

  const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({
    model: 'gpt-4',
    messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }],
    response_format: { type: 'json_object' },
  });

  return JSON.parse(response.choices[^50_0].message.content);
}
```


### **STEP 3: Create Database Table**

```sql
CREATE TABLE ai_task_suggestions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id),
  task_description TEXT NOT NULL,
  estimated_hours DECIMAL(5,2),
  priority TEXT CHECK (priority IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')),
  reasoning TEXT,
  suggested_date DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'completed')),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);
```


### **STEP 4: Create Dashboard Component**

**File:** `src/components/AIDailyPlanner.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { generateDailyTasks } from '@/lib/ai-task-generator';
import { Bot, CheckCircle, Clock } from 'lucide-react';

export default function AIDailyPlanner() {
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchDailyTasks();
  }, []);

  const fetchDailyTasks = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Fetch active projects
      const { data: projects } = await supabaseClient
        .from('projects')
        .select('*')
        .eq('status', 'in_progress');

      // Generate AI suggestions
      const suggestions = await generateDailyTasks(projects);
      setTasks(suggestions);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-500/10 to-blue-500/10 border-purple-500/20">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
        <Bot className="w-6 h-6 text-purple-400" />
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">AI Daily Planner</h2>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="text-center py-8">Generating tasks...</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {tasks.map((task, index) => (
            <div key={index} className="p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-lg border border-white/10">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-2">
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <h3 className="font-bold mb-1">{task.description}</h3>
                  <p className="text-sm opacity-70">{task.reasoning}</p>
                </div>
                <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs ${
                  task.priority === 'high' ? 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-300' :
                  task.priority === 'medium' ? 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-300' :
                  'bg-green-500/20 text-green-300'
                }`}>
                  {task.priority}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>{task.estimated_hours}h</span>
                </div>
                <button className="btn btn--sm btn--primary">
                  <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                  Start Task
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <button onClick={fetchDailyTasks} className="btn btn--secondary w-full mt-4">
        <Bot className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
        Refresh Suggestions
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### **DATABASE SCHEMA ENHANCEMENT:**

**Run this SQL in Supabase:**

```sql
-- Enhanced Materials Table
ALTER TABLE materials ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stock_quantity DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE materials ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS unit TEXT DEFAULT 'kg';
ALTER TABLE materials ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cost_per_unit DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE materials ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reorder_level DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE materials ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS supplier TEXT;
ALTER TABLE materials ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS location TEXT;

-- Material Purchases Table (Track incoming stock)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS material_purchases (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  material_id UUID REFERENCES materials(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  quantity DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  cost_per_unit DECIMAL(10,2),
  total_cost DECIMAL(12,2),
  purchase_date DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  supplier TEXT,
  invoice_number TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Material Usage Table (Track outgoing stock)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS material_usage (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  material_id UUID REFERENCES materials(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  quantity_used DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  usage_date DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  notes TEXT,
  created_by UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Function to auto-update stock on usage
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_material_stock()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Deduct from stock
  UPDATE materials
  SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - NEW.quantity_used
  WHERE id = NEW.material_id;
  
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- Trigger to auto-deduct stock
CREATE TRIGGER material_usage_trigger
AFTER INSERT ON material_usage
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION update_material_stock();

-- Function to auto-update stock on purchase
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_material_stock()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Add to stock
  UPDATE materials
  SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + NEW.quantity
  WHERE id = NEW.material_id;
  
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- Trigger to auto-add stock
CREATE TRIGGER material_purchase_trigger
AFTER INSERT ON material_purchases
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION add_material_stock();
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { Plus, Package, AlertTriangle, TrendingDown, ShoppingCart } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function MaterialsPage() {
  const [materials, setMaterials] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchMaterials();
  }, []);

  const fetchMaterials = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('materials')
        .select('*')
        .order('name');

      if (error) throw error;
      setMaterials(data || []);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to load materials');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const lowStockMaterials = materials.filter(
    (m) => m.stock_quantity <= m.reorder_level
  );

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2">Material Inventory</h1>

        <div className="flex gap-3">

            Record Purchase

          <Link href="/materials/new" className="btn btn--primary flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Add Material
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Stock Alerts */}
      {lowStockMaterials.length > 0 && (
        <div className="card bg-orange-500/10 border-orange-500/30 mb-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6 text-orange-400" />
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">Low Stock Alert</h2>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {lowStockMaterials.map((material) => (
              <div key={material.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-white/5 rounded-lg">
                <span className="font-medium">{material.name}</span>
                <span className="text-orange-300">
                  {material.stock_quantity} {material.unit} remaining
                </span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Stats Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mb-8">
        <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500/20 to-blue-600/20 border-blue-500/30">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/30">
              <Package className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-300" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-1">{materials.length}</div>
          <div className="text-sm opacity-80">Total Materials</div>
        </div>

        <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500/20 to-green-600/20 border-green-500/30">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-green-500/30">
              <TrendingDown className="w-6 h-6 text-green-300" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-1">
            ₹{materials.reduce((sum, m) => sum + (m.stock_quantity * m.cost_per_unit), 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
          </div>
          <div className="text-sm opacity-80">Stock Value</div>
        </div>

        <div className="card bg-gradient-to-br from-orange-500/20 to-red-600/20 border-orange-500/30">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-orange-500/30">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6 text-orange-300" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold mb-1">{lowStockMaterials.length}</div>
          <div className="text-sm opacity-80">Low Stock Items</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Materials Table */}
      <div className="card">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Inventory</h2>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="text-center py-12">Loading materials...</div>
        ) : materials.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-12 opacity-60">No materials found</div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="min-w-full">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-white/10 text-left">

                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Unit</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Cost/Unit</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Total Value</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Status</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 pr-4">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {materials.map((material) => (
                  <tr key={material.id} className="border-b border-white/5 hover:bg-white/5">
```
