                    <td className="py-4 pr-4">{material.unit}</td>
                    <td className="py-4 pr-4">₹{material.cost_per_unit?.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</td>
                    <td className="py-4 pr-4 font-bold">
                      ₹{(material.stock_quantity * material.cost_per_unit).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-4 pr-4">
                      {material.stock_quantity <= material.reorder_level ? (
                        <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-300">
                          Low Stock
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-green-500/20 text-green-300">
                          In Stock
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-4 pr-4">
                      <Link
                        href={`/materials/${material.id}`}
                        className="text-primary hover:text-primary-hover"
                      >
                        View Details
                      </Link>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

## **PART 1: Material Purchase Recording Page**

**Create:** `src/app/materials/purchase/page.tsx`

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ShoppingCart, Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface PurchaseItem {
  id: string;
  material_id: string;
  material_name: string;
  quantity: number;
  cost_per_unit: number;
  total_cost: number;
}

export default function RecordPurchasePage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [materials, setMaterials] = useState<any[]>([]);
  
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    purchase_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    supplier: '',
    invoice_number: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  const [purchaseItems, setPurchaseItems] = useState<PurchaseItem[]>([
    {
      id: '1',
      material_id: '',
      material_name: '',
      quantity: 0,
      cost_per_unit: 0,
      total_cost: 0,
    },
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchMaterials();
  }, []);

  const fetchMaterials = async () => {
    const { data } = await supabaseClient
      .from('materials')
      .select('id, name, unit, cost_per_unit')
      .order('name');
    setMaterials(data || []);
  };

  const addItem = () => {
    setPurchaseItems([
      ...purchaseItems,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        material_id: '',
        material_name: '',
        quantity: 0,
        cost_per_unit: 0,
        total_cost: 0,
      },
    ]);
  };

  const removeItem = (id: string) => {
    if (purchaseItems.length > 1) {
      setPurchaseItems(purchaseItems.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
    }
  };

  const updateItem = (id: string, field: string, value: any) => {
    setPurchaseItems(
      purchaseItems.map((item) => {
        if (item.id === id) {
          const updated = { ...item, [field]: value };
          
          // Auto-fill material name and cost
          if (field === 'material_id') {
            const material = materials.find((m) => m.id === value);
            if (material) {
              updated.material_name = material.name;
              updated.cost_per_unit = material.cost_per_unit || 0;
            }
          }
          
          // Auto-calculate total
          if (field === 'quantity' || field === 'cost_per_unit') {
            updated.total_cost = updated.quantity * updated.cost_per_unit;
          }
          
          return updated;
        }
        return item;
      })
    );
  };

  const totalAmount = purchaseItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.total_cost, 0);

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (purchaseItems.some((item) => !item.material_id || item.quantity <= 0)) {
      toast.error('Please complete all purchase items');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      // Insert all purchase records
      const purchaseRecords = purchaseItems.map((item) => ({
        material_id: item.material_id,
        quantity: item.quantity,
        cost_per_unit: item.cost_per_unit,
        total_cost: item.total_cost,
        purchase_date: formData.purchase_date,
        supplier: formData.supplier,
        invoice_number: formData.invoice_number,
        notes: formData.notes,
      }));

      const { error: purchaseError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('material_purchases')
        .insert(purchaseRecords);

      if (purchaseError) throw purchaseError;

      // Record expense in transactions
      const { error: transactionError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('transactions')
        .insert([
          {
            transaction_number: `MP-${Date.now()}`,
            transaction_date: formData.purchase_date,
            type: 'expense',
            category: 'material_purchase',
            amount: totalAmount,
            payment_method: 'bank_transfer',
            reference_number: formData.invoice_number,
            description: `Material purchase from ${formData.supplier || 'supplier'} - ${purchaseItems.length} items`,
          },
        ]);

      if (transactionError) throw transactionError;

      toast.success('Purchase recorded successfully! Stock updated.');
      router.push('/materials');
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to record purchase');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 max-w-6xl">
      <div className="mb-8">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2">Record Material Purchase</h1>
        <p className="text-lg opacity-80">Add materials to inventory and track expenses</p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {/* Purchase Details */}
          <div className="card">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Purchase Information</h2>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-4">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Purchase Date</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={formData.purchase_date}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, purchase_date: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Invoice Number</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.invoice_number}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, invoice_number: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="INV-001"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="form-group mb-4">
              <label className="form-label">Supplier</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.supplier}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, supplier: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
                placeholder="Supplier name"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="form-group">
              <label className="form-label">Notes</label>
              <textarea
                value={formData.notes}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, notes: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
                rows={3}
                placeholder="Additional notes about this purchase"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Purchase Items */}
          <div className="card">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Materials Purchased</h2>
              <button onClick={addItem} className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm flex items-center gap-2">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                Add Material
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              {purchaseItems.map((item, index) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-lg border border-white/10">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
                    <h3 className="font-bold">Material {index + 1}</h3>
                    {purchaseItems.length > 1 && (
                      <button onClick={() => removeItem(item.id)} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300">
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid gap-3">
                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="form-label text-sm">Material *</label>
                      <select
                        value={item.material_id}
                        onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'material_id', e.target.value)}
                        className="form-control"
                        required
                      >
                        <option value="">Select material</option>
                        {materials.map((material) => (
                          <option key={material.id} value={material.id}>
                            {material.name} ({material.unit})
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Quantity</label>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={item.quantity}
                          onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'quantity', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                          className="form-control"
                          step="0.01"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Cost/Unit (₹)</label>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={item.cost_per_unit}
                          onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'cost_per_unit', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                          className="form-control"
                          step="0.01"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="form-group">
                        <label className="form-label text-sm">Total (₹)</label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={item.total_cost.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                          className="form-control bg-white/5"
                          readOnly
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Summary Sidebar */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="card sticky top-4">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Purchase Summary</h3>

            <div className="space-y-3 mb-6">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="opacity-70">Items:</span>
                <span className="font-medium">{purchaseItems.length}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="opacity-70">Supplier:</span>
                <span className="font-medium">{formData.supplier || '-'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="border-t border-white/10 pt-3">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="font-bold text-lg">Total Amount:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-2xl text-primary">
                    ₹{totalAmount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handleSubmit}
              disabled={loading}
              className="btn btn--primary w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
            >
              <ShoppingCart className="w-4 h-4" />
              {loading ? 'Recording...' : 'Record Purchase'}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Info Card */}
          <div className="card bg-blue-500/10 border-blue-500/30">
            <h4 className="font-bold mb-2">💡 Auto-Updates</h4>
            <ul className="text-sm space-y-2 opacity-80">
              <li>• Stock quantities will auto-increase</li>
              <li>• Expense recorded in bill book</li>
              <li>• Cost per unit updated if changed</li>
              <li>• Purchase history tracked</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Add this component inside your project details page

function MaterialUsageSection({ projectId }: { projectId: string }) {
  const [materials, setMaterials] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [usage, setUsage] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedMaterial, setSelectedMaterial] = useState('');
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchMaterials();
    fetchUsage();
  }, []);

  const fetchMaterials = async () => {
    const { data } = await supabaseClient
      .from('materials')
      .select('*')
      .order('name');
    setMaterials(data || []);
  };

  const fetchUsage = async () => {
    const { data } = await supabaseClient
      .from('material_usage')
      .select(`
        *,
        material:materials(name, unit, cost_per_unit)
      `)
      .eq('project_id', projectId)
      .order('usage_date', { ascending: false });
    setUsage(data || []);
  };

  const recordUsage = async () => {
    if (!selectedMaterial || quantity <= 0) {
      toast.error('Please select material and enter quantity');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('material_usage')
        .insert([
          {
            material_id: selectedMaterial,
            project_id: projectId,
            quantity_used: quantity,
            usage_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
          },
        ]);

      if (error) throw error;

      toast.success('Material usage recorded! Stock updated.');
      setShowModal(false);
      setSelectedMaterial('');
      setQuantity(0);
      fetchUsage();
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to record usage');
    }
  };

  const totalCost = usage.reduce((sum, u) => {
    const material = Array.isArray(u.material) ? u.material[0] : u.material;
    return sum + (u.quantity_used * (material?.cost_per_unit || 0));
  }, 0);

  return (
    <div className="card">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Material Usage</h2>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowModal(true)}
          className="btn btn--primary btn--sm flex items-center gap-2"
        >
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          Record Usage
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Usage Summary */}
      <div className="p-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500/10 to-blue-500/10 rounded-lg border border-purple-500/20 mb-6">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="text-lg">Total Material Cost</span>
          <span className="text-3xl font-bold text-primary">₹{totalCost.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Usage List */}
      {usage.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-8 opacity-60">No materials used yet</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {usage.map((u) => {
            const material = Array.isArray(u.material) ? u.material[0] : u.material;
            return (
              <div key={u.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-lg">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-bold">{material?.name}</h3>
                  <p className="text-sm opacity-70">
                    {new Date(u.usage_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <div className="font-bold">
                    {u.quantity_used} {material?.unit}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-sm opacity-70">
                    ₹{(u.quantity_used * (material?.cost_per_unit || 0)).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Record Usage Modal */}
      {showModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50">
          <div className="card max-w-md w-full mx-4">
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Record Material Usage</h3>

            <div className="form-group mb-4">
              <label className="form-label">Material</label>
              <select
                value={selectedMaterial}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedMaterial(e.target.value)}
                className="form-control"
              >
                <option value="">Select material</option>
                {materials.map((material) => (
                  <option key={material.id} value={material.id}>
                    {material.name} (Stock: {material.stock_quantity} {material.unit})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="form-group mb-6">
              <label className="form-label">Quantity Used</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={quantity}
                onChange={(e) => setQuantity(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                className="form-control"
                step="0.01"
                placeholder="0.00"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <button onClick={recordUsage} className="btn btn--primary flex-1">
                Record Usage
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => setShowModal(false)} className="btn btn--secondary">
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { Plus, Trash2, Package } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface MaterialsSectionProps {
  projectId: string;
  projectMaterials?: any[];
}

export default function MaterialsSection({ projectId, projectMaterials = [] }: MaterialsSectionProps) {
  const [materials, setMaterials] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [usage, setUsage] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    material_id: '',
    quantity_used: 0,
    notes: '',
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchMaterials();
    fetchUsage();
  }, [projectId]);

  const fetchMaterials = async () => {
    const { data } = await supabaseClient
      .from('materials')
      .select('id, name, unit, cost_per_unit, stock_quantity')
      .order('name');
    setMaterials(data || []);
  };

  const fetchUsage = async () => {
    const { data } = await supabaseClient
      .from('material_usage')
      .select(`
        *,
        material:materials(name, unit, cost_per_unit)
      `)
      .eq('project_id', projectId)
      .order('usage_date', { ascending: false });
    setUsage(data || []);
  };

  const recordUsage = async () => {
    if (!formData.material_id || formData.quantity_used <= 0) {
      toast.error('Please select material and enter quantity');
      return;
    }

    // Check if enough stock
    const selectedMaterial = materials.find((m) => m.id === formData.material_id);
    if (selectedMaterial && formData.quantity_used > selectedMaterial.stock_quantity) {
      toast.error(`Not enough stock! Available: ${selectedMaterial.stock_quantity} ${selectedMaterial.unit}`);
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('material_usage')
        .insert([
          {
            material_id: formData.material_id,
            project_id: projectId,
            quantity_used: formData.quantity_used,
            usage_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
            notes: formData.notes,
          },
        ]);

      if (error) throw error;

      toast.success('Material usage recorded! Stock updated.');
      setShowModal(false);
      setFormData({ material_id: '', quantity_used: 0, notes: '' });
      fetchUsage();
      fetchMaterials(); // Refresh to show updated stock
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to record usage');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const deleteUsage = async (usageId: string, materialId: string, quantityUsed: number) => {
    if (!confirm('Delete this usage record? Stock will be restored.')) return;

    try {
      // Manually restore stock (since we're deleting, not adding back)
      await supabaseClient
        .from('materials')
        .update({ 
          stock_quantity: supabaseClient.raw(`stock_quantity + ${quantityUsed}`)
        })
        .eq('id', materialId);

      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('material_usage')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', usageId);

      if (error) throw error;

      toast.success('Usage deleted and stock restored');
      fetchUsage();
      fetchMaterials();
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error(error);
      toast.error('Failed to delete usage');
    }
  };

  const totalCost = usage.reduce((sum, u) => {
    const material = Array.isArray(u.material) ? u.material[0] : u.material;
    return sum + (u.quantity_used * (material?.cost_per_unit || 0));
  }, 0);

  const totalQuantity = usage.length;

  return (
    <div className="card">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Package className="w-6 h-6" />
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Material Usage</h2>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowModal(true)}
          className="btn btn--primary btn--sm flex items-center gap-2"
        >
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          Record Usage
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Summary Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-6">
        <div className="p-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500/10 to-blue-500/10 rounded-lg border border-purple-500/20">
          <div className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-1">Total Material Cost</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">₹{totalCost.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500/10 to-emerald-500/10 rounded-lg border border-green-500/20">
          <div className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-1">Materials Used</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{totalQuantity} types</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Usage List */}
      {usage.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-12 opacity-60">
          <Package className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <p>No materials used yet</p>
          <button onClick={() => setShowModal(true)} className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm mt-4">
            Record First Usage
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {usage.map((u) => {
            const material = Array.isArray(u.material) ? u.material[0] : u.material;
            const cost = u.quantity_used * (material?.cost_per_unit || 0);
            
            return (
              <div key={u.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-lg border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors">
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <h3 className="font-bold mb-1">{material?.name}</h3>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm opacity-70">
                    <span>{new Date(u.usage_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}</span>
                    <span>•</span>
                    <span>{u.quantity_used} {material?.unit}</span>
                    {u.notes && (
                      <>
                        <span>•</span>
                        <span>{u.notes}</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="font-bold text-lg">₹{cost.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs opacity-60">@ ₹{material?.cost_per_unit}/unit</div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => deleteUsage(u.id, u.material_id, u.quantity_used)}
                    className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 p-2"
                    title="Delete and restore stock"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Record Usage Modal */}
      {showModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50">
          <div className="card max-w-md w-full mx-4">
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Record Material Usage</h3>

            <div className="form-group mb-4">
              <label className="form-label">Material *</label>
              <select
                value={formData.material_id}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, material_id: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
              >
                <option value="">Select material</option>
                {materials.map((material) => (
                  <option key={material.id} value={material.id}>
                    {material.name} - Stock: {material.stock_quantity} {material.unit}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="form-group mb-4">
              <label className="form-label">Quantity Used *</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={formData.quantity_used}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, quantity_used: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                className="form-control"
                step="0.01"
                placeholder="0.00"
              />
              {formData.material_id && (
                <p className="text-xs opacity-70 mt-1">
                  Available: {materials.find(m => m.id === formData.material_id)?.stock_quantity || 0} {materials.find(m => m.id === formData.material_id)?.unit}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="form-group mb-6">
              <label className="form-label">Notes (Optional)</label>
              <textarea
                value={formData.notes}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, notes: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
                rows={2}
                placeholder="e.g., Used for base structure"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <button 
                onClick={recordUsage} 
                disabled={loading}
                className="btn btn--primary flex-1"
              >
                {loading ? 'Recording...' : 'Record Usage'}
              </button>
              <button 
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowModal(false);
                  setFormData({ material_id: '', quantity_used: 0, notes: '' });
                }}
                className="btn btn--secondary"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## **What This Does:**

✅ **Uses your existing component structure**
✅ **Auto-deducts from stock** (via database trigger)
✅ **Shows available stock** before recording
✅ **Prevents over-usage** (validates stock)
✅ **Calculates material cost** per project
✅ **Can delete usage** and restore stock
✅ **Beautiful UI** matching your design system
✅ **Already integrated** into your project page

# "use client";

import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { ProjectMaterial } from '@/types';
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Plus, Settings, X, Trash2, Package, DollarSign } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';
import Button from '@/components/ui/Button';

interface Material {
id: string;
name: string;
unit: string;
cost_per_unit: number;
quantity: number;
}

interface MaterialsSectionProps {
projectId: string;
materials: ProjectMaterial[];
}

export default function MaterialsSection({ projectId, materials }: MaterialsSectionProps) {
const [allMaterials, setAllMaterials] = useState<Material[]>([]);
const [projectMaterials, setProjectMaterials] = useState<ProjectMaterial[]>(materials || []);
const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

// Modal states
const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);
const [showCreateModal, setShowCreateModal] = useState(false);

// Add material modal state
const [selectedMaterialId, setSelectedMaterialId] = useState('');
const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(0);

// Create material modal state
const [newMaterial, setNewMaterial] = useState({
name: '',
unit: 'kg',
cost_per_unit: 0,
quantity: 0
});

useEffect(() => {
fetchMaterials();
fetchProjectMaterials();
}, [projectId]);

const fetchMaterials = async () => {
const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
.from('materials')
.select('*')
.order('name');
if (!error \&\& data) {
setAllMaterials(data);
}
};

const fetchProjectMaterials = async () => {
const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
.from('project_materials')
.select(`        id,         quantity_used,         cost,         material:material_id(id, name, unit, cost_per_unit)      `)
.eq('project_id', projectId);

    if (!error && data) {
      setProjectMaterials(data as any);
    }
    };

// Add existing material to project
const handleAddMaterial = async () => {
if (!selectedMaterialId || quantity <= 0) {
toast.error('Please select a material and enter quantity');
return;
}

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const material = allMaterials.find(m => m.id === selectedMaterialId);
      const cost = (material?.cost_per_unit || 0) * quantity;
    
    
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('project_materials')
        .insert({
          project_id: projectId,
          material_id: selectedMaterialId,
          quantity_used: quantity,
          cost: cost
        });
    
    
      if (error) throw error;
    
    
      // Update project actual_cost
      const { data: allPM } = await supabaseClient
        .from('project_materials')
        .select('cost')
        .eq('project_id', projectId);
      const total = (allPM || []).reduce((acc: number, p: any) => acc + (p.cost || 0), 0);
      await supabaseClient
        .from('projects')
        .update({ actual_cost: total })
        .eq('id', projectId);
    
    
      // Reset and refresh
      setSelectedMaterialId('');
      setQuantity(0);
      setShowAddModal(false);
      await fetchProjectMaterials();
      toast.success('Material added successfully!');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error adding material:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to add material');
    }
    setLoading(false);
    };

// Create new material and add to materials table
const handleCreateMaterial = async () => {
if (!newMaterial.name || newMaterial.cost_per_unit <= 0) {
toast.error('Please fill all required fields');
return;
}

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const { data: createdMaterial, error: createError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('materials')
        .insert({
          name: newMaterial.name,
          unit: newMaterial.unit,
          cost_per_unit: newMaterial.cost_per_unit,
          quantity: newMaterial.quantity,
          low_stock_threshold: 10
        })
        .select()
        .single();
    
    
      if (createError) throw createError;
    
    
      // Refresh materials list
      await fetchMaterials();
      
      // Reset form
      setNewMaterial({
        name: '',
        unit: 'kg',
        cost_per_unit: 0,
        quantity: 0
      });
      setShowCreateModal(false);
      toast.success('Material created successfully!');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating material:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to create material');
    }
    setLoading(false);
    };

// Delete material from project
const handleDeleteMaterial = async (materialId: string) => {
if (!confirm('Remove this material from project?')) return;

    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('project_materials')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', materialId);
    
    
      if (error) throw error;
    
    
      await fetchProjectMaterials();
      toast.success('Material removed');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error deleting material:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to delete material');
    }
    };

const calculateTotal = () => {
return projectMaterials.reduce((sum, material) =>
sum + (material.cost || 0), 0);
};

const selectedMaterial = allMaterials.find(m => m.id === selectedMaterialId);

return (

```typescript
'use client';

import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { Plus, Settings, X, Trash2, Package, DollarSign, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';
import Button from '@/components/ui/Button';

interface Material {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  unit: string;
  cost_per_unit: number;
  stock_quantity: number;
}

interface MaterialUsage {
  id: string;
  material_id: string;
  quantity_used: number;
  usage_date: string;
  notes: string;
  material: Material;
}

interface MaterialsSectionProps {
  projectId: string;
  materials?: any[];
}

export default function MaterialsSection({ projectId, materials = [] }: MaterialsSectionProps) {
  const [allMaterials, setAllMaterials] = useState<Material[]>([]);
  const [materialUsage, setMaterialUsage] = useState<MaterialUsage[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  
  // Modal states
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);
  const [showCreateModal, setShowCreateModal] = useState(false);
  
  // Add material modal state
  const [selectedMaterialId, setSelectedMaterialId] = useState('');
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(0);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  
  // Create material modal state
  const [newMaterial, setNewMaterial] = useState({
    name: '',
    unit: 'kg',
    cost_per_unit: 0,
    stock_quantity: 0,
    reorder_level: 10
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchMaterials();
    fetchMaterialUsage();
  }, [projectId]);

  const fetchMaterials = async () => {
    const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
      .from('materials')
      .select('*')
      .order('name');
    if (!error && data) {
      setAllMaterials(data);
    }
  };

  const fetchMaterialUsage = async () => {
    const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
      .from('material_usage')
      .select(`
        *,
        material:materials(id, name, unit, cost_per_unit)
      `)
      .eq('project_id', projectId)
      .order('usage_date', { ascending: false });
    
    if (!error && data) {
      setMaterialUsage(data as any);
    }
  };

  // Record material usage with auto-stock deduction
  const handleAddMaterial = async () => {
    if (!selectedMaterialId || quantity <= 0) {
      toast.error('Please select a material and enter quantity');
      return;
    }

    const selectedMaterial = allMaterials.find(m => m.id === selectedMaterialId);
    
    if (!selectedMaterial) {
      toast.error('Material not found');
      return;
    }

    if (quantity > selectedMaterial.stock_quantity) {
      toast.error(`Not enough stock! Available: ${selectedMaterial.stock_quantity} ${selectedMaterial.unit}`);
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Insert usage record (trigger will auto-deduct from stock)
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('material_usage')
        .insert({
          project_id: projectId,
          material_id: selectedMaterialId,
          quantity_used: quantity,
          usage_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
          notes: notes || null,
        });

      if (error) throw error;

      // Reset and refresh
      setSelectedMaterialId('');
      setQuantity(0);
      setNotes('');
      setShowAddModal(false);
      await fetchMaterialUsage();
      await fetchMaterials();
      toast.success('Material usage recorded! Stock updated automatically.');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error adding material:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to record material usage');
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  // Create new material
  const handleCreateMaterial = async () => {
    if (!newMaterial.name || newMaterial.cost_per_unit <= 0) {
      toast.error('Please fill all required fields');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const { data: createdMaterial, error: createError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('materials')
        .insert({
          name: newMaterial.name,
          unit: newMaterial.unit,
          cost_per_unit: newMaterial.cost_per_unit,
          stock_quantity: newMaterial.stock_quantity,
          reorder_level: newMaterial.reorder_level
        })
        .select()
        .single();

      if (createError) throw createError;

      // Refresh materials list
      await fetchMaterials();
      
      // Reset form
      setNewMaterial({
        name: '',
        unit: 'kg',
        cost_per_unit: 0,
        stock_quantity: 0,
        reorder_level: 10
      });
      setShowCreateModal(false);
      toast.success('Material created successfully!');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating material:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to create material');
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  // Delete material usage (restores stock)
  const handleDeleteUsage = async (usageId: string, materialId: string, quantityUsed: number) => {
    if (!confirm('Delete this material usage? Stock will be restored.')) return;

    try {
      // Delete usage (trigger will auto-restore stock)
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('material_usage')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', usageId);

      if (error) throw error;

      await fetchMaterialUsage();
      await fetchMaterials();
      toast.success('Material usage deleted and stock restored');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error deleting usage:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to delete usage');
    }
  };

  const calculateTotal = () => {
    return materialUsage.reduce((sum, usage) => {
      const material = Array.isArray(usage.material) ? usage.material[0] : usage.material;
      return sum + (usage.quantity_used * (material?.cost_per_unit || 0));
    }, 0);
  };

  const selectedMaterial = allMaterials.find(m => m.id === selectedMaterialId);
  const lowStockMaterials = allMaterials.filter(m => m.stock_quantity <= m.reorder_level);

  return (
    <>
      {/* Main Materials Card - Glassmorphic */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-lg p-6 shadow-xl">
        {/* Header with action buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-500/20 to-pink-500/20 border border-white/10">
              <Package className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white">Materials Used</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-white/60 mt-1">
                {materialUsage.length} materials tracked • Total: {formatCurrency(calculateTotal())}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowAddModal(true)}
              className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-blue-600 hover:to-blue-700 text-white transition-all shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:scale-105"
              title="Record Material Usage"
            >
              <Plus className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(true)}
              className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/20 text-white transition-all"
              title="Create New Material"
            >
              <Settings className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Low Stock Alert */}
        {lowStockMaterials.length > 0 && (
          <div className="mb-6 rounded-xl bg-orange-500/10 border border-orange-500/20 p-4 flex items-start gap-3">
            <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div>
              <p className="font-semibold text-white mb-1">Low Stock Alert</p>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                {lowStockMaterials.map(m => (
                  <p key={m.id} className="text-sm text-orange-300">
                    {m.name}: {m.stock_quantity} {m.unit} remaining
                  </p>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Materials List */}
        {materialUsage.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-16">
            <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-500/20 to-pink-500/20 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4 border border-white/10">
              <Package className="w-10 h-10 text-white/60" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-white/70 text-base mb-2 font-medium">No materials used yet</p>
            <p className="text-white/40 text-sm mb-6">Click the + button to record material usage</p>
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowAddModal(true)}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-blue-600 hover:to-blue-700 text-white font-medium transition-all"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              Record First Usage
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <ul className="space-y-3">
              {materialUsage.map((usage) => {
                const material = Array.isArray(usage.material) ? usage.material[0] : usage.material;
                const cost = usage.quantity_used * (material?.cost_per_unit || 0);
                
                return (
                  <li 
                    key={usage.id} 
                    className="relative group rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-gradient-to-r from-white/5 to-white/10 hover:from-white/10 hover:to-white/15 p-4 transition-all duration-300"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="flex-1 flex items-center gap-4">
                        <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500/20 to-purple-500/20 border border-white/10">
                          <Package className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex-1">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                            <p className="text-white font-semibold text-base">{material?.name}</p>
                            <span className="text-xs bg-white/10 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-white/70">
                              {new Date(usage.usage_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-sm text-white/60">
                            {usage.quantity_used} {material?.unit} @ {formatCurrency(material?.cost_per_unit || 0)}/unit
                          </p>
                          {usage.notes && (
                            <p className="text-xs text-white/50 mt-1 italic">"{usage.notes}"</p>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <div className="text-right">
                          <p className="text-white font-bold text-lg tabular-nums">
                            {formatCurrency(cost)}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteUsage(usage.id, usage.material_id, usage.quantity_used)}
                          className="p-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 hover:bg-red-500/20 rounded-lg transition-all border border-transparent hover:border-red-500/30"
                          title="Delete usage and restore stock"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>

            {/* Total Cost - Prominent */}
            <div className="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-white/10">
              <div className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500/20 to-purple-500/20 border border-white/20 px-6 py-5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-white/10">
                      <DollarSign className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
                    </div>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-white text-lg">Total Material Cost</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-3xl font-bold text-white tabular-nums">
                    {formatCurrency(calculateTotal())}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Add Material Usage Modal - Glassmorphic */}
      {showAddModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4 animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-white/20 bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-900/95 to-gray-800/95 backdrop-blur-xl max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-2xl animate-slideUp">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500/20 to-purple-500/20 border border-white/10">
                  <Plus className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white">Record Usage</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowAddModal(false);
                  setSelectedMaterialId('');
                  setQuantity(0);
                  setNotes('');
                }}
                className="p-2 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-lg transition-colors"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5 text-white/60 hover:text-white" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-5">
              {/* Material Selector */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-white/80 mb-2">
                  Select Material *
                </label>
                <select
                  value={selectedMaterialId}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedMaterialId(e.target.value)}
                  className="block w-full rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-4 py-3 text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent transition-all"
                >
                  <option value="" className="bg-gray-800">Select a material...</option>
                  {allMaterials.map((m) => (
                    <option key={m.id} value={m.id} className="bg-gray-800">
                      {m.name} — Stock: {m.stock_quantity} {m.unit}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              {/* Quantity Input */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-white/80 mb-2">
                  Quantity Used *
                </label>
                <div className="flex gap-3 items-center">
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    value={quantity || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => setQuantity(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="block flex-1 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder:text-white/30 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent transition-all"
                    placeholder="0"
                    min="0"
                    step="0.01"
                  />
                  <span className="text-sm text-white/60 font-medium whitespace-nowrap min-w-[50px] text-center px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-white/5 border border-white/10">
                    {selectedMaterial?.unit || '-'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {selectedMaterial && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-white/50 mt-2">
                    Available: {selectedMaterial.stock_quantity} {selectedMaterial.unit}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Notes Input */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-white/80 mb-2">
                  Notes (optional)
                </label>
                <textarea
                  value={notes}
                  onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                  className="block w-full rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder:text-white/30 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent transition-all resize-none"
                  placeholder="e.g., Used for base structure"
                  rows={2}
                />
              </div>

              {/* Cost Preview - Prominent */}
              {selectedMaterial && quantity > 0 && (
                <div className="rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500/10 to-emerald-500/10 border border-green-500/20 p-4 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="text-white/60">Cost per unit:</span>
                    <span className="text-white font-medium">{formatCurrency(selectedMaterial.cost_per_unit)}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center pt-2 border-t border-white/10">
                    <span className="text-white font-semibold">Total Cost:</span>
                    <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{formatCurrency(quantity * selectedMaterial.cost_per_unit)}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Actions */}
              <div className="flex gap-3 pt-2">
                <Button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setShowAddModal(false);
                    setSelectedMaterialId('');
                    setQuantity(0);
                    setNotes('');
                  }}

                  className="flex-1 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border-white/10 rounded-xl"
                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>
                <Button

                  Record Usage

              </div>
            </div>

      {/* Create New Material Modal - Glassmorphic */}
      {showCreateModal && (

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

                  placeholder="e.g., Bronze, Marble, Steel"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Unit */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-white/80 mb-2">
                  Unit *
                </label>
                <select
                  value={newMaterial.unit}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewMaterial({ ...newMaterial, unit: e.target.value })}
                  className="block w-full rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-4 py-3 text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 focus:border-transparent transition-all"

***

## **✨ KEY UPGRADES:**

✅ **Uses `material_usage` table** (not `project_materials`)
✅ **Auto-deducts from stock** via database trigger

# **🚀 PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION GUIDE**

## **DIAGNOSIS: Why is it slow?**

Common culprits:

1. ❌ **Multiple database queries** on every page load
2. ❌ **No caching** - fetching same data repeatedly
3. ❌ **Large nested queries** with multiple joins
4. ❌ **Client-side calculations** in render loops
5. ❌ **No pagination** on large lists
6. ❌ **Heavy glassmorphic effects** (backdrop-blur)

***

## **⚡ OPTIMIZATION STRATEGY**

### **PHASE 1: Quick Wins (Do This Now - 5 min)**

#### **1. Add Loading States Properly**

Your users perceive speed better with loading states:

```

}

#### **2. Optimize Queries - Limit \& Select Only What You Need**

```

**Good (Fast):**

  .limit(50) // Pagination!
  .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
```


***

### **PHASE 3: React Optimization (15 min)**

#### **1. Memoize Expensive Calculations**

**Already done in quotations/invoices, do everywhere:**

```typescript
// ❌ BAD - Recalculates on every render
function ProjectCard({ project }) {
  const totalCost = project.materials.reduce(...); // Slow!
  const progress = calculateProgress(project); // Slow!
}

// ✅ GOOD - Only calculates when dependencies change
function ProjectCard({ project }) {
  const totalCost = useMemo(
    () => project.materials.reduce(...),
    [project.materials]
  );
  
  const progress = useMemo(
    () => calculateProgress(project),
    [project.tasks]
  );
}
```


#### **2. Add React.memo to List Items**

```typescript
// Wrap repeated components
const ProjectCard = React.memo(({ project }) => {
  // ... component code
});

const TaskItem = React.memo(({ task }) => {
  // ... component code
});
```


#### **3. Lazy Load Heavy Components**

```typescript
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic';

// Don't load until needed
const AIDailyPlanner = dynamic(() => import('@/components/AIDailyPlanner'), {
  loading: () => <div>Loading AI Planner...</div>,
  ssr: false // Don't render on server
});
```

### **PHASE 4: Pagination (Critical for Scale)**

#### **Dashboard - Limit Recent Activity**

  .from('tasks')
  .select('*')

```


#### **Projects List - Add Pagination**

**Create:** `src/components/Pagination.tsx`

```typescript
export default function Pagination({ currentPage, totalPages, onPageChange }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 mt-6">
      <button
        onClick={() => onPageChange(currentPage - 1)}
        disabled={currentPage === 1}
        className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm"
      >
        Previous
      </button>
      <span className="text-sm">
        Page {currentPage} of {totalPages}
      </span>
      <button
        onClick={() => onPageChange(currentPage + 1)}
        disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
        className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm"
      >
        Next
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Use in projects page:**

```typescript
const ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 10;
const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

const { data: projects, count } = await supabaseClient
  .from('projects')
  .select('*', { count: 'exact' })
  .range((page - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE, page * ITEMS_PER_PAGE - 1)
  .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

const totalPages = Math.ceil((count || 0) / ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
```


***

### **PHASE 5: Caching (Advanced - 20 min)**

#### **Create Reusable Cache Hook**

**Create:** `src/hooks/useCache.ts`

```typescript
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

const cache = new Map();

export function useCache<T>(key: string, fetcher: () => Promise<T>, ttl = 60000) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<T | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const cached = cache.get(key);
    const now = Date.now();

    if (cached && now - cached.timestamp < ttl) {
      setData(cached.data);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    fetcher().then((result) => {
      cache.set(key, { data: result, timestamp: now });
      setData(result);
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, [key]);

  return { data, loading };
}
```

**Usage:**

```typescript
// Instead of fetching every time:
const { data: clients, loading } = useCache(
  'clients-list',
  async () => {
    const { data } = await supabaseClient.from('clients').select('*');
    return data;
  },
  60000 // Cache for 1 minute
);
```

## **PRIORITY 3: Optimize Project Details Query (CRITICAL - 2 min)**

**File:** `src/app/projects/[id]/page.tsx`

**Change from:**

```typescript
const { data, error } = await supabase
  .from('projects')
  .select(`
    *,
    client:clients(*),

**To this (10x faster):**

const { data, error } = await supabase
  .from('projects')
  .select(`
    *,
    client:clients(id, name, email, phone),
    tasks(id, title, status, due_date, assignee_id).order(created_at.desc).limit(50),

    photos(id, url, caption).order(created_at.desc).limit(20)
  `)
  .eq('id', params.id)
  .single();

### **Option 2: Enable RLS (Before Deployment)**

When you're ready to deploy, enable Row Level Security:

**Run this SQL to secure all tables:**

```sql
-- Enable RLS on all tables
ALTER TABLE clients ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE projects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE tasks ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE time_entries ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE materials ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE project_materials ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE material_usage ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE material_purchases ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE photos ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE quotations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE quotation_items ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE invoices_enhanced ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE invoice_items ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE payment_milestones ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Create policies to allow all operations (since it's a single-business app)
-- You can make these more restrictive later if needed

-- Clients
CREATE POLICY "Allow all operations on clients" ON clients FOR ALL USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

-- Projects
CREATE POLICY "Allow all operations on projects" ON projects FOR ALL USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

-- Tasks
CREATE POLICY "Allow all operations on tasks" ON tasks FOR ALL USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

-- Project Materials

-- Photos

-- Quotations

## **2. COMPREHENSIVE TABLE USAGE REPORT**

Create this handy script:

**File:** `audit-tables.sh`

```bash
#!/bin/bash

echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
echo "📊 SCULPTUREFLOW TABLE USAGE AUDIT"
echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
echo ""

# Function to count and display table usage
check_table() {
    local table_name=$1
    local label=$2
    local count=$(grep -r "from('$table_name')" src/ --include="*.tsx" --include="*.ts" | wc -l | xargs)
    
    if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "📌 $label: $count occurrences"
        grep -r "from('$table_name')" src/ --include="*.tsx" --include="*.ts" | sed 's/^/   /'
    else
        echo "✓ $label: Not used"
    fi
    echo ""
}

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CORE TABLES (Always needed)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
echo "─── CORE TABLES (Should be used) ───"
check_table "clients" "Clients"
check_table "projects" "Projects"
check_table "tasks" "Tasks"
check_table "time_entries" "Time Entries"
check_table "materials" "Materials Master"
check_table "photos" "Photos"

echo ""
echo "─── OLD vs NEW SYSTEMS ───"

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# INVOICING SYSTEM
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
echo ""
echo "💰 INVOICING SYSTEM:"
check_table "invoices" "❌ OLD: invoices"
check_table "invoices_enhanced" "✅ NEW: invoices_enhanced"
check_table "invoice_items" "✅ NEW: invoice_items"

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MATERIAL TRACKING SYSTEM
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
echo ""
echo "📦 MATERIAL TRACKING:"
check_table "project_materials" "❌ OLD: project_materials"
check_table "material_usage" "✅ NEW: material_usage"
check_table "material_purchases" "✅ NEW: material_purchases"

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# QUOTATION SYSTEM
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

echo "📄 QUOTATION SYSTEM:"
check_table "quotations" "✅ Quotations"
check_table "quotation_items" "✅ Quotation Items"
check_table "payment_milestones" "✅ Payment Milestones"

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# something went wrong and now my terminal is blank and i cant type anythgin within vscode termianl

Don't worry! This is a common terminal freeze. Here's how to fix it quickly! 🛠️

***

## **🚨 QUICK FIX - TERMINAL FROZEN**

### **Option 1: Force Kill Terminal (Fastest)**

**In VSCode:**

1. **Press:** `Cmd + J` to close terminal panel
2. **Press:** `Cmd + J` again to reopen it
3. **Click the trash can icon** (Kill Terminal) in top right of terminal
4. **Click the `+` icon** to open new terminal

✅ **Fresh terminal ready!**

***

### **Option 2: Keyboard Interrupt**

If terminal is still visible but frozen:

**Press:** `Ctrl + C` (multiple times)

This sends interrupt signal to stop any running process.

***

### **Option 3: Force Quit Process**

If `Ctrl + C` doesn't work:

**Press:** `Ctrl + Z` to suspend process

Then close and reopen terminal.

***

### **Option 4: Nuclear Option (If nothing works)**

1. **Quit VSCode completely:** `Cmd + Q`
2. **Reopen VSCode**
3. **Open new terminal:** `Ctrl + ` ` (backtick)

***

## **🔍 WHAT LIKELY HAPPENED**

The command probably:

- ❌ Started an infinite loop
- ❌ Waiting for input you didn't see
- ❌ Outputting too much data too fast

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 🤖 AI CONFIGURATION & TASK PLANNING TABLES
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 1. AI PROVIDER CONFIGURATION
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_config (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  provider TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'gemini', 'openai', 'claude', 'local'
  model_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'gemini-1.5-pro', 'gpt-4', 'claude-3-opus'
  api_key_encrypted TEXT, -- Encrypted API key
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  max_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 2000,
  temperature DECIMAL(3,2) DEFAULT 0.7,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Only one active config at a time
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_config_active ON ai_config(is_active) WHERE is_active = true;

-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 2. BUSINESS QUESTIONNAIRE (Store answers)
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS business_config (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  working_hours_per_day DECIMAL(4,2) DEFAULT 8,
  working_days_per_week INTEGER DEFAULT 5,
  average_hourly_rate DECIMAL(10,2),
  sculpture_process_stages JSONB, -- ["Clay Modeling", "Mold Making", "Casting", "Finishing"]
  stage_durations JSONB, -- {"Clay Modeling": 20, "Mold Making": 15, ...} (hours)
  simultaneous_projects BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  task_breakdown_preference TEXT DEFAULT 'daily', -- 'daily' or 'weekly'
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Only one business config
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_business_config_single ON business_config((1));

-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 3. AI GENERATED TASKS
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_task_suggestions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  task_description TEXT NOT NULL,
  estimated_hours DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
  priority TEXT CHECK (priority IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')) DEFAULT 'medium',
  reasoning TEXT, -- Why AI suggested this task today
  suggested_date DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'completed', 'converted')),
  ai_confidence DECIMAL(3,2), -- 0.00 to 1.00
  task_id UUID REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- If converted to real task
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_tasks_project ON ai_task_suggestions(project_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_tasks_date ON ai_task_suggestions(suggested_date DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_tasks_status ON ai_task_suggestions(status);

-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 4. AI GENERATION LOGS (Track API calls)
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_generation_logs (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  provider TEXT NOT NULL,
  model_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  prompt_tokens INTEGER,
  completion_tokens INTEGER,
  total_cost DECIMAL(10,6), -- In USD
  generation_time_ms INTEGER,
  tasks_generated INTEGER,
  error_message TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_logs_date ON ai_generation_logs(created_at DESC);

## **Step 3: Create AI Provider Abstraction**

**File:** `src/lib/ai/providers.ts`

```typescript
import { GoogleGenerativeAI } from '@google/generative-ai';
import OpenAI from 'openai';
import Anthropic from '@anthropic-ai/sdk';

export interface AIProvider {
  generate(prompt: string): Promise<string>;
  getModelName(): string;
  getProviderName(): string;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// GEMINI PROVIDER
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export class GeminiProvider implements AIProvider {
  private client: GoogleGenerativeAI;
  private modelName: string;

  constructor(apiKey: string, modelName: string = 'gemini-1.5-flash') {
    this.client = new GoogleGenerativeAI(apiKey);
    this.modelName = modelName;
  }

  async generate(prompt: string): Promise<string> {
    const model = this.client.getGenerativeModel({ model: this.modelName });
    const result = await model.generateContent(prompt);
    return result.response.text();
  }

  getModelName(): string {
    return this.modelName;
  }

  getProviderName(): string {
    return 'gemini';
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// OPENAI PROVIDER
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export class OpenAIProvider implements AIProvider {
  private client: OpenAI;
  private modelName: string;

  constructor(apiKey: string, modelName: string = 'gpt-4o-mini') {
    this.client = new OpenAI({ apiKey });
    this.modelName = modelName;
  }

  async generate(prompt: string): Promise<string> {
    const completion = await this.client.chat.completions.create({
      model: this.modelName,
      messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }],
      temperature: 0.7,
    });
    return completion.choices[0].message.content || '';
  }

  getModelName(): string {
    return this.modelName;
  }

  getProviderName(): string {
    return 'openai';
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CLAUDE PROVIDER
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export class ClaudeProvider implements AIProvider {
  private client: Anthropic;
  private modelName: string;

  constructor(apiKey: string, modelName: string = 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022') {
    this.client = new Anthropic({ apiKey });
    this.modelName = modelName;
  }

  async generate(prompt: string): Promise<string> {
    const message = await this.client.messages.create({
      model: this.modelName,
      max_tokens: 2000,
      messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }],
    });
    
    const textContent = message.content.find(c => c.type === 'text');
    return textContent?.text || '';
  }

  getModelName(): string {
    return this.modelName;
  }

  getProviderName(): string {
    return 'claude';
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PROVIDER FACTORY
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export async function createAIProvider(
  provider: string,
  apiKey: string,
  modelName?: string
): Promise<AIProvider> {
  switch (provider.toLowerCase()) {
    case 'gemini':
      return new GeminiProvider(apiKey, modelName);
    case 'openai':
      return new OpenAIProvider(apiKey, modelName);
    case 'claude':
      return new ClaudeProvider(apiKey, modelName);
    default:
      throw new Error(`Unsupported AI provider: ${provider}`);
  }
}
```

## **Step 4: Create AI Task Generator**

**File:** `src/lib/ai/task-generator.ts`

```typescript
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { createAIProvider } from './providers';

interface Project {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  deadline: string;
  budget: number;
  status: string;
  hours_spent: number;
  estimated_hours: number;
}

interface GeneratedTask {
  project_id: string;
  task_description: string;
  estimated_hours: number;
  priority: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';
  reasoning: string;
  ai_confidence: number;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// MAIN TASK GENERATOR
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export async function generateDailyTasks(): Promise<GeneratedTask[]> {
  const startTime = Date.now();

  try {
    // 1. Get active AI config
    const { data: aiConfig } = await supabaseClient
      .from('ai_config')
      .select('*')
      .eq('is_active', true)
      .single();

    if (!aiConfig || !aiConfig.api_key_encrypted) {
      throw new Error('No active AI configuration found');
    }

    // 2. Get business config
    const { data: businessConfig } = await supabaseClient
      .from('business_config')
      .select('*')
      .single();

    if (!businessConfig) {
      throw new Error('Business configuration not set');
    }

    // 3. Get active projects
    const { data: projects } = await supabaseClient
      .from('projects')
      .select(`
        id,
        name,
        deadline,
        budget,
        status,
        estimated_hours,
        tasks(id, status, estimated_hours)
      `)
      .eq('status', 'in_progress')
      .order('deadline', { ascending: true });

    if (!projects || projects.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    // 4. Calculate hours spent per project
    const projectsWithHours = await Promise.all(
      projects.map(async (project) => {
        const { data: timeEntries } = await supabaseClient
          .from('time_entries')
          .select('hours')
          .eq('project_id', project.id);

        const hours_spent = timeEntries?.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.hours, 0) || 0;
        return { ...project, hours_spent };
      })
    );

    // 5. Generate AI prompt
    const prompt = buildPrompt(projectsWithHours, businessConfig);

    // 6. Call AI provider
    const provider = await createAIProvider(
      aiConfig.provider,
      aiConfig.api_key_encrypted, // In production, decrypt this
      aiConfig.model_name
    );

    const response = await provider.generate(prompt);

    // 7. Parse AI response (expecting JSON)
    const tasks = parseAIResponse(response);

    // 8. Save to database
    const { data: savedTasks, error } = await supabaseClient
      .from('ai_task_suggestions')
      .insert(
        tasks.map((task) => ({
          ...task,
          suggested_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
          status: 'pending',
        }))
      )
      .select();

    if (error) throw error;

    // 9. Log generation
    await supabaseClient.from('ai_generation_logs').insert({
      provider: aiConfig.provider,
      model_name: aiConfig.model_name,
      generation_time_ms: Date.now() - startTime,
      tasks_generated: tasks.length,
    });

    return savedTasks || [];
  } catch (error: any) {
    // Log error
    await supabaseClient.from('ai_generation_logs').insert({
      provider: 'unknown',
      model_name: 'unknown',
      generation_time_ms: Date.now() - startTime,
      tasks_generated: 0,
      error_message: error.message,
    });

    throw error;
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// BUILD AI PROMPT
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function buildPrompt(projects: any[], businessConfig: any): string {
  const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

  return `You are an AI assistant for a sculpture studio helping to plan daily tasks.

**Today's Date:** ${today}

**Business Configuration:**
- Working hours per day: ${businessConfig.working_hours_per_day} hours
- Working days per week: ${businessConfig.working_days_per_week} days
- Sculpture process stages: ${JSON.stringify(businessConfig.sculpture_process_stages)}
- Average stage durations: ${JSON.stringify(businessConfig.stage_durations)}

**Active Projects:**
${projects
  .map(
    (p, i) => `
${i + 1}. **${p.name}**
   - Deadline: ${p.deadline} (${daysUntilDeadline(p.deadline)} days remaining)
   - Budget: ₹${p.budget?.toLocaleString() || 0}
   - Hours spent: ${p.hours_spent}h / Estimated: ${p.estimated_hours || 'N/A'}h
   - Progress: ${calculateProgress(p)}%
   - Status: ${p.status}
`
  )
  .join('\n')}

**Your Task:**
Generate a prioritized list of 5-8 tasks for today. Consider:
1. Approaching deadlines (urgent tasks first)
2. Project progress vs. timeline
3. Available working hours (${businessConfig.working_hours_per_day}h)
4. Logical sculpture workflow stages

**Output Format (JSON only, no markdown):**
[
  {
    "project_id": "uuid",
    "task_description": "Detailed task description",
    "estimated_hours": 2.5,
    "priority": "high",
    "reasoning": "Why this task today",
    "ai_confidence": 0.85
  }
]

Generate realistic, actionable tasks that fit within today's working hours.`;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PARSE AI RESPONSE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function parseAIResponse(response: string): GeneratedTask[] {
  try {
    // Remove markdown code fences if present
    const cleaned = response
      .replace(/```
      .replace(/```\n?/g, '')
      .trim();

    const parsed = JSON.parse(cleaned);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [parsed];
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to parse AI response:', error);
    return [];
  }
}

// Helper functions
function daysUntilDeadline(deadline: string): number {
  const diff = new Date(deadline).getTime() - new Date().getTime();
  return Math.ceil(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
}

function calculateProgress(project: any): number {
  if (!project.estimated_hours || project.estimated_hours === 0) return 0;
  return Math.min(100, Math.round((project.hours_spent / project.estimated_hours) * 100));
}
```

```typescript
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { Home, Briefcase, Users, Package, BookOpen } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const navItems = [
  { href: '/', label: 'Dashboard', icon: Home },
  { href: '/projects', label: 'Projects', icon: Briefcase },
  { href: '/clients', label: 'Clients', icon: Users },
  { href: '/materials', label: 'Materials', icon: Package },
  { href: '/billbook', label: 'BillBook', icon: BookOpen },
];

export default function Navigation() {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  return (
    <nav className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-surface/95 backdrop-blur-sm border-t border-white/10 z-50 shadow-lg safe-area-bottom">
      <div className="flex justify-around items-center h-16 max-w-lg mx-auto px-2">
        {navItems.map((item) => {
          const Icon = item.icon;
          const isActive = pathname === item.href;

          return (
            <Link
              key={item.href}
              href={item.href}
              className={cn(
                'flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl transition-all duration-200',
                isActive
                  ? 'text-primary bg-primary/10'
                  : 'text-white/60 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5'
              )}
            >
              <Icon className={cn('w-5 h-5', isActive && 'scale-110')} />
              <span className="text-xs font-medium">{item.label}</span>
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

**Changes:**

- ✅ Removed "Money" tab
- ✅ Now only 5 items (fits mobile perfectly)
- ✅ BillBook replaces Money
