## **FIX 2: Move FAB to Not Block Navigation**

**Update:** `src/components/FAB.tsx`

```typescript
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Plus, FileText, DollarSign, User, X, ListTodo, Package } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export default function FAB() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const actions = [
    { 
      href: '/projects/new', 
      label: 'New Project', 
      icon: ListTodo, 
      color: 'from-blue-500 to-blue-600' 
    },
    { 
      href: '/quotations/new', 
      label: 'New Quote', 
      icon: FileText, 
      color: 'from-purple-500 to-purple-600' 
    },
    { 
      href: '/invoices/new', 
      label: 'New Invoice', 
      icon: DollarSign, 
      color: 'from-green-500 to-green-600' 
    },
    { 
      href: '/clients/new', 
      label: 'New Client', 
      icon: User, 
      color: 'from-pink-500 to-pink-600' 
    },
    { 
      href: '/materials/purchase', 
      label: 'Record Purchase', 
      icon: Package, 
      color: 'from-orange-500 to-orange-600' 
    },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      {/* Overlay */}
      {open && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/40 z-40 animate-fadeIn"
          onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
        />
      )}

      {/* Action Menu */}
      {open && (
        <div className="fixed right-4 bottom-28 z-50 flex flex-col gap-3 animate-slideUp">
          {actions.map((action, index) => {
            const Icon = action.icon;
            return (
              <Link
                key={action.href}
                href={action.href}
                onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                className={cn(
                  'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl',
                  'bg-gradient-to-r shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl',
                  'text-white font-medium transition-all',
                  'hover:scale-105 animate-slideUp',
                  action.color
                )}
                style={{ animationDelay: `${index * 50}ms` }}
              >
                <Icon className="w-5 h-5" />
                <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{action.label}</span>
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Main FAB Button - MOVED UP */}
      <button
        onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
        className={cn(
          'fixed right-4 bottom-20 z-50', // Changed from bottom-6 to bottom-20
          'w-14 h-14 rounded-full',
          'bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary-hover',
          'text-white shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl',
          'transition-all duration-300',
          'flex items-center justify-center',
          open && 'rotate-45 scale-110'
        )}
      >
        {open ? <X className="w-6 h-6" /> : <Plus className="w-6 h-6" />}
      </button>

      <style jsx>{`
        @keyframes fadeIn {
          from { opacity: 0; }
          to { opacity: 1; }
        }
        @keyframes slideUp {
          from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
          to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
        .animate-fadeIn {
          animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease-out;
        }
        .animate-slideUp {
          animation: slideUp 0.3s ease-out;
        }
      `}</style>
    </>
  );
}
```

**Changes:**

- ✅ FAB moved up: `bottom-20` (was `bottom-6`)

```typescript
import { supabase } from '@/lib/supabase';
import DailyTasksCard from '@/components/DailyTasksCard';
import DeadlinesCard from '@/components/DeadlinesCard';
import ProjectCompletionCard from '@/components/ProjectCompletionCard';

export default async function DashboardPage() {
  // Fetch data server-side
  const { data: projects } = await supabase
    .from('projects')
    .select('*')
    .eq('status', 'in_progress')
    .order('deadline');

  const { data: upcomingDeadlines } = await supabase
    .from('projects')
    .select('id, name, deadline, status')
    .gte('deadline', new Date().toISOString())
    .lte('deadline', new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString())
    .order('deadline');

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 pb-24">
      <div className="mb-8">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2">Welcome Back! 👋</h1>
        <p className="text-lg opacity-80">Here's what needs your attention today</p>
      </div>

      {/* Main Grid - Daily Tasks as Hero */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mb-6">
        {/* Daily Tasks - Takes 2 columns on desktop */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2">
          <DailyTasksCard />
        </div>

        {/* Side Cards */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <DeadlinesCard deadlines={upcomingDeadlines || []} />
          <ProjectCompletionCard projects={projects || []} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Quick Stats - Simplified */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        {/* Keep only most important stats */}
        <StatCard label="Active Projects" value={projects?.length || 0} />
        <StatCard label="Pending Invoices" value="3" color="text-yellow-400" />
        <StatCard label="This Week" value="32h" color="text-blue-400" />
        <StatCard label="Materials Low" value="2" color="text-orange-400" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function StatCard({ label, value, color = 'text-primary' }: any) {
  return (
    <div className="card p-4">
      <div className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-1">{label}</div>
      <div className={`text-2xl font-bold ${color}`}>{value}</div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## **✅ FIXED: src/app/invoices/new/page.tsx**

```typescript
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Plus, Trash2, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface LineItem {
  id: string;
  description: string;
  specifications: string;
  quantity: number;
  unit: string;
  rate: number;
  amount: number;
}

export default function NewInvoicePage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [clients, setClients] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    client_id: '',
    project_id: '',
    subject: '',
    issue_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    due_date: '',
    gst_percentage: 18,
    payment_terms: 'Net 30',
  });

  const [items, setItems] = useState<LineItem[]>([
    {
      id: '1',
      description: '',
      specifications: '',
      quantity: 1,
      unit: 'unit',
      rate: 0,
      amount: 0,
    },
  ]);

  // Fetch data on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    async function fetchData() {
      try {
        // Fetch clients
        const { data: clientsData, error: clientsError } = await supabaseClient
          .from('clients')
          .select('id, name, email')
          .order('name');

        if (clientsError) throw clientsError;
        setClients(clientsData || []);

        // Fetch projects
        const { data: projectsData, error: projectsError } = await supabaseClient
          .from('projects')
          .select('id, name, client_id')
          .order('name');

        if (projectsError) throw projectsError;
        setProjects(projectsData || []);
      } catch (error: any) {
        console.error('Fetch error:', error);
        toast.error('Failed to load data');
      }
    }

    fetchData();
  }, []);

  // Calculate totals
  const { subtotal, gstAmount, total } = useMemo(() => {
    const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.amount, 0);
    const gstAmount = (subtotal * formData.gst_percentage) / 100;
    const total = subtotal + gstAmount;
    return { subtotal, gstAmount, total };
  }, [items, formData.gst_percentage]);

  // Add new line item
  const addItem = () => {
    setItems([
      ...items,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        description: '',
        specifications: '',
        quantity: 1,
        unit: 'unit',
        rate: 0,
        amount: 0,
      },
    ]);
  };

  // Remove line item
  const removeItem = (id: string) => {
    if (items.length > 1) {
      setItems(items.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
    } else {
      toast.error('At least one item is required');
    }
  };

  // Update line item
  const updateItem = (id: string, field: string, value: any) => {
    setItems((prevItems) =>
      prevItems.map((item) => {
        if (item.id === id) {
          const updated = { ...item, [field]: value };
          // Recalculate amount if quantity or rate changes
          if (field === 'quantity' || field === 'rate') {
            updated.amount = updated.quantity * updated.rate;
          }
          return updated;
        }
        return item;
      })
    );
  };

  // Submit invoice
  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    // Validation
    if (!formData.client_id) {
      toast.error('Please select a client');
      return;
    }

    if (!formData.subject) {
      toast.error('Please enter a subject');
      return;
    }

    if (items.length === 0 || items.some((item) => !item.description || item.quantity <= 0 || item.rate <= 0)) {
      toast.error('Please complete all line items with valid data');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      // Generate invoice number
      const invoiceNumber = `INV-${Date.now()}`;

      // 1. Insert invoice
      const { data: invoice, error: invoiceError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('invoices_enhanced')
        .insert([
          {
            invoice_number: invoiceNumber,
            client_id: formData.client_id,
            project_id: formData.project_id || null,
            subject: formData.subject,
            issue_date: formData.issue_date,
            due_date: formData.due_date || null,
            status: 'pending',
            subtotal: subtotal,
            gst_percentage: formData.gst_percentage,
            gst_amount: gstAmount,
            total_amount: total,
            paid_amount: 0,
            balance_amount: total,
            payment_terms: formData.payment_terms,
          },
        ])
        .select()
        .single();

      if (invoiceError) {
        console.error('Invoice error:', invoiceError);
        throw new Error(invoiceError.message);
      }

      if (!invoice) {
        throw new Error('Failed to create invoice - no data returned');
      }

      // 2. Insert invoice items
      const itemsToInsert = items.map((item, index) => ({
        invoice_id: invoice.id,
        item_number: index + 1,
        description: item.description,
        specifications: item.specifications ? { notes: item.specifications } : null,
        quantity: item.quantity,
        unit: item.unit,
        rate: item.rate,
        amount: item.amount,
      }));

      const { error: itemsError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('invoice_items')
        .insert(itemsToInsert);

      if (itemsError) {
        console.error('Items error:', itemsError);
        throw new Error(itemsError.message);
      }

      toast.success('Invoice created successfully!');
      router.push(`/invoices/${invoice.id}`);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Submit error:', error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to create invoice');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 pb-24 max-w-6xl">
      <div className="mb-8">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2">Create Invoice</h1>
        <p className="text-lg opacity-80">Generate professional invoices for your clients</p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
        {/* Main Form */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {/* Basic Details Card */}
          <div className="card">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Basic Information</h2>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-4">
              {/* Client Selection */}
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Client *</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.client_id}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, client_id: e.target.value, project_id: '' })}
                  className="form-control"
                  required
                >
                  <option value="">Select a client</option>
                  {clients.map((client) => (
                    <option key={client.id} value={client.id}>
                      {client.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              {/* Project Selection */}
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Project (Optional)</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.project_id}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, project_id: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  disabled={!formData.client_id}
                >
                  <option value="">Select a project (optional)</option>
                  {projects
                    .filter((p) => p.client_id === formData.client_id)
                    .map((project) => (
                      <option key={project.id} value={project.id}>
                        {project.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                </select>
                {!formData.client_id && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-white/50 mt-1">Select a client first</p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Subject */}
            <div className="form-group mb-4">
              <label className="form-label">Subject *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={formData.subject}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, subject: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
                placeholder="e.g., Invoice for Sculpture Commission"
                required
              />
            </div>

            {/* Dates and GST */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Issue Date *</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={formData.issue_date}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, issue_date: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Due Date</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={formData.due_date}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, due_date: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  min={formData.issue_date}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">GST %</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={formData.gst_percentage}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, gst_percentage: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                  className="form-control"
                  min="0"
                  max="100"
                  step="0.01"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Line Items Card */}
          <div className="card">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Line Items</h2>
              <button
                onClick={addItem}
                type="button"
                className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                Add Item
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              {items.map((item, index) => (
                <div
                  key={item.id}
                  className="p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-lg border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
                >
                  {/* Item Header */}
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-lg">Item {index + 1}</h3>
                    {items.length > 1 && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => removeItem(item.id)}
                        type="button"
                        className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 transition-colors"
                        title="Remove item"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Description */}
                  <div className="form-group mb-3">
                    <label className="form-label text-sm">Description *</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={item.description}
                      onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'description', e.target.value)}
                      className="form-control"
                      placeholder="Describe the item or service"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Specifications */}
                  <div className="form-group mb-3">
                    <label className="form-label text-sm">Specifications (Optional)</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={item.specifications}
                      onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'specifications', e.target.value)}
                      className="form-control"
                      placeholder="Additional details"
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Quantity, Unit, Rate, Amount */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="form-label text-sm">Quantity *</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        value={item.quantity}
                        onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'quantity', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                        className="form-control"
                        min="0"
                        step="0.01"
                        required
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="form-label text-sm">Unit</label>
                      <select
                        value={item.unit}
                        onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'unit', e.target.value)}
                        className="form-control"
                      >
                        <option value="unit">Unit</option>
                        <option value="kg">Kg</option>
                        <option value="sqft">Sq.Ft</option>
                        <option value="feet">Feet</option>
                        <option value="hours">Hours</option>
                        <option value="days">Days</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="form-label text-sm">Rate (₹) *</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        value={item.rate}
                        onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'rate', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                        className="form-control"
                        min="0"
                        step="0.01"
                        required
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="form-label text-sm">Amount (₹)</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={`₹${item.amount.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`}
                        className="form-control bg-white/5 cursor-not-allowed"
                        readOnly
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Summary Sidebar */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="card sticky top-4">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-6">Invoice Summary</h3>

            {/* Calculation Breakdown */}
            <div className="space-y-4 mb-6">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <span className="text-sm opacity-70">Subtotal:</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-lg">
                  ₹{subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <span className="text-sm opacity-70">GST ({formData.gst_percentage}%):</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-lg">
                  ₹{gstAmount.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="border-t border-white/10 pt-4">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="font-bold text-lg">Total Amount:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-3xl text-primary">
                    ₹{total.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Payment Terms */}
            <div className="form-group mb-6">
              <label className="form-label text-sm">Payment Terms</label>
              <select
                value={formData.payment_terms}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, payment_terms: e.target.value })}
                className="form-control"
              >
                <option value="Net 15">Net 15 Days</option>
                <option value="Net 30">Net 30 Days</option>
                <option value="Net 45">Net 45 Days</option>
                <option value="Net 60">Net 60 Days</option>
                <option value="Due on Receipt">Due on Receipt</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Submit Button */}
            <button
              onClick={handleSubmit}
              disabled={loading}
              className="btn btn--primary w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              <FileText className="w-5 h-5" />
              {loading ? 'Creating Invoice...' : 'Create Invoice'}
            </button>

            {loading && (
              <p className="text-xs text-center text-white/50 mt-2">
                Please wait, this may take a moment...
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## **✅ FIXED: src/app/invoices/page.tsx**

```typescript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { FileText, Plus, Eye, Download, CheckCircle, Clock, AlertCircle, Filter } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface Invoice {
  id: string;
  invoice_number: string;
  client_id: string;
  subject: string;
  issue_date: string;
  due_date: string | null;
  status: string;
  total_amount: number;
  paid_amount: number;
  balance_amount: number;
  client?: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
  };
}

export default function InvoicesPage() {
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState<Invoice[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<'all' | 'pending' | 'paid' | 'overdue'>('all');

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchInvoices();
  }, []);

  const fetchInvoices = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);

      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('invoices_enhanced')
        .select(`
          id,
          invoice_number,
          client_id,
          subject,
          issue_date,
          due_date,
          status,
          total_amount,
          paid_amount,
          balance_amount,
          client:clients (
            id,
            name
          )
        `)
        .order('issue_date', { ascending: false });

      if (error) {
        console.error('Fetch error:', error);
        throw error;
      }

      setInvoices(data || []);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch invoices:', error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to load invoices');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    const badges = {
      paid: { 
        label: 'Paid', 
        icon: CheckCircle, 
        className: 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 border-green-500/30' 
      },
      pending: { 
        label: 'Pending', 
        icon: Clock, 
        className: 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-500/30' 
      },
      overdue: { 
        label: 'Overdue', 
        icon: AlertCircle, 
        className: 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border-red-500/30' 
      },
    };

    const badge = badges[status as keyof typeof badges] || badges.pending;
    const Icon = badge.icon;

    return (
      <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border ${badge.className}`}>
        <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        {badge.label}
      </span>
    );
  };

  const filteredInvoices = invoices.filter((invoice) => {
    if (filterStatus === 'all') return true;
    return invoice.status === filterStatus;
  });

  const stats = {
    total: invoices.length,
    paid: invoices.filter((i) => i.status === 'paid').length,
    pending: invoices.filter((i) => i.status === 'pending').length,
    overdue: invoices.filter((i) => i.status === 'overdue').length,
    totalAmount: invoices.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.total_amount, 0),
    paidAmount: invoices.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.paid_amount, 0),
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 pb-24">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
          <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-4 border-primary border-t-transparent"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 pb-24">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2">Invoices</h1>
          <p className="text-lg opacity-80">Manage and track all invoices</p>
        </div>
        <Link href="/invoices/new" className="btn btn--primary flex items-center gap-2">
          <Plus className="w-5 h-5" />
          New Invoice
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* Stats Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-8">
        <div className="card p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
            <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-400" />
            <span className="text-sm opacity-70">Total Invoices</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-3xl font-bold">{stats.total}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="card p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
            <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-400" />
            <span className="text-sm opacity-70">Paid</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-400">{stats.paid}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="card p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
            <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-400" />
            <span className="text-sm opacity-70">Pending</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-yellow-400">{stats.pending}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="card p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
            <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-400" />
            <span className="text-sm opacity-70">Overdue</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-red-400">{stats.overdue}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Revenue Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-8">
        <div className="card p-6 bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500/10 to-emerald-500/10 border-green-500/20">
          <div className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-2">Total Invoiced</div>
          <div className="text-4xl font-bold text-green-400">
            {formatCurrency(stats.totalAmount)}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="card p-6 bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500/10 to-cyan-500/10 border-blue-500/20">
          <div className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-2">Total Collected</div>
          <div className="text-4xl font-bold text-blue-400">
            {formatCurrency(stats.paidAmount)}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 mb-6 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
        <button
          onClick={() => setFilterStatus('all')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${
            filterStatus === 'all'
              ? 'bg-primary text-white'
              : 'bg-white/5 text-white/60 hover:bg-white/10'
          }`}
        >
          All ({stats.total})
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setFilterStatus('pending')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${
            filterStatus === 'pending'
              ? 'bg-yellow-500 text-white'
              : 'bg-white/5 text-white/60 hover:bg-white/10'
          }`}
        >
          Pending ({stats.pending})
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setFilterStatus('paid')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${
            filterStatus === 'paid'
              ? 'bg-green-500 text-white'
              : 'bg-white/5 text-white/60 hover:bg-white/10'
          }`}
        >
          Paid ({stats.paid})
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setFilterStatus('overdue')}
          className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${
            filterStatus === 'overdue'
              ? 'bg-red-500 text-white'
              : 'bg-white/5 text-white/60 hover:bg-white/10'
          }`}
        >
          Overdue ({stats.overdue})
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Invoices List */}
      {filteredInvoices.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="card p-12 text-center">
          <FileText className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-2">
            {filterStatus === 'all' ? 'No invoices yet' : `No ${filterStatus} invoices`}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-6">
            {filterStatus === 'all'
              ? 'Create your first invoice to get started'
              : `There are no ${filterStatus} invoices at the moment`}
          </p>
          {filterStatus === 'all' && (
            <Link href="/invoices/new" className="btn btn--primary inline-flex items-center gap-2">
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              Create Invoice
            </Link>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {filteredInvoices.map((invoice) => (
            <div
              key={invoice.id}
              className="card hover:bg-white/5 transition-all cursor-pointer group"
            >
              <Link href={`/invoices/${invoice.id}`} className="block p-6">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                      <h3 className="text-xl font-bold group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">
                        {invoice.invoice_number}
                      </h3>
                      {getStatusBadge(invoice.status)}
                    </div>

                    <p className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-1">
                      {invoice.subject}
                    </p>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm opacity-60">
                      <span>
                        {invoice.client && Array.isArray(invoice.client) 
                          ? invoice.client[0]?.name 
                          : invoice.client?.name || 'Unknown Client'}
                      </span>
                      <span>•</span>
                      <span>
                        Issued: {new Date(invoice.issue_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}
                      </span>
                      {invoice.due_date && (
                        <>
                          <span>•</span>
                          <span>
                            Due: {new Date(invoice.due_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}
                          </span>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary mb-1">
                      {formatCurrency(invoice.total_amount)}
                    </div>
                    {invoice.status !== 'paid' && invoice.balance_amount > 0 && (
                      <div className="text-sm opacity-60">
                        Balance: {formatCurrency(invoice.balance_amount)}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Link>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { useParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Download, CheckCircle, ArrowLeft, Edit, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface InvoiceItem {
  id: string;
  description: string;
  specifications: any;
  quantity: number;
  unit: string;
  rate: number;
  amount: number;
}

interface Invoice {
  id: string;
  invoice_number: string;
  client_id: string;
  project_id: string | null;
  subject: string;
  issue_date: string;
  due_date: string | null;
  status: string;
  subtotal: number;
  gst_percentage: number;
  gst_amount: number;
  total_amount: number;
  paid_amount: number;
  balance_amount: number;
  payment_terms: string | null;
  client?: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    email: string;
    phone: string;
    address: string;
  };
  project?: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
  };
}

export default function InvoiceDetailPage() {
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const invoiceId = params?.id as string;

  const [invoice, setInvoice] = useState<Invoice | null>(null);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<InvoiceItem[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [markingPaid, setMarkingPaid] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (invoiceId) {
      fetchInvoice();
    }
  }, [invoiceId]);

  const fetchInvoice = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);

      // Fetch invoice with relations
      const { data: invoiceData, error: invoiceError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('invoices_enhanced')
        .select(`
          *,
          client:clients (
            id,
            name,
            email,
            phone,
            address
          ),
          project:projects (
            id,
            name
          )
        `)
        .eq('id', invoiceId)
        .single();

      if (invoiceError) {
        console.error('Invoice fetch error:', invoiceError);
        throw invoiceError;
      }

      if (!invoiceData) {
        throw new Error('Invoice not found');
      }

      setInvoice(invoiceData);

      // Fetch invoice items
      const { data: itemsData, error: itemsError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('invoice_items')
        .select('*')
        .eq('invoice_id', invoiceId)
        .order('item_number');

      if (itemsError) {
        console.error('Items fetch error:', itemsError);
        throw itemsError;
      }

      setItems(itemsData || []);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch invoice:', error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to load invoice');
      // Don't navigate away, show error state
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkAsPaid = async () => {
    if (!invoice) return;

    if (!confirm('Mark this invoice as paid?')) return;

    setMarkingPaid(true);

    try {
      // Update invoice status
      const { error: updateError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('invoices_enhanced')
        .update({
          status: 'paid',
          paid_amount: invoice.total_amount,
          balance_amount: 0,
        })
        .eq('id', invoice.id);

      if (updateError) throw updateError;

      // Create transaction record
      const { error: transactionError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('transactions')
        .insert({
          type: 'income',
          category: 'invoice_payment',
          amount: invoice.total_amount,
          transaction_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
          description: `Payment received for ${invoice.invoice_number}`,
          client_id: invoice.client_id,
          reference_number: invoice.invoice_number,
        });

      if (transactionError) {
        console.error('Transaction error:', transactionError);
        // Don't fail if transaction fails, just log it
      }

      toast.success('Invoice marked as paid!');
      fetchInvoice(); // Refresh data
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Mark paid error:', error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to mark as paid');
    } finally {
      setMarkingPaid(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadPDF = () => {
    toast.success('PDF download coming soon!');
    // TODO: Implement PDF generation
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 pb-24">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
          <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-4 border-primary border-t-transparent"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!invoice) {
    return (
      <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 pb-24">
        <div className="card p-12 text-center">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">Invoice Not Found</h2>
          <p className="text-lg opacity-70 mb-6">
            The invoice you're looking for doesn't exist or has been deleted.
          </p>
          <button onClick={() => router.push('/invoices')} className="btn btn--primary">
            Back to Invoices
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Extract client data (handle both array and object)
  const client = invoice.client && Array.isArray(invoice.client)
    ? invoice.client[0]
    : invoice.client;

  const project = invoice.project && Array.isArray(invoice.project)
    ? invoice.project[0]
    : invoice.project;

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 pb-24 max-w-5xl">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-8">
        <button
          onClick={() => router.push('/invoices')}
          className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm flex items-center gap-2"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          Back
        </button>
        <div className="flex-1">
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold">{invoice.invoice_number}</h1>
          <p className="text-lg opacity-70 mt-1">{invoice.subject}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {invoice.status !== 'paid' && (
            <button
              onClick={handleMarkAsPaid}
              disabled={markingPaid}
              className="btn btn--primary flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
              {markingPaid ? 'Processing...' : 'Mark as Paid'}
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            onClick={handleDownloadPDF}
            className="btn btn--secondary flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
            Download PDF
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Status Banner */}
      <div
        className={`mb-6 rounded-xl p-4 border ${
          invoice.status === 'paid'
            ? 'bg-green-500/10 border-green-500/30 text-green-400'
            : invoice.status === 'overdue'
            ? 'bg-red-500/10 border-red-500/30 text-red-400'
            : 'bg-yellow-500/10 border-yellow-500/30 text-yellow-400'
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="font-semibold">
            Status: {invoice.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + invoice.status.slice(1)}
          </span>
          {invoice.status === 'paid' ? (
            <span>Paid on {new Date(invoice.issue_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}</span>
          ) : (
            <span>Balance Due: {formatCurrency(invoice.balance_amount)}</span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Invoice Details Card */}
      <div className="card mb-6">
        <div className="p-8">
          {/* Header Info */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8 mb-8">
            {/* Bill To */}
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold opacity-70 mb-2">BILL TO</h3>
              <div className="text-lg font-bold mb-1">{client?.name || 'Unknown Client'}</div>
              {client?.email && <div className="text-sm opacity-70">{client.email}</div>}
              {client?.phone && <div className="text-sm opacity-70">{client.phone}</div>}
              {client?.address && <div className="text-sm opacity-70 mt-2">{client.address}</div>}
            </div>

            {/* Invoice Info */}
            <div className="text-right">
              <div className="mb-4">
                <div className="text-sm opacity-70">Invoice Number</div>

              <div className="mb-4">

              </div>
              {invoice.due_date && (
                <div className="mb-4">

              )}
              {project && (

              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Line Items Table */}
          <div className="overflow-x-auto mb-8">
            <table className="w-full">
```

```typescript
            <button
              onClick={handleMarkAsPaid}
              disabled={markingPaid}
              className="btn btn--primary flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
              {markingPaid ? 'Processing...' : 'Mark as Paid'}
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            onClick={() => toast.success('PDF download coming soon!')}
            className="btn btn--secondary flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
            PDF
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Status Banner */}
      <div
        className={`mb-6 rounded-xl p-4 border ${
          invoice.status === 'paid'
            ? 'bg-green-500/10 border-green-500/30 text-green-400'
            : invoice.status === 'overdue'
            ? 'bg-red-500/10 border-red-500/30 text-red-400'
            : 'bg-yellow-500/10 border-yellow-500/30 text-yellow-400'
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="font-semibold">
            Status: {invoice.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + invoice.status.slice(1)}
          </span>
          {invoice.status === 'paid' ? (
            <span>Fully Paid</span>
          ) : (
            <span>Balance Due: {formatCurrency(invoice.balance_amount)}</span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Invoice Card */}
      <div className="card">
        <div className="p-6 md:p-8">
          {/* Bill To & Invoice Info */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8 mb-8">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold opacity-70 mb-3">BILL TO</h3>
              <div className="text-xl font-bold mb-2">{client?.name || 'Unknown Client'}</div>
              {client?.email && <div className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-1">{client.email}</div>}
              {client?.phone && <div className="text-sm opacity-70">{client.phone}</div>}
            </div>

            <div className="md:text-right">
              <div className="mb-4">
                <div className="text-sm opacity-70">Invoice Number</div>
                <div className="text-lg font-bold">{invoice.invoice_number}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="mb-4">
                <div className="text-sm opacity-70">Issue Date</div>
                <div className="font-medium">
                  {new Date(invoice.issue_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}
                </div>
              </div>
              {invoice.due_date && (
                <div className="mb-4">
                  <div className="text-sm opacity-70">Due Date</div>
                  <div className="font-medium">
                    {new Date(invoice.due_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              {project && (
                <div>
                  <div className="text-sm opacity-70">Project</div>
                  <div className="font-medium">{project.name}</div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Items Table */}
          <div className="overflow-x-auto mb-8">
            <table className="w-full">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-white/10">
                  <th className="text-left py-3 px-2 text-sm font-semibold opacity-70">Description</th>
                  <th className="text-right py-3 px-2 text-sm font-semibold opacity-70">Qty</th>
                  <th className="text-right py-3 px-2 text-sm font-semibold opacity-70">Unit</th>
                  <th className="text-right py-3 px-2 text-sm font-semibold opacity-70">Rate</th>
                  <th className="text-right py-3 px-2 text-sm font-semibold opacity-70">Amount</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {items.map((item) => (
                  <tr key={item.id} className="border-b border-white/5">
                    <td className="py-4 px-2">
                      <div className="font-medium">{item.description}</div>
                      {item.specifications && (
                        <div className="text-sm opacity-60 mt-1">
                          {typeof item.specifications === 'object'
                            ? item.specifications.notes
                            : item.specifications}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="text-right py-4 px-2">{item.quantity}</td>
                    <td className="text-right py-4 px-2">{item.unit}</td>
                    <td className="text-right py-4 px-2">{formatCurrency(item.rate)}</td>
                    <td className="text-right py-4 px-2 font-semibold">
                      {formatCurrency(item.amount)}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          {/* Totals */}
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <div className="w-full md:w-96 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="opacity-70">Subtotal:</span>
                <span className="font-medium">{formatCurrency(invoice.subtotal)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="opacity-70">GST ({invoice.gst_percentage}%):</span>
                <span className="font-medium">{formatCurrency(invoice.gst_amount)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="border-t border-white/10 pt-3">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="text-lg font-bold">Total:</span>
                  <span className="text-3xl font-bold text-primary">
                    {formatCurrency(invoice.total_amount)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
              {invoice.status !== 'paid' && (
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center pt-2">
                  <span className="font-medium text-yellow-400">Amount Due:</span>
                  <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-400">
                    {formatCurrency(invoice.balance_amount)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Payment Terms */}
          {invoice.payment_terms && (
            <div className="mt-8 pt-8 border-t border-white/10">
              <div className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-1">Payment Terms</div>
              <div className="font-medium">{invoice.payment_terms}</div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { Plus, TrendingUp, TrendingDown } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function BillBookTab() {
  const [transactions, setTransactions] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTransactions();
  }, []);

  const fetchTransactions = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('transactions')
        .select('*')
        .order('transaction_date', { ascending: false })
        .limit(50);

      if (error) throw error;
      setTransactions(data || []);
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error('Failed to load transactions');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Your existing BillBook content here
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex gap-3 mb-6">
        <button className="btn btn--primary flex items-center gap-2">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          Add Income
        </button>
        <button className="btn btn--secondary flex items-center gap-2">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          Add Expense
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Transaction list */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {transactions.map((txn) => (
          <div key={txn.id} className="card p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                {txn.type === 'income' ? (
                  <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-green-400" />
                ) : (
                  <TrendingDown className="w-5 h-5 text-red-400" />
                )}
                <div>
                  <div className="font-medium">{txn.description}</div>
                  <div className="text-sm opacity-60">{txn.category}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={`text-lg font-bold ${txn.type === 'income' ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400'}`}>
                {txn.type === 'income' ? '+' : '-'}₹{txn.amount.toLocaleString('en-IN')}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# **🚀 STEP 6: Professional Invoice with PDF Generation**

## **Create PDF Generation Utility**

**Create:** `src/lib/pdf-generator.ts`

```typescript
import jsPDF from 'jspdf';
import autoTable from 'jspdf-autotable';

interface CompanyDetails {
  company_name: string;
  address_line1: string;
  address_line2?: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
  pincode: string;
  phone: string;
  email: string;
  gstin: string;
  bank_name?: string;
  account_number?: string;
  ifsc_code?: string;
}

interface ClientDetails {
  name: string;
  address_line1?: string;
  address_line2?: string;
  city?: string;
  state?: string;
  pincode?: string;
  gstin?: string;
  phone?: string;
  email?: string;
}

interface InvoiceItem {
  description: string;
  specifications?: string;
  quantity: number;
  unit: string;
  rate: number;
  amount: number;
}

interface InvoiceData {
  invoice_number: string;
  issue_date: string;
  due_date?: string;
  subject: string;
  subtotal: number;
  gst_percentage: number;
  gst_amount: number;
  total_amount: number;
  payment_terms?: string;
  company: CompanyDetails;
  client: ClientDetails;
  items: InvoiceItem[];
}

export function generateInvoicePDF(data: InvoiceData): void {
  const doc = new jsPDF();
  const pageWidth = doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
  const pageHeight = doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight();

  // Colors
  const primaryColor = '#21808D'; // Teal
  const darkGray = '#2C2C2C';
  const lightGray = '#666666';

  let yPos = 20;

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // HEADER - Company Name
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  doc.setFontSize(24);
  doc.setTextColor(primaryColor);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.text(data.company.company_name, 20, yPos);

  // INVOICE Label
  doc.setFontSize(28);
  doc.setTextColor(darkGray);
  doc.text('INVOICE', pageWidth - 20, yPos, { align: 'right' });

  yPos += 10;

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Company Address & Details
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  doc.setFontSize(9);
  doc.setTextColor(lightGray);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');

  doc.text(data.company.address_line1, 20, yPos);
  yPos += 4;

  if (data.company.address_line2) {
    doc.text(data.company.address_line2, 20, yPos);
    yPos += 4;
  }

  doc.text(`${data.company.city}, ${data.company.state} - ${data.company.pincode}`, 20, yPos);
  yPos += 4;

  doc.text(`Phone: ${data.company.phone}`, 20, yPos);
  yPos += 4;

  doc.text(`Email: ${data.company.email}`, 20, yPos);
  yPos += 4;

  doc.text(`GSTIN: ${data.company.gstin}`, 20, yPos);

  // Invoice Number & Date (Right side)
  yPos = 30;
  doc.setFontSize(10);
  doc.setTextColor(darkGray);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.text('Invoice Number:', pageWidth - 80, yPos);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  doc.text(data.invoice_number, pageWidth - 20, yPos, { align: 'right' });

  yPos += 6;
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.text('Issue Date:', pageWidth - 80, yPos);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  doc.text(new Date(data.issue_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN'), pageWidth - 20, yPos, { align: 'right' });

  if (data.due_date) {
    yPos += 6;
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
    doc.text('Due Date:', pageWidth - 80, yPos);
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
    doc.text(new Date(data.due_date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN'), pageWidth - 20, yPos, { align: 'right' });
  }

  yPos = 70;

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Bill To Section
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  doc.setFillColor(primaryColor);
  doc.rect(20, yPos, pageWidth - 40, 8, 'F');

  doc.setFontSize(11);
  doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.text('BILL TO', 22, yPos + 5);

  yPos += 13;

  doc.setFontSize(11);
  doc.setTextColor(darkGray);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.text(data.client.name, 20, yPos);

  yPos += 5;

  doc.setFontSize(9);
  doc.setTextColor(lightGray);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');

  if (data.client.address_line1) {
    doc.text(data.client.address_line1, 20, yPos);
    yPos += 4;
  }

  if (data.client.address_line2) {
    doc.text(data.client.address_line2, 20, yPos);
    yPos += 4;
  }

  if (data.client.city && data.client.state) {
    doc.text(`${data.client.city}, ${data.client.state}${data.client.pincode ? ' - ' + data.client.pincode : ''}`, 20, yPos);
    yPos += 4;
  }

  if (data.client.phone) {
    doc.text(`Phone: ${data.client.phone}`, 20, yPos);
    yPos += 4;
  }

  if (data.client.email) {
    doc.text(`Email: ${data.client.email}`, 20, yPos);
    yPos += 4;
  }

  if (data.client.gstin) {
    doc.text(`GSTIN: ${data.client.gstin}`, 20, yPos);
    yPos += 4;
  }

  yPos += 8;

  // Subject
  if (data.subject) {
    doc.setFontSize(10);
    doc.setTextColor(darkGray);
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
    doc.text('Subject:', 20, yPos);
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
    doc.text(data.subject, 20, yPos + 5, { maxWidth: pageWidth - 40 });
    yPos += 12;
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Items Table
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  const tableData = data.items.map((item) => [
    item.description + (item.specifications ? `\n${item.specifications}` : ''),
    item.quantity.toString(),
    item.unit,
    `₹${item.rate.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}`,
    `₹${item.amount.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}`,
  ]);

  autoTable(doc, {
    startY: yPos,
    head: [['Description', 'Qty', 'Unit', 'Rate', 'Amount']],
    body: tableData,
    theme: 'striped',
    headStyles: {
      fillColor: primaryColor,
      textColor: 255,
      fontSize: 10,
      fontStyle: 'bold',
      halign: 'left',
    },
    bodyStyles: {
      fontSize: 9,
      textColor: darkGray,
    },
    columnStyles: {
      0: { cellWidth: 80 },
      1: { halign: 'center', cellWidth: 20 },
      2: { halign: 'center', cellWidth: 20 },
      3: { halign: 'right', cellWidth: 30 },
      4: { halign: 'right', cellWidth: 35 },
    },
    margin: { left: 20, right: 20 },
  });

  // @ts-ignore
  yPos = doc.lastAutoTable.finalY + 10;

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Totals Section
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  const totalsX = pageWidth - 80;
  
  doc.setFontSize(10);
  doc.setTextColor(lightGray);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  doc.text('Subtotal:', totalsX, yPos);
  doc.text(`₹${data.subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}`, pageWidth - 20, yPos, { align: 'right' });

  yPos += 6;
  doc.text(`GST (${data.gst_percentage}%):`, totalsX, yPos);
  doc.text(`₹${data.gst_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}`, pageWidth - 20, yPos, { align: 'right' });

  yPos += 2;
  doc.setLineWidth(0.5);
  doc.setDrawColor(primaryColor);
  doc.line(totalsX, yPos, pageWidth - 20, yPos);

  yPos += 6;
  doc.setFontSize(12);
  doc.setTextColor(darkGray);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.text('Total Amount:', totalsX, yPos);
  doc.setTextColor(primaryColor);
  doc.text(`₹${data.total_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}`, pageWidth - 20, yPos, { align: 'right' });

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Bank Details (if available)
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (data.company.bank_name) {
    yPos += 15;
    
    doc.setFillColor(240, 240, 240);
    doc.rect(20, yPos - 5, pageWidth - 40, 25, 'F');

    doc.setFontSize(10);
    doc.setTextColor(darkGray);
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
    doc.text('BANK DETAILS', 22, yPos);

    yPos += 5;
    doc.setFontSize(9);
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
    doc.text(`Bank: ${data.company.bank_name}`, 22, yPos);
    yPos += 4;
    doc.text(`Account: ${data.company.account_number}`, 22, yPos);
    yPos += 4;
    doc.text(`IFSC: ${data.company.ifsc_code}`, 22, yPos);
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Payment Terms
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  if (data.payment_terms) {
    yPos += 15;
    doc.setFontSize(9);
    doc.setTextColor(lightGray);
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'italic');
    doc.text(`Payment Terms: ${data.payment_terms}`, 20, yPos);
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Footer
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  doc.setFontSize(8);
  doc.setTextColor(lightGray);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  doc.text('Thank you for your business!', pageWidth / 2, pageHeight - 20, { align: 'center' });
  doc.text(`Generated on ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}`, pageWidth / 2, pageHeight - 15, { align: 'center' });

  // Save PDF
  doc.save(`${data.invoice_number}.pdf`);
}
```

```typescript
const handleDownloadPDF = async () => {
  if (!invoice || !client) {
    toast.error('Invoice data not loaded');
    return;
  }

  try {
    // Fetch company settings
    const { data: companyData, error: companyError } = await supabaseClient
      .from('company_settings')

        state: companyData.state || '',

        gstin: companyData.gstin || '',
        bank_name: companyData.bank_name,
        account_number: companyData.account_number,
        ifsc_code: companyData.ifsc_code,
      },
      client: {
        name: client.name,
        address_line1: client.address_line1,
        address_line2: client.address_line2,
        city: client.city,
        state: client.state,
        pincode: client.pincode,
        gstin: client.gstin,
        phone: client.phone,
        email: client.email,
      },
      items: items.map((item) => ({
        description: item.description,
        specifications: typeof item.specifications === 'object' 
          ? item.specifications.notes 
          : item.specifications,
        quantity: item.quantity,
        unit: item.unit,
        rate: item.rate,
        amount: item.amount,
      })),
    };

    generateInvoicePDF(pdfData);
    toast.success('PDF downloaded successfully!');
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('PDF generation error:', error);
    toast.error('Failed to generate PDF');
  }
};
```

```typescript
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ArrowLeft, Save } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function NewClientPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    email: '',
    phone: '',
    whatsapp: '',
    address_line1: '',
    address_line2: '',
    city: '',
    state: '',
    pincode: '',
    gstin: '',
    pan: '',
  });

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!formData.name) {
      toast.error('Client name is required');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('clients')
        .insert([formData]);

      if (error) throw error;

      toast.success('Client created successfully!');
      router.push('/clients');
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Error creating client:', error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to create client');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 pb-24 max-w-4xl">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-8">
        <button
          onClick={() => router.back()}
          className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm flex items-center gap-2"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          Back
        </button>
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold">New Client</h1>
          <p className="text-lg opacity-70 mt-1">Add a new client to your system</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="card">
        <div className="p-6 space-y-6">
          {/* Basic Information */}
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Basic Information</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="form-group md:col-span-2">
                <label className="form-label">Client Name *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.name}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="Enter client name"
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Email</label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  value={formData.email}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, email: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="client@example.com"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Phone</label>
                <input
                  type="tel"
                  value={formData.phone}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, phone: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="+91 98765 43210"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">WhatsApp</label>
                <input
                  type="tel"
                  value={formData.whatsapp}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, whatsapp: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="+91 98765 43210"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Address Information */}
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Address</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="form-group md:col-span-2">
                <label className="form-label">Address Line 1</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.address_line1}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, address_line1: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="Street address"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group md:col-span-2">
                <label className="form-label">Address Line 2</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.address_line2}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, address_line2: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="Apartment, suite, etc. (optional)"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">City</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.city}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, city: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="City"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">State</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.state}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, state: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="State"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">PIN Code</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.pincode}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, pincode: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="400001"
                  maxLength={6}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Tax Information */}
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Tax Information</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">GSTIN</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.gstin}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, gstin: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="27XXXXX1234X1ZX"
                  maxLength={15}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">PAN</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.pan}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, pan: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="ABCDE1234F"
                  maxLength={10}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Actions */}
          <div className="flex gap-3 pt-4">
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="btn btn--primary flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
              {loading ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Client'}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => router.back()}
              className="btn btn--secondary"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### **STEP 9: Company Settings Page**

**Create:** `src/app/settings/page.tsx`

```typescript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { Save, Building2 } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function SettingsPage() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    company_name: '',
    address_line1: '',
    address_line2: '',
    city: '',
    state: '',
    pincode: '',
    phone: '',
    email: '',
    website: '',
    gstin: '',
    pan: '',
    bank_name: '',
    account_number: '',
    ifsc_code: '',
    account_holder_name: '',
    invoice_prefix: 'INV',
    quotation_prefix: 'QUO',
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchCompanySettings();
  }, []);

  const fetchCompanySettings = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('company_settings')
        .select('*')
        .single();

      if (error) throw error;

      if (data) {
        setFormData(data);
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Error fetching settings:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load settings');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);

    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('company_settings')
        .upsert([{ ...formData, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }]);

      if (error) throw error;

      toast.success('Settings saved successfully!');
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Error saving settings:', error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to save settings');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
          <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-4 border-primary border-t-transparent"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 pb-24 max-w-4xl">
      <div className="mb-8">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2 flex items-center gap-3">
          <Building2 className="w-10 h-10" />
          Company Settings
        </h1>
        <p className="text-lg opacity-70">Configure your company information for invoices and quotations</p>
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
        {/* Company Information */}
        <div className="card">
          <div className="p-6">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Company Information</h2>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="form-group md:col-span-2">
                <label className="form-label">Company Name *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.company_name}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, company_name: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group md:col-span-2">
                <label className="form-label">Address Line 1</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.address_line1}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, address_line1: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group md:col-span-2">
                <label className="form-label">Address Line 2</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.address_line2}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, address_line2: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">City</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.city}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, city: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">State</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.state}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, state: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">PIN Code</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.pincode}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, pincode: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  maxLength={6}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Phone</label>
                <input
                  type="tel"
                  value={formData.phone}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, phone: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Email</label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  value={formData.email}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, email: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Website</label>
                <input
                  type="url"
                  value={formData.website}

                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="https://yourcompany.com"
                />

            </div>
          </div>

        {/* Tax Information */}
        <div className="card">
          <div className="p-6">
```
