```typescript
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">GSTIN</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.gstin}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, gstin: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="27XXXXX1234X1ZX"
                  maxLength={15}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">PAN</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.pan}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, pan: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="ABCDE1234F"
                  maxLength={10}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Bank Details */}
        <div className="card">
          <div className="p-6">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Bank Details</h2>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="form-group md:col-span-2">
                <label className="form-label">Bank Name</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.bank_name}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, bank_name: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="State Bank of India"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Account Holder Name</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.account_holder_name}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, account_holder_name: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Account Number</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.account_number}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, account_number: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">IFSC Code</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.ifsc_code}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, ifsc_code: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="SBIN0001234"
                  maxLength={11}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Document Prefixes */}
        <div className="card">
          <div className="p-6">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Document Settings</h2>
            
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Invoice Prefix</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.invoice_prefix}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, invoice_prefix: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="INV"
                  maxLength={5}
                />
                <p className="text-xs opacity-60 mt-1">Example: INV-2024001</p>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Quotation Prefix</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.quotation_prefix}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, quotation_prefix: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="QUO"
                  maxLength={5}
                />
                <p className="text-xs opacity-60 mt-1">Example: QUO-2024001</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Save Button */}
        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={saving}
            className="btn btn--primary flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
            {saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Settings'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# is it better to move invoices and quotation folder under finances folder to kinda tidy the project?

**Good question!** Let me give you the pros/cons and my recommendation:

***

# **📁 FOLDER STRUCTURE OPTIONS**

## **❌ DON'T Nest Under /finances (Keep Current Structure)**

### **Recommended Structure:**

```
src/app/
├── finances/          # Main finances page with tabs
│   └── page.tsx
├── invoices/          # Invoice routes
│   ├── [id]/page.tsx  # /invoices/123
│   └── new/page.tsx   # /invoices/new
├── quotations/        # Quotation routes
│   ├── [id]/page.tsx  # /quotations/456
│   └── new/page.tsx   # /quotations/new
├── projects/
├── clients/
└── materials/
```


***

## **WHY THIS IS BETTER:**

### **✅ Pros of Keeping Them Separate:**

1. **Cleaner URLs**
    - ✅ `/invoices/123` (clean, shareable)
    - ❌ `/finances/invoices/123` (longer, awkward)
2. **Better for SEO \& Sharing**
    - Invoice links are more professional
    - Easier to bookmark specific invoices
3. **Next.js Routing Simplicity**
    - Direct route mapping
    - No extra nesting complexity
4. **FAB Links Work Directly**
    - `href="/invoices/new"` stays simple
    - No need to update all references
5. **Follows Standard Patterns**
    - Most SaaS apps use `/invoices/123`
    - Industry-standard URL structure

***

## **❌ Cons of Nesting Under /finances:**

1. **Longer URLs**
    - `/finances/invoices/new` vs `/invoices/new`
    - Awkward to share
2. **Breaking Changes**
    - Would need to update ALL links:
        - FAB buttons
        - Navigation
        - Tab components
        - Router.push() calls
3. **Route Confusion**
    - `/finances` → Tab view
    - `/finances/invoices/123` → Detail view?
    - Mixing concerns
4. **No Real Benefit**
    - Folder organization is fine
    - Doesn't improve code structure

***

## **✅ RECOMMENDED: Keep Current Structure**

**Just delete the old list pages:**

```bash
# Delete only these (replaced by /finances tabs):
rm src/app/invoices/page.tsx
rm src/app/quotations/page.tsx
rm -rf src/app/billbook/
```

**Keep everything else as-is!**

***

## **🎯 FINAL STRUCTURE:**

```
src/app/
├── finances/
│   └── page.tsx                    # Tabs: BillBook | Invoices | Quotations
├── invoices/
│   ├── [id]/page.tsx               # View/edit invoice detail
│   └── new/page.tsx                # Create new invoice
├── quotations/
│   ├── [id]/page.tsx               # View/edit quotation detail
│   └── new/page.tsx                # Create new quotation
├── projects/

│   ├── [id]/page.tsx               # Project detail

├── clients/
│   ├── page.tsx                    # Client list
│   ├── [id]/page.tsx               # Client detail
│   └── new/page.tsx                # Create client
├── materials/
│   ├── page.tsx                    # Material inventory
│   └── purchase/page.tsx           # Record purchase
└── settings/
    └── page.tsx                    # Company settings
```

## **📋 URL FLOW:**

### **User Journey:**

Type 'string | null' is not assignable to type 'string | undefined'.
Type 'null' is not assignable to type 'string | undefined'.

Perfect! Quick fix - update the `InvoiceData` interface in your PDF generator to accept `null`:

***

## **🔧 FIX: Update PDF Generator Interface**

**In:** `src/lib/pdf-generator.ts`

**Find the `InvoiceData` interface and update it:**

```typescript
interface InvoiceData {
  invoice_number: string;
  issue_date: string;
  due_date?: string | null;        // ✅ Changed: Added | null
  subject: string;
  subtotal: number;
  gst_percentage: number;
  gst_amount: number;
  total_amount: number;
  payment_terms?: string | null;   // ✅ Changed: Added | null
  company: CompanyDetails;
  client: ClientDetails;
  items: InvoiceItem[];
}
```

**That's it!** Now TypeScript will accept both `null` and `undefined`. ✅

***

## **💡 ALTERNATIVE: Convert in Invoice Page**

If you prefer to keep the interface strict, you can convert `null` to `undefined` in the invoice page:

```typescript
};
```

## **✅ RECOMMENDED: Update Interface (Cleaner)**

Go with the **first option** (updating the interface) because:

## **🔧 FIX: QuotationsTab Component**

```typescript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Plus, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface Quotation {
  id: string;
  quotation_number: string;
  date: string;
  status: string;
  total_amount: number;
  client?: any;
}

export default function QuotationsTab() {
  const [quotations, setQuotations] = useState<Quotation[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchQuotations();
  }, []);

  const fetchQuotations = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);

      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotations')
        .select(`
          id,
          quotation_number,
          date,
          status,
          total_amount,
          client:clients (
            id,
            name
          )
        `)
        .order('date', { ascending: false });

      if (error) {
        console.error('Quotations fetch error:', error);
        throw error;
      }

      setQuotations(data || []);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load quotations:', error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to load quotations');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status?.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'accepted':
        return 'text-green-400';
      case 'sent':
        return 'text-blue-400';
      case 'rejected':
        return 'text-red-400';
      default:
        return 'text-yellow-400';
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-4 border-primary border-t-transparent"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">All Quotations</h2>
        <Link href="/quotations/new" className="btn btn--primary flex items-center gap-2">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          New Quotation
        </Link>
      </div>

      {quotations.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="card p-12 text-center">
          <FileText className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-2">No quotations yet</h3>
          <p className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-6">Create your first quotation to get started</p>
          <Link href="/quotations/new" className="btn btn--primary inline-flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Create Quotation
          </Link>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {quotations.map((quote) => {
            // Handle client data (could be array or object)
            const clientName = quote.client && Array.isArray(quote.client)
              ? quote.client[0]?.name
              : quote.client?.name || 'Unknown Client';

            return (
              <Link
                key={quote.id}
                href={`/quotations/${quote.id}`}
                className="card p-4 block hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors group"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-1">
                      <div className="font-bold text-lg group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">
                        {quote.quotation_number}
                      </div>
                      <span className={`text-xs font-medium ${getStatusColor(quote.status)}`}>
                        {quote.status}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-sm opacity-70">{clientName}</div>
                    <div className="text-xs opacity-60 mt-1">
                      {new Date(quote.date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">
                      ₹{(quote.total_amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## **📋 IF TABLE DOESN'T EXIST - Create It**

**Run this in Supabase SQL Editor:**

```sql
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- CREATE QUOTATIONS TABLE
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quotations (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  quotation_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  client_id UUID REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  valid_until DATE,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'sent', 'accepted', 'rejected')),
  subject TEXT,
  subtotal DECIMAL(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  gst_percentage DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 18,
  gst_amount DECIMAL(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  total_amount DECIMAL(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
  terms_conditions TEXT,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Quotation items table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quotation_items (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  quotation_id UUID REFERENCES quotations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  item_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  specifications JSONB,
  quantity DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  unit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unit',
  rate DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL,
  amount DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Indexes
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotations_client ON quotations(client_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotations_date ON quotations(date DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotations_status ON quotations(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotation_items_quotation ON quotation_items(quotation_id);
```

```typescript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Plus, FileText } from 'lucide-react';

export default function QuotationsTab() {
  const [quotations, setQuotations] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchQuotations();
  }, []);

  const fetchQuotations = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      const { data, error: fetchError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotations')
        .select(`
          id,
          quotation_number,
          date,
          status,
          total_amount,
          client:clients(name)
        `)
        .order('date', { ascending: false });

      if (fetchError) {
        // Table might not exist
        console.error('Quotations fetch error:', fetchError);
        setError('Quotations feature not yet configured');
        setQuotations([]);
        return;
      }

      setQuotations(data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error:', err);
      setError('Failed to load quotations');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-4 border-primary border-t-transparent"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="card p-12 text-center">
        <FileText className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
        <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-2">Quotations Coming Soon</h3>
        <p className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-6">{error}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">All Quotations</h2>
        <Link href="/quotations/new" className="btn btn--primary flex items-center gap-2">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          New Quotation
        </Link>
      </div>

      {quotations.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="card p-12 text-center">
          <FileText className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-2">No quotations yet</h3>
          <p className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-6">Create your first quotation</p>
          <Link href="/quotations/new" className="btn btn--primary inline-flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Create Quotation
          </Link>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {quotations.map((quote) => (
            <Link
              key={quote.id}
              href={`/quotations/${quote.id}`}
              className="card p-4 block hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="font-bold text-lg">{quote.quotation_number}</div>
                  <div className="text-sm opacity-70">
                    {quote.client?.[0]?.name || quote.client?.name || 'Unknown'}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">
                  ₹{(quote.total_amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                </div>
              </div>
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

# did we figure where the date did not exist? is that a prob, did we need to add date? seems like an imp column?

Great question! Let me explain what happened and whether we need to fix it:

***

## **🔍 WHAT HAPPENED:**

Looking at your **quotations** table structure, I can see:


| Column | Type | Purpose |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| ✅ `created_at` | timestamp | When quotation was created |
| ✅ `updated_at` | timestamp | When quotation was last modified |
| ❌ `date` | **MISSING** | Quotation date (the date ON the quotation) |


***

## **🤔 IS THIS A PROBLEM?**

**YES - It's a minor problem!** Here's why:

### **What you currently have:**

- `created_at` = System timestamp (when record was inserted)
- This is NOT the same as the quotation date


### **What you should have:**

- `date` = The actual quotation date (like invoice date)
- `created_at` = System tracking (when created in database)

**Example scenario:**

- You create a quotation today (Nov 3, 2025)
- But the quotation is dated Oct 28, 2025 (backdated)
- Without a `date` column, you can't do this!

***

## **✅ THE FIX: Add `date` Column to Quotations**

Run this in **Supabase SQL Editor:**

```sql
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- ADD MISSING DATE COLUMN TO QUOTATIONS
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

-- Add date column (defaults to current date for new quotations)
ALTER TABLE quotations 
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE;

-- Update existing quotations to use created_at as date
UPDATE quotations 
SET date = created_at::date 
WHERE date IS NULL;

-- Add valid_until column (useful for expiry)
ALTER TABLE quotations 
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS valid_until DATE;

-- Add index for the date column
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotations_date ON quotations(date DESC);
```


***

## **📊 UPDATED QUOTATIONS TABLE STRUCTURE**

After running the fix, your quotations table will have:


| Column | Type | Purpose |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| ✅ `date` | DATE | **The quotation date (shown on PDF)** |
| ✅ `valid_until` | DATE | When quotation expires |
| ✅ `created_at` | TIMESTAMP | System tracking |
| ✅ `updated_at` | TIMESTAMP | Last modification |


***

## **🔧 UPDATE QuotationsTab Component**

Now update the component to use `date` instead of `created_at`:

**Update:** `src/components/finances/QuotationsTab.tsx`

Change this line:

```typescript
// FROM:
.order('created_at', { ascending: false });

// TO:
.order('date', { ascending: false });
```

And update the display:

```typescript
// FROM:
<div className="text-xs opacity-60 mt-1">
  {new Date(quote.created_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}
</div>

// TO:
<div className="text-xs opacity-60 mt-1">
  {new Date(quote.date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}
</div>
```


***

## **🎯 WHY THIS MATTERS:**

### **Without `date` column:**

❌ Can't backdate quotations
❌ Can't set future quotation dates
❌ Sorting by `created_at` shows when YOU created it, not the actual quotation date
❌ PDF would show wrong date

### **With `date` column:**

✅ Proper quotation dating
✅ Can backdate if needed
✅ Correct sorting by actual quotation date
✅ Professional PDFs with correct dates
✅ Expiry tracking with `valid_until`

***

## **✅ COMPLETE FIX CHECKLIST:**

1. **Run SQL to add `date` column** ✅
2. **Update QuotationsTab to use `date`** ✅
3. **Update quotation creation form** (add date picker)
4. **Test creating new quotation** ✅

***

## **📝 SUMMARY:**

**Issue:** Quotations table uses `created_at` instead of a proper `date` column
**Impact:** Minor - works but not ideal for professional use
**Fix:** Add `date` column with the SQL above
**Time:** 2 minutes to fix

**Run the SQL now and you're good to go!** 🚀

```sql
-- 2. UPGRADE QUOTATIONS TABLE - Add Modern Structure
-- ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

-- Add quotation_number with proper format
ALTER TABLE quotations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS quotation_number TEXT;

-- Add project_id foreign key
ALTER TABLE quotations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

-- Add professional fields
ALTER TABLE quotations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS subject TEXT;
ALTER TABLE quotations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS subtotal NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE quotations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS gst_percentage NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 18;
ALTER TABLE quotations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS gst_amount NUMERIC(15,2) DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE quotations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS terms_conditions TEXT;
ALTER TABLE quotations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS notes TEXT;

-- Generate unique quotation numbers for existing records
DO $$
DECLARE
    rec RECORD;
    counter INT := 1;
    year_prefix TEXT := TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY');
BEGIN
    FOR rec IN SELECT id, created_at FROM quotations WHERE quotation_number IS NULL ORDER BY created_at
    LOOP
        UPDATE quotations 
        SET quotation_number = 'QUO-' || year_prefix || LPAD(counter::TEXT, 4, '0')
        WHERE id = rec.id;
        counter := counter + 1;
    END LOOP;
END $$;

-- Make quotation_number NOT NULL and UNIQUE
ALTER TABLE quotations ALTER COLUMN quotation_number SET NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotations_number_unique ON quotations(quotation_number);

-- Calculate totals for existing quotations (if they have old structure)
UPDATE quotations 
SET 
    subtotal = COALESCE(total_amount, 0) / (1 + COALESCE(gst_percentage, 18) / 100),
    gst_amount = COALESCE(total_amount, 0) - (COALESCE(total_amount, 0) / (1 + COALESCE(gst_percentage, 18) / 100))
WHERE subtotal = 0 AND total_amount IS NOT NULL AND total_amount > 0;

-- Note: Keep old fields (labor_hours, hourly_rate, material_cost, etc.) for reference
-- Don't drop them - they might contain useful historical data

-- ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
-- 3. ADD MISSING project_id TO TRANSACTIONS
-- ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ALTER TABLE transactions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

-- ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
-- 4. ADD MISSING budget COLUMN TO PROJECTS (if not exists)
-- ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS budget NUMERIC(15,2);

-- Populate budget from quoted_amount if empty
UPDATE projects 
SET budget = quoted_amount 
WHERE budget IS NULL AND quoted_amount IS NOT NULL;

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 5. CREATE ALL PRODUCTION INDEXES
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

-- Clients
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_clients_name ON clients(name);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_clients_created ON clients(created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_clients_gstin ON clients(gstin) WHERE gstin IS NOT NULL;

-- Projects
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_client ON projects(client_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_status ON projects(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_deadline ON projects(deadline) WHERE deadline IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_created ON projects(created_at DESC);

-- Quotations
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotations_client ON quotations(client_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotations_project ON quotations(project_id) WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotations_status ON quotations(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotations_date ON quotations(date DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotations_number ON quotations(quotation_number);

-- Quotation Items
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotation_items_quotation ON quotation_items(quotation_id);

-- Invoices
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_invoices_client ON invoices_enhanced(client_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_invoices_project ON invoices_enhanced(project_id) WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_invoices_quotation ON invoices_enhanced(quotation_id) WHERE quotation_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_invoices_status ON invoices_enhanced(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_invoices_issue_date ON invoices_enhanced(issue_date DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_invoices_due_date ON invoices_enhanced(due_date) WHERE due_date IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_invoices_number ON invoices_enhanced(invoice_number);

-- Invoice Items
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_invoice_items_invoice ON invoice_items(invoice_id);

-- Transactions
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transactions_date ON transactions(transaction_date DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transactions_type ON transactions(type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transactions_client ON transactions(client_id) WHERE client_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transactions_project ON transactions(project_id) WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transactions_invoice ON transactions(invoice_id) WHERE invoice_id IS NOT NULL;

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 6. ADD PROPER CONSTRAINTS
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

-- Quotations status
ALTER TABLE quotations DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS quotations_status_check;
ALTER TABLE quotations ADD CONSTRAINT quotations_status_check 
  CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'sent', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'converted', 'expired'));

-- Invoice status
ALTER TABLE invoices_enhanced DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS invoices_status_check;
ALTER TABLE invoices_enhanced ADD CONSTRAINT invoices_status_check 
  CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'pending', 'sent', 'paid', 'overdue', 'cancelled', 'partial'));

-- Project status
ALTER TABLE projects DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS projects_status_check;
ALTER TABLE projects ADD CONSTRAINT projects_status_check 
  CHECK (status IN ('not_started', 'planning', 'in_progress', 'on_hold', 'review', 'completed', 'cancelled'));

-- Transaction type
ALTER TABLE transactions DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS transactions_type_check;
ALTER TABLE transactions ADD CONSTRAINT transactions_type_check 
  CHECK (type IN ('income', 'expense'));

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 7. VERIFY EVERYTHING
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

-- Show updated quotations structure
SELECT 
    column_name, 
    data_type,
    is_nullable,
    column_default
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_name = 'quotations'
ORDER BY ordinal_position;

-- Count indexes
SELECT 
    tablename,
    COUNT(*) as index_count
FROM pg_indexes
WHERE schemaname = 'public'
  AND tablename IN ('clients', 'projects', 'quotations', 'invoices_enhanced', 'transactions')
GROUP BY tablename
ORDER BY tablename;
```

```typescript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Plus, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function QuotationsTab() {
  const [quotations, setQuotations] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchQuotations();
  }, []);

  const fetchQuotations = async () => {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotations')
        .select(`
          id,
          quotation_number,
          date,
          valid_until,
          status,
          subject,
          total_amount,
          client:clients (
            id,
            name
          ),
          project:projects (
            id,
            name
          )
        `)
        .order('date', { ascending: false });

      if (error) throw error;
      setQuotations(data || []);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load quotations:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load quotations');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status?.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'accepted':
      case 'converted':
        return 'text-green-400';
      case 'sent':
        return 'text-blue-400';
      case 'rejected':
      case 'expired':
        return 'text-red-400';
      default:
        return 'text-yellow-400';
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-4 border-primary border-t-transparent"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">All Quotations</h2>
        <Link href="/quotations/new" className="btn btn--primary flex items-center gap-2">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          New Quotation
        </Link>
      </div>

      {quotations.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="card p-12 text-center">
          <FileText className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold mb-2">No quotations yet</h3>
          <p className="text-sm opacity-70 mb-6">Create your first quotation</p>
          <Link href="/quotations/new" className="btn btn--primary inline-flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Create Quotation
          </Link>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {quotations.map((quote) => {
            const clientName = quote.client?.[0]?.name || quote.client?.name || 'Unknown Client';
            const projectName = quote.project?.[0]?.name || quote.project?.name || quote.project_name;

            return (
              <Link
                key={quote.id}
                href={`/quotations/${quote.id}`}
                className="card p-4 block hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors group"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-1">
                      <div className="font-bold text-lg group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">
                        {quote.quotation_number}
                      </div>
                      <span className={`text-xs font-medium ${getStatusColor(quote.status)}`}>
                        {quote.status}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    
                    {quote.subject && (
                      <div className="text-sm font-medium mb-1">{quote.subject}</div>
                    )}
                    
                    <div className="text-sm opacity-70">{clientName}</div>
                    
                    {projectName && (
                      <div className="text-xs opacity-60 mt-1">Project: {projectName}</div>
                    )}
                    
                    <div className="text-xs opacity-60 mt-1 flex items-center gap-3">
                      <span>Date: {new Date(quote.date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}</span>
                      {quote.valid_until && (
                        <span>Valid Until: {new Date(quote.valid_until).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}</span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">
                      ₹{(quote.total_amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ArrowLeft, Plus, Trash2, Save } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

interface QuotationItem {
  id: string;
  description: string;
  specifications: string;
  quantity: number;
  unit: string;
  rate: number;
  amount: number;
}

export default function NewQuotationPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [clients, setClients] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    client_id: '',
    project_id: '',
    subject: '',
    date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    valid_until: '',
    gst_percentage: 18,
    terms_conditions: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  const [items, setItems] = useState<QuotationItem[]>([
    {
      id: '1',
      description: '',
      specifications: '',
      quantity: 1,
      unit: 'unit',
      rate: 0,
      amount: 0,
    },
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchClients();
    fetchProjects();
  }, []);

  const fetchClients = async () => {
    const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
      .from('clients')
      .select('id, name')
      .order('name');

    if (!error && data) {
      setClients(data);
    }
  };

  const fetchProjects = async () => {
    const { data, error } = await supabaseClient
      .from('projects')
      .select('id, name, client_id')
      .order('name');

    if (!error && data) {
      setProjects(data);
    }
  };

  const calculateItemAmount = (quantity: number, rate: number) => {
    return quantity * rate;
  };

  const updateItem = (id: string, field: string, value: any) => {
    setItems(
      items.map((item) => {
        if (item.id === id) {
          const updated = { ...item, [field]: value };
          if (field === 'quantity' || field === 'rate') {
            updated.amount = calculateItemAmount(
              field === 'quantity' ? value : updated.quantity,
              field === 'rate' ? value : updated.rate
            );
          }
          return updated;
        }
        return item;
      })
    );
  };

  const addItem = () => {
    setItems([
      ...items,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        description: '',
        specifications: '',
        quantity: 1,
        unit: 'unit',
        rate: 0,
        amount: 0,
      },
    ]);
  };

  const removeItem = (id: string) => {
    if (items.length > 1) {
      setItems(items.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
    }
  };

  const calculateTotals = () => {
    const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.amount, 0);
    const gst_amount = (subtotal * formData.gst_percentage) / 100;
    const total_amount = subtotal + gst_amount;

    return { subtotal, gst_amount, total_amount };
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!formData.client_id) {
      toast.error('Please select a client');
      return;
    }

    if (items.some((item) => !item.description)) {
      toast.error('Please fill in all item descriptions');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const { subtotal, gst_amount, total_amount } = calculateTotals();

      // Generate quotation number
      const year = new Date().getFullYear();
      const { data: existingQuotes } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotations')
        .select('quotation_number')
        .like('quotation_number', `QUO-${year}%`)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
        .limit(1);

      let quotationNumber = `QUO-${year}0001`;
      if (existingQuotes && existingQuotes.length > 0) {
        const lastNumber = parseInt(existingQuotes[0].quotation_number.split('-')[1].slice(4));
        quotationNumber = `QUO-${year}${String(lastNumber + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`;
      }

      // Insert quotation
      const { data: quotation, error: quotationError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotations')
        .insert([
          {
            quotation_number: quotationNumber,
            client_id: formData.client_id,
            project_id: formData.project_id || null,
            subject: formData.subject || null,
            date: formData.date,
            valid_until: formData.valid_until || null,
            subtotal,
            gst_percentage: formData.gst_percentage,
            gst_amount,
            total_amount,
            terms_conditions: formData.terms_conditions || null,
            notes: formData.notes || null,
            status: 'draft',
          },
        ])
        .select()
        .single();

      if (quotationError) throw quotationError;

      // Insert items
      const itemsToInsert = items.map((item, index) => ({
        quotation_id: quotation.id,
        item_number: index + 1,
        description: item.description,
        specifications: item.specifications ? { notes: item.specifications } : null,
        quantity: item.quantity,
        unit: item.unit,
        rate: item.rate,
        amount: item.amount,
      }));

      const { error: itemsError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotation_items')
        .insert(itemsToInsert);

      if (itemsError) throw itemsError;

      toast.success('Quotation created successfully!');
      router.push(`/quotations/${quotation.id}`);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Error creating quotation:', error);
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to create quotation');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const { subtotal, gst_amount, total_amount } = calculateTotals();

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 pb-24 max-w-6xl">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-8">
        <button
          onClick={() => router.back()}
          className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm flex items-center gap-2"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          Back
        </button>
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold">New Quotation</h1>
          <p className="text-lg opacity-70 mt-1">Create a new quotation for your client</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
        {/* Basic Details */}
        <div className="card">
          <div className="p-6">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Basic Details</h2>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Client *</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.client_id}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, client_id: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  required
                >
                  <option value="">Select Client</option>
                  {clients.map((client) => (
                    <option key={client.id} value={client.id}>
                      {client.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Project (Optional)</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.project_id}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, project_id: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                >
                  <option value="">No Project</option>
                  {projects
                    .filter((p) => !formData.client_id || p.client_id === formData.client_id)
                    .map((project) => (
                      <option key={project.id} value={project.id}>
                        {project.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group md:col-span-2">
                <label className="form-label">Subject</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.subject}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, subject: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  placeholder="Quotation subject or title"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Date *</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={formData.date}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, date: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Valid Until</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={formData.valid_until}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, valid_until: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Items */}
        <div className="card">
          <div className="p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">Items</h2>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={addItem}
                className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                Add Item
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              {items.map((item, index) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="border border-white/10 rounded-lg p-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                    <h3 className="font-bold">Item {index + 1}</h3>
                    {items.length > 1 && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => removeItem(item.id)}
                        className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div className="form-group md:col-span-2">
                      <label className="form-label">Description *</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={item.description}
                        onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'description', e.target.value)}
                        className="form-control"
                        placeholder="Item description"
                        required
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="form-group md:col-span-2">
                      <label className="form-label">Specifications</label>
                      <textarea
                        value={item.specifications}
                        onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'specifications', e.target.value)}
                        className="form-control"
                        rows={2}
                        placeholder="Additional specifications or details"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="form-label">Quantity *</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        value={item.quantity}
                        onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'quantity', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                        className="form-control"
                        min="0"
                        step="0.01"
                        required
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="form-label">Unit</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={item.unit}
                        onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'unit', e.target.value)}
                        className="form-control"
                        placeholder="unit, piece, hour, etc."
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="form-label">Rate (₹) *</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        value={item.rate}
                        onChange={(e) => updateItem(item.id, 'rate', parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                        className="form-control"
                        min="0"
                        step="0.01"
                        required
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="form-label">Amount (₹)</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        value={item.amount}
                        className="form-control"
                        disabled
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Totals & Terms */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <div className="card">
            <div className="p-6">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Terms & Notes</h2>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Terms & Conditions</label>
                <textarea
                  value={formData.terms_conditions}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, terms_conditions: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  rows={4}
                  placeholder="Payment terms, delivery conditions, etc."
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="form-label">Notes</label>
                <textarea
                  value={formData.notes}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, notes: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-control"
                  rows={3}
                  placeholder="Additional notes or comments"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="card">
            <div className="p-6">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Totals</h2>

              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex justify-between text-lg">
                  <span className="opacity-70">Subtotal:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold">₹{subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="form-group">
                  <label className="form-label">GST %</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    value={formData.gst_percentage}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, gst_percentage: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                    className="form-control"
                    min="0"
                    max="100"
                    step="0.01"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-between text-lg">
                  <span className="opacity-70">GST ({formData.gst_percentage}%):</span>
                  <span className="font-bold">₹{gst_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="border-t border-white/10 pt-4">
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-2xl">
                    <span className="font-bold">Total:</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-primary">
                      ₹{total_amount.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Actions */}
        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="btn btn--primary flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
            {loading ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Quotation'}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => router.back()}
            className="btn btn--secondary"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```


***

## **✅ KEY CHANGES:**

1. **Removed old fields:**
    - ❌ `labor_hours`, `hourly_rate`, `material_cost`, `margin_percentage`, `project_name`
2. **Added new fields:**
    - ✅ `quotation_number` (auto-generated)
    - ✅ `project_id` (foreign key instead of text)
    - ✅ `subject` (quotation title)
    - ✅ `subtotal`, `gst_percentage`, `gst_amount` (proper tax)
    - ✅ `terms_conditions`, `notes`
    - ✅ `date`, `valid_until`
3. **Fixed quotation number generation:**
    - Generates `QUO-20250001` format
    - Auto-increments based on year
4. **Proper item structure:**
    - Uses `quotation_items` table correctly
    - Specifications stored as JSONB

***

# whats the command to pull the complete filestructure on vscode

Here are the commands to get your complete file structure in VSCode:

***

## **📂 Generate File Structure Tree**

### **Option 1: Using `tree` command (macOS/Linux)**

**In VSCode integrated terminal:**

```bash
# Install tree if not installed (macOS)
brew install tree

# Generate complete tree excluding node_modules and .next
tree -I 'node_modules|.next|.git' -L 4 > project-structure.txt

# Or simpler version (directories only)
tree -I 'node_modules|.next|.git' -d -L 3

# Or just show important src/ directory
tree src/ -I 'node_modules' -L 4
```


***

### **Option 2: Using `find` command (Works everywhere)**

```bash
# Full structure
find . -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/.next/*" -not -path "*/.git/*" | sort

# Just directories
find . -type d -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/.next/*" -not -path "*/.git/*" | sort

# Just src/ directory
find ./src -type f | sort

# Save to file
find ./src -type f | sort > src-structure.txt
```


***

### **Option 3: Using `ls` with directories**

```bash
# Show src/ structure
ls -R src/

# Save to file
ls -R src/ > src-files.txt
```


***

### **Option 4: VSCode Extension - "File Tree Generator"**

1. Install extension: **File Tree Generator** by Shinotatwu-DS
2. Right-click on `src/` folder in Explorer
3. Select "Generate Tree"
4. It will create a markdown-formatted tree

***

### **Option 5: Quick Node.js Script**

**Create a file `list-files.js` in your project root:**

```javascript
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

function listFiles(dir, indent = '') {
  const items = fs.readdirSync(dir);
  items.forEach(item => {
    if (item === 'node_modules' || item === '.next' || item === '.git') return;
    
    const fullPath = path.join(dir, item);
    const stats = fs.statSync(fullPath);
    
    if (stats.isDirectory()) {
      console.log(`${indent}📁 ${item}/`);
      listFiles(fullPath, indent + '  ');
    } else {
      console.log(`${indent}📄 ${item}`);
    }
  });
}

listFiles('./src');
```

**Run it:**

```bash
node list-files.js > structure.txt
```


***

## **🎯 Recommended: Quick Tree Command**

**For your SculptureFlow project, run this:**

```bash
tree src/ -I 'node_modules' -L 4 --dirsfirst > PROJECT-STRUCTURE.txt
```

**This will create a file with:**

```
src/
├── app/
│   ├── clients/
```

I got you! Same issue as before - the **detail pages still have the old column references**. Let me fix both:

***

## **🔧 FIX 1: Invoice Detail Page - clients.address error**

The invoice detail page is still trying to query `clients.address` instead of `address_line1`.

**Update:** `src/app/invoices/[id]/page.tsx`

Find the client query section and update it. Here's what needs to change:

**Search for this in your invoice detail page:**

```typescript
client:clients (
  id,
  name,
  email,
  phone,
  address,  // ❌ OLD
  city,
  state,
  pincode,
  gstin
)
```

**Replace with:**

```typescript
client:clients (
  id,
  name,
  email,
  phone,
  address_line1,  // ✅ NEW
  address_line2,  // ✅ NEW
  city,
  state,
  pincode,
  gstin
)
```


***

## **🔧 FIX 2: Create Quotation Detail Page**

You don't have a quotation detail page yet! That's why it fails. Let me create it:

**Create file:** `src/app/quotations/[id]/page.tsx`

```typescript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabaseClient } from '@/lib/supabaseClient';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ArrowLeft, Download, Edit, Trash2, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function QuotationDetailPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [quotation, setQuotation] = useState<any>(null);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchQuotation();
  }, [params.id]);

  const fetchQuotation = async () => {
    try {
      // Fetch quotation with related data
      const { data: quotationData, error: quotationError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotations')
        .select(`
          *,
          client:clients (
            id,
            name,
            email,
            phone,
            address_line1,
            address_line2,
            city,
            state,
            pincode,
            gstin
          ),
          project:projects (
            id,
            name
          )
        `)
        .eq('id', params.id)
        .single();

      if (quotationError) throw quotationError;

      // Fetch quotation items
      const { data: itemsData, error: itemsError } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotation_items')
        .select('*')
        .eq('quotation_id', params.id)
        .order('item_number');

      if (itemsError) throw itemsError;

      setQuotation(quotationData);
      setItems(itemsData || []);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Error fetching quotation:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to load quotation');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this quotation?')) return;

    try {
      const { error } = await supabaseClient
        .from('quotations')
        .delete()
        .eq('id', params.id);

      if (error) throw error;

      toast.success('Quotation deleted successfully');
      router.push('/finances');
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Error deleting quotation:', error);
      toast.error('Failed to delete quotation');
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status?.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'accepted':
      case 'converted':
        return 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 border-green-500/30';
      case 'sent':
        return 'bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30';
      case 'rejected':
      case 'expired':
        return 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border-red-500/30';
      default:
        return 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-500/30';
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-4 border-primary border-t-transparent"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!quotation) {
    return (
      <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">
        <div className="card p-12 text-center">
          <FileText className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">Quotation not found</h2>
          <p className="opacity-70 mb-6">The quotation you're looking for doesn't exist.</p>
          <button onClick={() => router.push('/finances')} className="btn btn--primary">
            Back to Finances
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const client = Array.isArray(quotation.client) ? quotation.client[^89_0] : quotation.client;
  const project = Array.isArray(quotation.project) ? quotation.project[^89_0] : quotation.project;

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8 max-w-4xl">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <button
            onClick={() => router.back()}
            className="btn btn--secondary btn--sm flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            Back
          </button>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold">{quotation.quotation_number}</h1>
            <p className="text-lg opacity-70 mt-1">
              {quotation.subject || 'Quotation Details'}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-medium border ${getStatusColor(quotation.status)}`}>
            {quotation.status}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Actions */}
      <div className="flex gap-3 mb-6">
        <button className="btn btn--primary flex items-center gap-2">
          <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
          Download PDF
        </button>
        <button className="btn btn--secondary flex items-center gap-2">
          <Edit className="w-4 h-4" />
          Edit
        </button>
        <button onClick={handleDelete} className="btn btn--secondary flex items-center gap-2 text-red-400">
```

## **🔧 Step 1: Update pdf-generator.ts to Support Quotations**

Add this quotation PDF function (add after the invoice function):

```typescript
// Add this to your existing pdf-generator.ts

export const generateQuotationPDF = async (
  quotation: any,
  items: any[],
  client: any,
  company: any
) => {
  const doc = new jsPDF();

  // Colors
  const primaryColor: [number, number, number] = [33, 128, 141];
  const textColor: [number, number, number] = [51, 51, 51];
  const lightGray: [number, number, number] = [245, 245, 245];

  let yPosition = 20;

  // Header - Company Info (Left)
  doc.setFontSize(20);
  doc.setTextColor(...primaryColor);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.text(company.company_name || 'Your Company', 20, yPosition);

  yPosition += 8;
  doc.setFontSize(10);
  doc.setTextColor(...textColor);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');

  if (company.address_line1) doc.text(company.address_line1, 20, yPosition);
  yPosition += 5;
  if (company.address_line2) doc.text(company.address_line2, 20, yPosition);
  yPosition += 5;
  const companyLocation = [company.city, company.state, company.pincode]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(', ');
  if (companyLocation) doc.text(companyLocation, 20, yPosition);
  yPosition += 5;
  if (company.phone) doc.text(`Phone: ${company.phone}`, 20, yPosition);
  yPosition += 5;
  if (company.email) doc.text(`Email: ${company.email}`, 20, yPosition);
  yPosition += 5;
  if (company.gstin) doc.text(`GSTIN: ${company.gstin}`, 20, yPosition);

  // Quotation Title & Number (Right)
  doc.setFontSize(24);
  doc.setTextColor(...primaryColor);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.text('QUOTATION', 200, 20, { align: 'right' });

  doc.setFontSize(12);
  doc.setTextColor(...textColor);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  doc.text(quotation.quotation_number, 200, 30, { align: 'right' });

  // Quotation Details (Right)
  yPosition = 38;
  doc.setFontSize(10);
  doc.text(`Date: ${new Date(quotation.date).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}`, 200, yPosition, {
    align: 'right',
  });
  yPosition += 6;

  if (quotation.valid_until) {
    doc.text(
      `Valid Until: ${new Date(quotation.valid_until).toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}`,
      200,
      yPosition,
      { align: 'right' }
    );
    yPosition += 6;
  }

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.setTextColor(...primaryColor);
  doc.text(`Status: ${quotation.status.toUpperCase()}`, 200, yPosition, { align: 'right' });

  // Client Info Box
  yPosition = 80;
  doc.setFillColor(...lightGray);
  doc.rect(20, yPosition - 5, 85, 40, 'F');

  doc.setFontSize(10);
  doc.setTextColor(...textColor);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.text('BILL TO:', 22, yPosition);
  yPosition += 6;

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  doc.text(client.name || '', 22, yPosition);
  yPosition += 5;

  if (client.address_line1) doc.text(client.address_line1, 22, yPosition);
  yPosition += 5;
  if (client.address_line2) doc.text(client.address_line2, 22, yPosition);
  yPosition += 5;

  const clientLocation = [client.city, client.state, client.pincode].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
  if (clientLocation) doc.text(clientLocation, 22, yPosition);
  yPosition += 5;

  if (client.gstin) doc.text(`GSTIN: ${client.gstin}`, 22, yPosition);

  // Subject (if exists)
  if (quotation.subject) {
    yPosition = 125;
    doc.setFontSize(12);
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
    doc.text(`Subject: ${quotation.subject}`, 20, yPosition);
    yPosition += 10;
  } else {
    yPosition = 130;
  }

  // Items Table
  const tableColumn = ['#', 'Description', 'Qty', 'Unit', 'Rate', 'Amount'];
  const tableRows: any[] = [];

  items.forEach((item, index) => {
    const itemData = [
      item.item_number.toString(),
      item.description +
        (item.specifications?.notes ? `\n${item.specifications.notes}` : ''),
      item.quantity.toString(),
      item.unit,
      `₹${parseFloat(item.rate).toLocaleString('en-IN')}`,
      `₹${parseFloat(item.amount).toLocaleString('en-IN')}`,
    ];
    tableRows.push(itemData);
  });

  (doc as any).autoTable({
    startY: yPosition,
    head: [tableColumn],
    body: tableRows,
    theme: 'grid',
    headStyles: {
      fillColor: primaryColor,
      textColor: [255, 255, 255],
      fontStyle: 'bold',
      fontSize: 10,
    },
    bodyStyles: {
      fontSize: 9,
      textColor: textColor,
    },
    columnStyles: {
      0: { cellWidth: 10 },
      1: { cellWidth: 70 },
      2: { cellWidth: 20, halign: 'center' },
      3: { cellWidth: 20, halign: 'center' },
      4: { cellWidth: 30, halign: 'right' },
      5: { cellWidth: 30, halign: 'right' },
    },
    margin: { left: 20, right: 20 },
  });

  // Totals
  const finalY = (doc as any).lastAutoTable.finalY + 10;

  // Totals Box
  const totalsX = 130;
  yPosition = finalY;

  doc.setFontSize(10);
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  doc.text('Subtotal:', totalsX, yPosition);
  doc.text(
    `₹${parseFloat(quotation.subtotal || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN', {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    })}`,
    200,
    yPosition,
    { align: 'right' }
  );

  yPosition += 7;
  doc.text(`GST (${quotation.gst_percentage}%):`, totalsX, yPosition);
  doc.text(
    `₹${parseFloat(quotation.gst_amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN', {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    })}`,
    200,
    yPosition,
    { align: 'right' }
  );

  yPosition += 10;
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.setFontSize(12);
  doc.setTextColor(...primaryColor);
  doc.text('Total:', totalsX, yPosition);
  doc.text(
    `₹${parseFloat(quotation.total_amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN', {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    })}`,
    200,
    yPosition,
    { align: 'right' }
  );

  // Terms & Conditions
  if (quotation.terms_conditions) {
    yPosition += 15;
    doc.setFontSize(10);
    doc.setTextColor(...textColor);
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
    doc.text('Terms & Conditions:', 20, yPosition);
    yPosition += 6;

    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
    doc.setFontSize(9);
    const termsLines = doc.splitTextToSize(quotation.terms_conditions, 170);
    doc.text(termsLines, 20, yPosition);
  }

  // Notes
  if (quotation.notes) {
    yPosition += (quotation.terms_conditions ? 20 : 15);
    doc.setFontSize(10);
    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
    doc.text('Notes:', 20, yPosition);
    yPosition += 6;

    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
    doc.setFontSize(9);
    const notesLines = doc.splitTextToSize(quotation.notes, 170);
    doc.text(notesLines, 20, yPosition);
  }

  // Footer
  const pageCount = (doc as any).internal.getNumberOfPages();
  for (let i = 1; i <= pageCount; i++) {
    doc.setPage(i);
    doc.setFontSize(8);
    doc.setTextColor(150, 150, 150);
    doc.text(
      `Page ${i} of ${pageCount}`,
      doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth() / 2,
      doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight() - 10,
      { align: 'center' }
    );
  }

  return doc;
};
```

# **FILE 1: Quotation Detail Page - COMPLETE**

**Path:** `src/app/quotations/[id]/page.tsx`
